title: I Kings 21:24
text: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city shall the dogs eat, and him that dieth in the field shall the fowl of the heavens eat.

title: I Kings 21:25
text: (Surely there was none like to Ahab, who did sell himself to do evil in the sight of Jehovah, Jezebel his wife urging him on.

title: I Kings 21:26
text: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Jehovah had dispossessed before the children of Israel.)

title: I Kings 21:27
text: And it came to pass when Ahab heard these words, that he rent his garments, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.

title: I Kings 21:28
text: And the word of Jehovah came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

title: I Kings 21:29
text: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.

title: I Kings 22:1
text: ¶And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

title: I Kings 22:2
text: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

title: I Kings 22:3
text: And the king of Israel said to his servants, Do ye know that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we keep quiet without taking it out of the hand of the king of Syria?

title: I Kings 22:4
text: And he said to Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-Gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

title: I Kings 22:5
text: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Inquire, I pray thee, this day of the word of Jehovah.

title: I Kings 22:6
text: And the king of Israel assembled the prophets, about four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go against Ramoth-Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up, and the Lord will give it into the king's hand.

title: I Kings 22:7
text: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Jehovah besides, that we might inquire of him?

title: I Kings 22:8
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Jehovah; but I hate him, for he prophesies no good concerning me, but evil: [it is] Micah the son of Imlah. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

title: I Kings 22:9
text: Then the king of Israel called a chamberlain, and said, Fetch quickly Micah the son of Imlah.

title: I Kings 22:10
text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, having put on their robes, sat each on his throne, in the open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

title: I Kings 22:11
text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron, and he said, Thus saith Jehovah: With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have exterminated them.

title: I Kings 22:12
text: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-Gilead, and prosper; for Jehovah will give it into the king's hand.

title: I Kings 22:13
text: And the messenger that went to call Micah spoke to him saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets [declare] good to the king with one assent: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak good.

title: I Kings 22:14
text: And Micah said, As Jehovah liveth, even what Jehovah shall say to me, that will I speak.

title: I Kings 22:15
text: ¶And he came to the king. And the king said to him, Micah, shall we go against Ramoth-Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he said to him, Go up, and prosper; for Jehovah will give it into the hand of the king.

title: I Kings 22:16
text: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but truth in the name of Jehovah?

title: I Kings 22:17
text: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. And Jehovah said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

title: I Kings 22:18
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he prophesies no good concerning me, but evil?

title: I Kings 22:19
text: And he said, Hear therefore the word of Jehovah: I saw Jehovah sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him, on his right hand and on his left;

title: I Kings 22:20
text: and Jehovah said, Who shall entice Ahab that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-Gilead? And one said after this manner, and another said after that manner.

title: I Kings 22:21
text: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before Jehovah, and said, I will entice him.

title: I Kings 22:22
text: And Jehovah said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt entice [him], and also succeed: go forth, and do so.

title: I Kings 22:23
text: And now, behold, Jehovah has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and Jehovah has spoken evil concerning thee.

title: I Kings 22:24
text: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micah upon the cheek, and said, Where now went the Spirit of Jehovah from me to speak to thee?

title: I Kings 22:25
text: And Micah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go from chamber to chamber to hide thyself.

title: I Kings 22:26
text: And the king of Israel said, Take Micah and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

title: I Kings 22:27
text: and thou shalt say, Thus says the king: Put this [man] in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

title: I Kings 22:28
text: And Micah said, If thou return at all in peace, Jehovah has not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O peoples, all of you!

title: I Kings 22:29
text: ¶And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-Gilead.

title: I Kings 22:30
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

title: I Kings 22:31
text: And the king of Syria commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots saying, Fight neither with small nor great, but with the king of Israel only.

title: I Kings 22:32
text: And it came to pass when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely that is the king of Israel; and they turned against him to fight; and Jehoshaphat cried out.

title: I Kings 22:33
text: And it came to pass that when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

title: I Kings 22:34
text: And a man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the fastenings and the corslet. And he said to his charioteer, Turn thy hand, and drive me out of the camp; for I am wounded.

title: I Kings 22:35
text: And the battle increased that day; and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and he died at even; and the blood of the wound ran out into the hollow of the chariot.

title: I Kings 22:36
text: And there went the cry throughout the host at the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country!

title: I Kings 22:37
text: And the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

title: I Kings 22:38
text: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked his blood, where the harlots bathed: according to the word of Jehovah, which he had spoken.

title: I Kings 22:39
text: And the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house that he built, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: I Kings 22:40
text: And Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 22:41
text: ¶And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

title: I Kings 22:42
text: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.

title: I Kings 22:43
text: And he walked in all the way of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing what was right in the sight of Jehovah. Only, the high places were not removed: the people offered and burned incense still on the high places.

title: I Kings 22:44
text: And Jehoshaphat was at peace with the king of Israel.

title: I Kings 22:45
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might which he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: I Kings 22:46
text: And the remainder of the sodomites, which were left in the days of his father Asa, he put away from out of the land.

title: I Kings 22:47
text: And there was no king in Edom: a deputy reigned.

title: I Kings 22:48
text: Jehoshaphat made Tarshish-ships to go to Ophir for gold; but they went not, for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

title: I Kings 22:49
text: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab to Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

title: I Kings 22:50
text: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father; and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Kings 22:51
text: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; and he reigned two years over Israel.

title: I Kings 22:52
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

title: I Kings 22:53
text: And he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked Jehovah the God of Israel to anger, according to all that his father had done.

title: II Kings 1:1
text: ¶And Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

title: II Kings 1:2
text: And Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper chamber which was in Samaria, and was sick; and he sent messengers and said to them, Go, inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, whether I shall recover from this disease.

title: II Kings 1:3
text: And the angel of Jehovah said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say to them, Is it because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?

title: II Kings 1:4
text: Now therefore thus saith Jehovah: Thou shalt not come down from the bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt certainly die. And Elijah departed.

title: II Kings 1:5
text: And the messengers returned to him; and he said to them, Why have ye returned?

title: II Kings 1:6
text: And they said unto him, A man came up to meet us, and said to us, Go, return to the king that sent you and say to him, Thus saith Jehovah: Is it because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from the bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt certainly die.

title: II Kings 1:7
text: And he said to them, What manner of man was he that came up to meet you, and told you these words?

title: II Kings 1:8
text: And they said to him, He was a man in a hairy [garment], and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

title: II Kings 1:9
text: ¶And he sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him, and behold, he sat on the top of the mount. And he spoke to him: Man of God, the king says, Come down!

title: II Kings 1:10
text: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, And if I be a man of God, let fire come down from the heavens and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from the heavens, and consumed him and his fifty.

title: II Kings 1:11
text: And again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he spoke and said to him, Man of God, thus says the king: Come down quickly!

title: II Kings 1:12
text: And Elijah answered and said to them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from the heavens and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from the heavens, and consumed him and his fifty.

title: II Kings 1:13
text: And again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him and said to him, Man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.

title: II Kings 1:14
text: Behold, there came down fire from the heavens, and consumed the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties; but now, let my life be precious in thy sight.

title: II Kings 1:15
text: And the angel of Jehovah said to Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him to the king.

title: II Kings 1:16
text: And he said to him, Thus saith Jehovah: Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down from the bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt certainly die.

title: II Kings 1:17
text: And he died according to the word of Jehovah that Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram began to reign in his stead, in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; for he had no son.

title: II Kings 1:18
text: And the rest of the acts of Ahaziah, what he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 2:1
text: ¶And it came to pass when Jehovah would take up Elijah into the heavens by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

title: II Kings 2:2
text: And Elijah said to Elisha, Abide here, I pray thee; for Jehovah has sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said, As Jehovah liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee! So they went down to Bethel.

title: II Kings 2:3
text: And the sons of the prophets that were at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said to him, Dost thou know that Jehovah will take away thy master from over thy head to-day? And he said, I also know it: be silent!

title: II Kings 2:4
text: And Elijah said to him, Elisha, abide here, I pray thee; for Jehovah has sent me to Jericho. And he said, As Jehovah liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee! And they came to Jericho.

title: II Kings 2:5
text: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho drew near to Elisha and said to him, Dost thou know that Jehovah will take away thy master from over thy head to-day? And he said, I also know it: be silent!

title: II Kings 2:6
text: And Elijah said to him, Abide here, I pray thee; for Jehovah has sent me to the Jordan. And he said, As Jehovah liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee! And they two went on.

title: II Kings 2:7
text: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite afar off; and they two stood by the Jordan.

title: II Kings 2:8
text: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither; and they two went over on dry ground.

title: II Kings 2:9
text: ¶And it came to pass when they had gone over, that Elijah said to Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I am taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

title: II Kings 2:10
text: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so to thee; but if not, it shall not be [so].

title: II Kings 2:11
text: And it came to pass as they went on, and talked, that behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire; and they parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into the heavens.

title: II Kings 2:12
text: And Elisha saw [it], and he cried, My father, my father! the chariot of Israel and the horsemen thereof! And he saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own garments and rent them in two pieces.

title: II Kings 2:13
text: ¶And he took up the mantle of Elijah which fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan;

title: II Kings 2:14
text: and he took the mantle of Elijah which had fallen from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is Jehovah, the God of Elijah? He also smote the waters, and they parted hither and thither, and Elisha went over.

title: II Kings 2:15
text: And the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho on the opposite side saw him, and they said, The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him,

title: II Kings 2:16
text: and said to him, Behold now, there are with thy servants fifty valiant men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master, lest perhaps the Spirit of Jehovah have taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some ravine. And he said, Ye shall not send.

title: II Kings 2:17
text: And they pressed him till he was ashamed, and he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men, and they sought three days, but did not find him.

title: II Kings 2:18
text: And they came again to him (now he was staying at Jericho); and he said to them, Did I not say to you, Go not?

title: II Kings 2:19
text: ¶And the men of the city said to Elisha, Behold now, the situation of the city is good, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.

title: II Kings 2:20
text: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt in it. And they brought it to him.

title: II Kings 2:21
text: And he went forth to the source of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith Jehovah: I have healed these waters: there shall not be from thence any more death or barrenness.

title: II Kings 2:22
text: And the waters were healed to this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spoke.

title: II Kings 2:23
text: And he went up from thence to Bethel, and as he went up by the way, there came forth little boys out of the city, and mocked him, and said to him, Go up, bald head; go up, bald head!

title: II Kings 2:24
text: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of Jehovah. And there came forth two she-bears out of the wood, and tore forty-two children of them.

title: II Kings 2:25
text: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

title: II Kings 3:1
text: ¶And Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; and he reigned twelve years.

title: II Kings 3:2
text: And he wrought evil in the sight of Jehovah, but not like his father, and like his mother; and he took away the column of Baal that his father had made.

title: II Kings 3:3
text: Only, he clave to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat who made Israel to sin: he did not depart therefrom.

title: II Kings 3:4
text: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs and a hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

title: II Kings 3:5
text: And it came to pass when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

title: II Kings 3:6
text: ¶And at that time king Jehoram went out of Samaria and inspected all Israel.

title: II Kings 3:7
text: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah saying, The king of Moab has rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

title: II Kings 3:8
text: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he said, By way of the wilderness of Edom.

title: II Kings 3:9
text: And the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom, and they made a circuit of seven days' journey. And there was no water for the army, and for the cattle that followed them.

title: II Kings 3:10
text: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that Jehovah has called these three kings together, to give them into the hand of Moab!

title: II Kings 3:11
text: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Jehovah that we may inquire of Jehovah by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah.

title: II Kings 3:12
text: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of Jehovah is with him. And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

title: II Kings 3:13
text: And Elisha said to the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? go to the prophets of thy father and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said to him, Not so, for Jehovah has called these three kings to give them into the hand of Moab.

title: II Kings 3:14
text: And Elisha said, As Jehovah of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee nor see thee.

title: II Kings 3:15
text: And now fetch me a minstrel. And it came to pass when the minstrel played, that the hand of Jehovah was upon him.

title: II Kings 3:16
text: And he said, Thus saith Jehovah: Make this valley full of ditches.

title: II Kings 3:17
text: For thus saith Jehovah: Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet this valley shall be filled with water, and ye shall drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

title: II Kings 3:18
text: And this is a light thing in the sight of Jehovah: he will give the Moabites also into your hand.

title: II Kings 3:19
text: And ye shall smite every fortified city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

title: II Kings 3:20
text: ¶And it came to pass in the morning, when the oblation was offered up, that behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

title: II Kings 3:21
text: And all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, and they were called together, all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood by the border.

title: II Kings 3:22
text: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun rose upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side red as blood.

title: II Kings 3:23
text: And they said, This is blood: the kings are entirely destroyed, and have smitten one another; and now, Moab, to the spoil!

title: II Kings 3:24
text: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, and they fled before them; and they entered in and smote Moab.

title: II Kings 3:25
text: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone and filled it, and they stopped every well of water, and felled every good tree, until they left [only] the stones at Kirhareseth; and the slingers went about it, and smote it.

title: II Kings 3:26
text: And the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, and he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through to the king of Edom, but they could not.

title: II Kings 3:27
text: And he took his eldest son, that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him up for a burnt-offering upon the wall. And there was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to [their own] land.

title: II Kings 4:1
text: ¶And a woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried to Elisha saying, Thy servant my husband is dead, and thou knowest that thy servant feared Jehovah; and the creditor is come to take my two children to be bondmen.

title: II Kings 4:2
text: And Elisha said to her, What shall I do for thee? Tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thy handmaid has not anything at all in the house but a pot of oil.

title: II Kings 4:3
text: And he said, Go, borrow for thyself vessels abroad from all thy neighbours, empty vessels; let it not be few;

title: II Kings 4:4
text: and go in, and shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and pour out into all those vessels, and set aside what is full.

title: II Kings 4:5
text: And she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons: they brought [the vessels] to her, and she poured out.

title: II Kings 4:6
text: And it came to pass when the vessels were full, that she said to her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said to her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

title: II Kings 4:7
text: And she came and told the man of God; and he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou [and] thy sons on the rest.

title: II Kings 4:8
text: ¶And it came to pass on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a wealthy woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, [that] as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

title: II Kings 4:9
text: And she said to her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God, who passes by us continually.

title: II Kings 4:10
text: Let us make, I pray thee, a small upper chamber with walls, and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a seat, and a lampstand; and it shall be when he cometh to us, he shall turn in thither.

title: II Kings 4:11
text: And it came to pass on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the upper chamber, and lay there.

title: II Kings 4:12
text: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And he called her, and she stood before him.

title: II Kings 4:13
text: And he said to him, Say now to her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she said, I dwell among mine own people.

title: II Kings 4:14
text: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi said, Verily, she has no son, and her husband is old.

title: II Kings 4:15
text: And he said, Call her; and he called her; and she stood in the doorway.

title: II Kings 4:16
text: And he said, At this appointed time, when thy term is come, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, No, my lord, man of God, do not lie to thy handmaid.

title: II Kings 4:17
text: And the woman conceived, and bore a son at that appointed time in the next year as Elisha had said to her.

title: II Kings 4:18
text: ¶And the child grew, and it came to pass one day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

title: II Kings 4:19
text: And he said to his father, My head, my head! And he said to the servant, Carry him to his mother.

title: II Kings 4:20
text: And he carried him, and brought him to his mother; and he sat on her knees till noon, and died.

title: II Kings 4:21
text: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut [the door] upon him, and went out.

title: II Kings 4:22
text: And she called to her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, and I will run to the man of God, and come again.

title: II Kings 4:23
text: And he said, Why wilt thou go to him to-day? It is neither new moon nor sabbath. And she said, [It is] well.

title: II Kings 4:24
text: Then she saddled the ass, and said to her servant, Drive and go forward; slack not the riding for me, except I bid thee.

title: II Kings 4:25
text: And she went and came to the man of God, to mount Carmel. And it came to pass when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, there is the Shunammite:

title: II Kings 4:26
text: run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she said, It is well.

title: II Kings 4:27
text: And she came to the man of God to the mountain, and caught him by the feet; and Gehazi drew near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, Let her alone, for her soul is troubled within her, and Jehovah has hidden it from me, and has not told me.

title: II Kings 4:28
text: And she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

title: II Kings 4:29
text: And he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thy hand, and go thy way. If thou meet any man, salute him not, and if any salute thee, answer him not again; and lay my staff upon the face of the lad.

title: II Kings 4:30
text: And the mother of the lad said, As Jehovah liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee! And he rose up and followed her.

title: II Kings 4:31
text: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the lad; but there was neither voice, nor sign of attention. And he returned to meet him, and told him saying, The lad is not awaked.

title: II Kings 4:32
text: And when Elisha came into the house, behold, the child was dead, [and] laid upon his bed.

title: II Kings 4:33
text: And he went in and shut the door upon them both, and prayed to Jehovah.

title: II Kings 4:34
text: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands, and bent over him; and the flesh of the child grew warm.

title: II Kings 4:35
text: And he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and bent over him. And the lad sneezed seven times, and the lad opened his eyes.

title: II Kings 4:36
text: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. And he called her; and she came to him. And he said, Take up thy son.

title: II Kings 4:37
text: And she came and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; and she took up her son, and went out.

title: II Kings 4:38
text: ¶And Elisha came again to Gilgal. And there was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him. And he said to his servant, Set on the great pot, and boil pottage for the sons of the prophets.

title: II Kings 4:39
text: Then one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered from it his lap full of wild colocynths, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage; for they did not know them.

title: II Kings 4:40
text: And they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out and said, Man of God, there is death in the pot! And they could not eat [it].

title: II Kings 4:41
text: And he said, Then bring meal. And he cast [it] into the pot, and said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.

title: II Kings 4:42
text: And there came a man from Baal-shalishah, and brought the man of God bread of the first-fruits, twenty loaves of barley, and fresh ears of corn in his sack. And he said, Give to the people that they may eat.

title: II Kings 4:43
text: And his attendant said, How shall I set this before a hundred men? And he said, Give the people that they may eat; for thus saith Jehovah: They shall eat, and shall have to spare.

title: II Kings 4:44
text: And he set [it] before them, and they ate and left [thereof], according to the word of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 5:1
text: ¶And Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man before his master, and honourable, for by him Jehovah had given deliverance to Syria; and he was a mighty man of valour, [but] a leper.

title: II Kings 5:2
text: And the Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.

title: II Kings 5:3
text: And she said to her mistress, Oh, would that my lord were before the prophet that is in Samaria! then he would cure him of his leprosy.

title: II Kings 5:4
text: And he went and told his lord saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.

title: II Kings 5:5
text: And the king of Syria said, Well! go, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand [shekels] of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

title: II Kings 5:6
text: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, And now, when this letter comes to thee, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest cure him of his leprosy.

title: II Kings 5:7
text: And it came to pass when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his garments, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to cure a man of his leprosy? Wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeks an occasion against me.

title: II Kings 5:8
text: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his garments, that he sent to the king, saying, Why hast thou rent thy garments? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

title: II Kings 5:9
text: ¶And Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the doorway of the house of Elisha.

title: II Kings 5:10
text: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

title: II Kings 5:11
text: And Naaman was wroth, and went away and said, Behold, I thought, He will certainly come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of Jehovah his God, and wave his hand over the place, and cure the leper.

title: II Kings 5:12
text: Are not the Abanah and the Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them and be clean? And he turned and went away in a rage.

title: II Kings 5:13
text: And his servants drew near, and spoke to him and said, My father, [if] the prophet had bidden thee [do some] great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he says to thee, Wash and be clean?

title: II Kings 5:14
text: Then he went down, and plunged himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God. And his flesh became again like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

title: II Kings 5:15
text: ¶And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came and stood before him; and he said, Behold, I know that there is no God in all the earth but in Israel; and now, I pray thee, take a present of thy servant.

title: II Kings 5:16
text: But he said, As Jehovah liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none! And he urged him to take it; but he refused.

title: II Kings 5:17
text: And Naaman said, If not, then let there, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of [this] earth; for thy servant will no more offer burnt-offering and sacrifice to other gods, but to Jehovah.

title: II Kings 5:18
text: In this thing Jehovah pardon thy servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to bow down there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon--when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, Jehovah pardon thy servant, I pray thee, in this thing.

title: II Kings 5:19
text: And he said to him, Go in peace. And he departed from him a little way.

title: II Kings 5:20
text: ¶And Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master has spared Naaman, this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought; but as Jehovah liveth, I will run after him and take somewhat of him.

title: II Kings 5:21
text: And Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he sprang down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?

title: II Kings 5:22
text: And he said, All is well. My master has sent me saying, Behold, even now there are come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets; give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of raiment.

title: II Kings 5:23
text: And Naaman said, Consent to take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of raiment, and laid them upon two of his young men; and they bore them before him.

title: II Kings 5:24
text: And when he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stowed them in the house; and he let the men go, and they departed.

title: II Kings 5:25
text: And he entered in and stood before his master. And Elisha said to him, Whence [comest thou], Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.

title: II Kings 5:26
text: And he said to him, Did not my heart go, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and bondmen, and bondwomen?

title: II Kings 5:27
text: But the leprosy of Naaman shall fasten upon thee, and upon thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence leprous, as snow.

title: II Kings 6:1
text: ¶And the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell before thee is too strait for us.

title: II Kings 6:2
text: Let us go, we pray thee, to the Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he said, Go.

title: II Kings 6:3
text: And one said, Consent, I pray thee, to go with thy servants. And he said, I will go.

title: II Kings 6:4
text: And he went with them. And they came to the Jordan and cut down the trees.

title: II Kings 6:5
text: And it came to pass as one was felling a beam, that the iron fell into the water; and he cried and said, Alas, master, and it was borrowed!

title: II Kings 6:6
text: And the man of God said, Where did it fall? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither, and made the iron to swim.

title: II Kings 6:7
text: And he said, Take [it] up to thee. And he put out his hand and took it.

title: II Kings 6:8
text: ¶And the king of Syria warred against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place [shall be] my camp.

title: II Kings 6:9
text: And the man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place, for thither the Syrians are come down.

title: II Kings 6:10
text: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and he was on his guard there. [That took place] not once, nor twice.

title: II Kings 6:11
text: And the heart of the king of Syria was troubled because of this thing; and he called his servants, and said to them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?

title: II Kings 6:12
text: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.

title: II Kings 6:13
text: ¶And he said, Go and see where he is, and I will send and fetch him. And it was told him saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.

title: II Kings 6:14
text: And he sent thither horses and chariots, and a great host, and they came by night and surrounded the city.

title: II Kings 6:15
text: And when the attendant of the man of God rose early and went forth, behold, an army surrounded the city, with horses and chariots. And his servant said to him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

title: II Kings 6:16
text: And he said, Fear not, for they that are with us are more than they that are with them.

title: II Kings 6:17
text: And Elisha prayed and said, Jehovah, I pray thee, open his eyes that he may see. And Jehovah opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw; and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

title: II Kings 6:18
text: And they came down to him; and Elisha prayed to Jehovah and said, Smite this nation, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

title: II Kings 6:19
text: And Elisha said to them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. And he led them to Samaria.

title: II Kings 6:20
text: And it came to pass when they entered into Samaria, that Elisha said, Jehovah, open the eyes of these [men] that they may see. And Jehovah opened their eyes, and they saw, and behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.

title: II Kings 6:21
text: And the king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite? shall I smite [them]?

title: II Kings 6:22
text: And he said, Thou shalt not smite [them]: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

title: II Kings 6:23
text: And he prepared a great repast for them, and they ate and drank; and he sent them away, and they went to their master. And the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

title: II Kings 6:24
text: ¶And it came to pass after this that Ben-Hadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.

title: II Kings 6:25
text: And there was a great famine in Samaria; and behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was worth eighty silver-pieces, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung five silver-pieces.

title: II Kings 6:26
text: And it came to pass as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman to him saying, Help, my lord O king!

title: II Kings 6:27
text: And he said, If Jehovah do not help thee, whence should I help thee? Out of the threshing-floor, or out of the winepress?

title: II Kings 6:28
text: And the king said to her, What aileth thee? And she said, This woman said to me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to-day, and we will eat my son to-morrow.

title: II Kings 6:29
text: And we boiled my son, and ate him: and I said to her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him; and she has hidden her son.

title: II Kings 6:30
text: And it came to pass when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his garments; and he was passing by upon the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.

title: II Kings 6:31
text: And he said, God do so, and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall remain on him this day!

title: II Kings 6:32
text: And Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him. And [the king] sent a man before him. Before the messenger came to him, he himself said to the elders, Do ye see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? See, when the messenger comes; shut the door, and keep him off with the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?

title: II Kings 6:33
text: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. And [the king] said, Behold, this evil is of Jehovah: why should I wait for Jehovah any longer?

title: II Kings 7:1
text: ¶And Elisha said, Hear the word of Jehovah. Thus saith Jehovah: To-morrow about this time shall the measure of fine flour be at a shekel, and two measures of barley at a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

title: II Kings 7:2
text: And the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God and said, Behold, if Jehovah should make windows in the heavens, would this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

title: II Kings 7:3
text: ¶And there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate, and they said one to another, Why do we abide here until we die?

title: II Kings 7:4
text: If we say, Let us enter into the city, the famine is in the city, and we shall die there; and if we abide here, we shall die. And now come, let us fall away to the camp of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they put us to death, we shall but die.

title: II Kings 7:5
text: And they rose up in the dusk to go to the camp of the Syrians; and they came to the extremity of the camp of the Syrians; and behold, there was no man there.

title: II Kings 7:6
text: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, a noise of a great host; and they said one to another, Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.

title: II Kings 7:7
text: And they rose up and fled in the dusk, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

title: II Kings 7:8
text: And those lepers came to the extremity of the camp; and they went into one tent, and ate and drank, and carried thence silver and gold, and garments, and went and hid it; and they came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence, and went and hid [it].

title: II Kings 7:9
text: And they said one to another, We are not doing right; this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, the iniquity will find us out; and now come, let us go and tell the king's household.

title: II Kings 7:10
text: And they came and called to the porters of the city, and told them saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and behold, there was no one there, no sound of man, but the horses tied, and the asses tied, and the tents as they were.

title: II Kings 7:11
text: And the porters cried [it] and told [it] to the king's house within.

title: II Kings 7:12
text: ¶And the king rose up in the night and said to his servants, Let me tell you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry, and they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.

title: II Kings 7:13
text: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some one take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city (behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that have perished), and let us send and see.

title: II Kings 7:14
text: And they took two chariots with their horses; and the king sent after the army of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

title: II Kings 7:15
text: And they went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the way was full of garments and materials, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned and told the king.

title: II Kings 7:16
text: And the people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians; and the measure of fine flour was at a shekel, and two measures of barley at a shekel, according to the word of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 7:17
text: And the king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate; and the people trampled upon him in the gate, and he died, according to what the man of God had said, --what he had said when the king came down to him.

title: II Kings 7:18
text: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king saying, Two measures of barley shall be at a shekel, and the measure of fine flour at a shekel, to-morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria.

title: II Kings 7:19
text: And the captain answered the man of God and said, Behold, if Jehovah should make windows in the heavens, would such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

title: II Kings 7:20
text: And so it happened to him; and the people trampled upon him in the gate, and he died.

title: II Kings 8:1
text: ¶And Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, Rise up and go, thou and thy household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn; for Jehovah has called for a famine, and it shall also come upon the land for seven years.

title: II Kings 8:2
text: And the woman rose up, and did according to the saying of the man of God, and went, she and her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

title: II Kings 8:3
text: And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines; and she went forth to cry to the king for her house and for her land.

title: II Kings 8:4
text: And the king was talking with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha has done.

title: II Kings 8:5
text: And it came to pass as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

title: II Kings 8:6
text: And the king asked the woman, and she told him. And the king appointed a certain chamberlain, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the revenue of the land since the day that she left the country even until now.

title: II Kings 8:7
text: ¶And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-Hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him saying, The man of God is come hither.

title: II Kings 8:8
text: And the king said to Hazael, Take a present in thy hand, and go, meet the man of God, and inquire of Jehovah by him, saying, Shall I recover from this disease?

title: II Kings 8:9
text: And Hazael went to meet him, and took with him a present, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden; and he came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Ben-Hadad king of Syria has sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover from this disease?

title: II Kings 8:10
text: And Elisha said to him, Go, say to him, Thou wilt certainly recover. But Jehovah has shewn me that he shall certainly die.

title: II Kings 8:11
text: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed; and the man of God wept.

title: II Kings 8:12
text: And Hazael said, Why does my lord weep? And he said, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do to the children of Israel: their strongholds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou kill with the sword, and wilt dash in pieces their children, and rip up their women with child.

title: II Kings 8:13
text: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha said, Jehovah has shewn me that thou wilt be king over Syria.

title: II Kings 8:14
text: And he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, What did Elisha say to thee? And he said, He told me [that] thou wouldest certainly recover.

title: II Kings 8:15
text: And it came to pass the next day, that he took the coverlet and dipped [it] in water, and spread it over his face, so that he died; and Hazael reigned in his stead.

title: II Kings 8:16
text: ¶And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab, king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, began to reign.

title: II Kings 8:17
text: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

title: II Kings 8:18
text: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab, for the daughter of Ahab was his wife; and he did evil in the sight of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 8:19
text: But Jehovah would not destroy Judah, for David his servant's sake, as he had promised him to give him always a lamp for his sons.

title: II Kings 8:20
text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and they set a king over themselves.

title: II Kings 8:21
text: And Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him; and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites who had surrounded him, and the captains of the chariots; and the people fled into their tents.

title: II Kings 8:22
text: But the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

title: II Kings 8:23
text: And the rest of the acts of Joram and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: II Kings 8:24
text: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Kings 8:25
text: ¶In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab, king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, began to reign.

title: II Kings 8:26
text: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

title: II Kings 8:27
text: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of Jehovah, like the house of Ahab; for he was the son-in-law of the house of Ahab.

title: II Kings 8:28
text: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael the king of Syria at Ramoth-Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

title: II Kings 8:29
text: And king Joram returned to be healed in Jizreel of the wounds that the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab at Jizreel, for he was sick.

title: II Kings 9:1
text: ¶And Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, Gird up thy loins, and take this vial of oil in thy hand, and go to Ramoth-Gilead.

title: II Kings 9:2
text: And when thou art come thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat, son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him rise up from among his brethren, and bring him to an inner chamber;

title: II Kings 9:3
text: then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head and say, Thus saith Jehovah: I have anointed thee king over Israel; and open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

title: II Kings 9:4
text: And the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth-Gilead.

title: II Kings 9:5
text: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting. And he said, I have an errand to thee, captain. And Jehu said, To which of all of us? And he said, To thee, captain.

title: II Kings 9:6
text: And he rose up and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, Thus saith Jehovah the God of Israel: I have anointed thee king over the people of Jehovah, over Israel.

title: II Kings 9:7
text: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master; and I will avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of Jehovah at the hand of Jezebel.

title: II Kings 9:8
text: And the whole house of Ahab shall perish, and I will cut off from Ahab every male, and him that is shut up and left in Israel.

title: II Kings 9:9
text: And I will make the house of Ahab as the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and as the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

title: II Kings 9:10
text: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the plot of Jizreel, and none shall bury her. And he opened the door and fled.

title: II Kings 9:11
text: ¶And Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord. And one said to him, Is all well? why came this madman to thee? And he said to them, Ye know the man, and his mind.

title: II Kings 9:12
text: And they said, It is false! tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spoke he to me saying, Thus saith Jehovah: I have anointed thee king over Israel.

title: II Kings 9:13
text: Then they hasted and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the very stairs, and blew with trumpets, and said, Jehu is king!

title: II Kings 9:14
text: And Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat, son of Nimshi, conspired against Joram. (Now Joram kept Ramoth-Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

title: II Kings 9:15
text: and king Joram had returned to be healed in Jizreel of the wounds that the Syrians had given him, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your will, let not a fugitive escape out of the city to go to tell [it] in Jizreel.

title: II Kings 9:16
text: ¶And Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jizreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

title: II Kings 9:17
text: And the watchman stood on the tower in Jizreel, and saw Jehu's company as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?

title: II Kings 9:18
text: So there went one on horseback to meet him; and he said, Thus saith the king: Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told saying, The messenger came to them, and he does not return.

title: II Kings 9:19
text: And he sent out a second on horseback; and he came to them and said, Thus saith the king: Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

title: II Kings 9:20
text: And the watchman told saying, He came to them, and does not return. And the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he drives furiously.

title: II Kings 9:21
text: Then Joram said, Make ready! And they made ready his chariot. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and met him in the plot of Naboth the Jizreelite.

title: II Kings 9:22
text: And it came to pass when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he said, What peace, so long as the fornications of thy mother Jezebel and her sorceries are so many?

title: II Kings 9:23
text: Then Joram turned his hand, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, Treachery, Ahaziah!

title: II Kings 9:24
text: And Jehu took his bow in his hand, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out through his heart; and he sank down in his chariot.

title: II Kings 9:25
text: And he said to Bidkar his captain, Take him up [and] cast him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jizreelite. For remember how, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, that Jehovah laid this burden upon him:

title: II Kings 9:26
text: Certainly I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith Jehovah; and I will requite thee in this plot, saith Jehovah. And now, take [and] cast him into the plot, according to the word of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 9:27
text: When Ahaziah king of Judah saw [that], he fled by the way of the garden-house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in his chariot. It was on the ascent of Gur, which is by Jibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

title: II Kings 9:28
text: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

title: II Kings 9:29
text: (And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab had Ahaziah begun to reign over Judah.)

title: II Kings 9:30
text: ¶And Jehu came to Jizreel; and Jezebel heard of it, and she put paint to her eyes, and decked her head, and looked out at the window.

title: II Kings 9:31
text: And when Jehu came in at the gate, she said, Is it peace, Zimri, murderer of his master?

title: II Kings 9:32
text: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And two or three chamberlains looked out to him.

title: II Kings 9:33
text: And he said, Throw her down! And they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses; and he trampled on her.

title: II Kings 9:34
text: And he came in, and ate and drank; and he said, Go, look, I pray you, after this cursed [woman], and bury her; for she is a king's daughter.

title: II Kings 9:35
text: And they went to bury her; but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of the hands.

title: II Kings 9:36
text: And they came back and told him. And he said, This is the word of Jehovah, which he spoke through his servant Elijah the Tishbite saying, In the plot of Jizreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel;

title: II Kings 9:37
text: and the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the open field in the plot of Jizreel, so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.

title: II Kings 10:1
text: ¶Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, to the princes of Jizreel, to the elders, and to Ahab's guardians, saying,

title: II Kings 10:2
text: And now, when this letter comes to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots, and horses, and a fortified city, and armour,

title: II Kings 10:3
text: look out the best and worthiest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.

title: II Kings 10:4
text: And they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, the two kings stood not before him; and how shall we stand?

title: II Kings 10:5
text: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, and the elders, and the guardians sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any one king; do what is good in thy sight.

title: II Kings 10:6
text: And he wrote a letter the second time to them saying, If ye are mine, and will hearken to my voice, take the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jizreel to-morrow at this time. Now the king's sons, seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.

title: II Kings 10:7
text: And it came to pass when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slaughtered seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jizreel.

title: II Kings 10:8
text: And a messenger came and told him saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.

title: II Kings 10:9
text: And it came to pass in the morning that he went out; and he stood, and said to all the people, Ye are righteous! behold, I conspired against my master and killed him; but who smote all these?

title: II Kings 10:10
text: Know now that nothing shall fall to the earth of the word of Jehovah, which Jehovah spoke concerning the house of Ahab; for Jehovah has done that which he said through his servant Elijah.

title: II Kings 10:11
text: And Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jizreel, and all his great men, and his acquaintances, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

title: II Kings 10:12
text: And he rose up and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shepherds' meeting-place on the way,

title: II Kings 10:13
text: Jehu found the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they said, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and have come down to salute the children of the king, and the children of the queen.

title: II Kings 10:14
text: And he said, Take them alive! And they took them alive, and slew them at the well of the meeting-place, forty-two men; and he left not one of them remaining.

title: II Kings 10:15
text: ¶And he departed thence, and found Jehonadab the son of Rechab [coming] to meet him; and he greeted him, and said to him, Is thy heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab said, It is. --If it be, give [me] thy hand. --And he gave [him] his hand; and [Jehu] took him up to him into the chariot,

title: II Kings 10:16
text: and said, Come with me, and see my zeal for Jehovah. So they made him ride in his chariot.

title: II Kings 10:17
text: And he came to Samaria, and smote all that remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed him, according to the word of Jehovah which he spoke to Elijah.

title: II Kings 10:18
text: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, Ahab served Baal a little: Jehu will serve him much.

title: II Kings 10:19
text: And now call me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests: let none be wanting; for I have a great sacrifice [to do] to Baal; whoever shall be wanting shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, in order that he might bring destruction upon the servants of Baal.

title: II Kings 10:20
text: And Jehu said, Hallow a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed [it].

title: II Kings 10:21
text: And Jehu sent into all Israel; and all the servants of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not: and they entered into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to the other.

title: II Kings 10:22
text: And he said to him that was over the wardrobe, Bring forth vestments for all the servants of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

title: II Kings 10:23
text: And Jehu and Jehonadab the son of Rechab entered into the house of Baal, and said to the servants of Baal, Search, and see that there be here with you none of the servants of Jehovah, but the servants of Baal only.

title: II Kings 10:24
text: And they entered in to offer sacrifices and burnt-offerings. Now Jehu appointed eighty men without, and said, He that allows any of the men to escape that I have brought into your hands, his life shall be for the life of him.

title: II Kings 10:25
text: And it came to pass as soon as they had ended offering up the burnt-offering, that Jehu said to the couriers and to the captains, Go in, slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the couriers and the captains cast [them] there. And they went to the city of the house of Baal,

title: II Kings 10:26
text: and brought forth the columns out of the house of Baal, and burned them;

title: II Kings 10:27
text: and they broke down the column of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a draught-house to this day.

title: II Kings 10:28
text: Thus Jehu extirpated Baal out of Israel.

title: II Kings 10:29
text: ¶Only, the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, from them Jehu departed not: [from] the golden calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.

title: II Kings 10:30
text: And Jehovah said to Jehu, Because thou hast executed well that which is right in my sight, [and] hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in my heart, thy children of the fourth [generation] shall sit on the throne of Israel.

title: II Kings 10:31
text: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of Jehovah the God of Israel with all his heart; he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, who made Israel to sin.

title: II Kings 10:32
text: In those days Jehovah began to cut Israel short; and Hazael smote them in all the borders of Israel;

title: II Kings 10:33
text: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, both Gilead and Bashan.

title: II Kings 10:34
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 10:35
text: And Jehu slept with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria: and Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Kings 10:36
text: Now the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

title: II Kings 11:1
text: ¶And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she rose up and destroyed all the royal seed.

title: II Kings 11:2
text: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, the sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, [and hid] him and his nurse in the bedchamber; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

title: II Kings 11:3
text: And he was with her hid in the house of Jehovah six years. And Athaliah reigned over the land.

title: II Kings 11:4
text: ¶And in the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains of the hundreds, of the bodyguard and the couriers, and brought them to him into the house of Jehovah, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of Jehovah, and shewed them the king's son.

title: II Kings 11:5
text: And he commanded them saying, This is the thing which ye shall do: a third part of you, that come in on the sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king's house;

title: II Kings 11:6
text: and a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the couriers; and ye shall keep the watch of the house for a defence.

title: II Kings 11:7
text: And the two parts of you, all those that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of Jehovah about the king.

title: II Kings 11:8
text: And ye shall encompass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he that comes within the ranks shall be put to death; and ye shall be with the king when he goes out and when he comes in.

title: II Kings 11:9
text: And the captains of the hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they took every man his men, those that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go forth on the sabbath, and they came to Jehoiada the priest.

title: II Kings 11:10
text: And the priest gave to the captains of the hundreds king David's spears and shields which were in the house of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 11:11
text: And the couriers stood by the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, toward the altar and the house.

title: II Kings 11:12
text: And he brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and [gave him] the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, Long live the king!

title: II Kings 11:13
text: ¶And Athaliah heard the noise of the couriers [and] of the people; and she came to the people into the house of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 11:14
text: And she looked, and behold, the king stood on the dais, according to the custom, and the princes and the trumpeters were by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets. And Athaliah rent her garments and cried, Conspiracy! Conspiracy!

title: II Kings 11:15
text: And Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds that were set over the host, and said to them, Lead her forth without the ranks; and whosoever follows her, slay with the sword; for the priest said, Let her not be put to death in the house of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 11:16
text: And they made way for her, and she went by the way by which the horses entered the king's house, and there was she put to death.

title: II Kings 11:17
text: ¶And Jehoiada made a covenant between Jehovah and the king and the people, that they should be the people of Jehovah; and between the king and the people.

title: II Kings 11:18
text: Then all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and broke it down: his altars and his images they broke in pieces completely, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 11:19
text: And he took the captains of the hundreds, and the bodyguard, and the couriers, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of Jehovah, and came by the way through the gate of the couriers into the king's house. And he sat upon the throne of the kings.

title: II Kings 11:20
text: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet; and they had slain Athaliah with the sword [beside] the king's house.

title: II Kings 11:21
text: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

title: II Kings 12:1
text: ¶In the seventh year of Jehu, Jehoash began to reign; and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

title: II Kings 12:2
text: And Jehoash did what was right in the sight of Jehovah, all the days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

title: II Kings 12:3
text: Only, the high places were not removed: the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

title: II Kings 12:4
text: ¶And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the hallowed things that is brought into the house of Jehovah, the money of every one that passes [the account], the money at which every man is valued, [and] all the money that comes into any man's heart to bring into the house of Jehovah,

title: II Kings 12:5
text: let the priests take it, every man of his acquaintance; and let them repair the breaches of the house, wherever any breach is found.

title: II Kings 12:6
text: And it was [so that] in the twenty-third year of king Jehoash, the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

title: II Kings 12:7
text: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the priests, and said to them, Why have ye not repaired the breaches of the house? And now receive no money of your acquaintances, but give it for the breaches of the house.

title: II Kings 12:8
text: And the priests consented to receive no money of the people, and that they should only repair the breaches of the house.

title: II Kings 12:9
text: And Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the house of Jehovah; and the priests that kept the door put into it all the money brought into the house of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 12:10
text: And it came to pass when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they tied up and counted the money that was found in the house of Jehovah.

title: II Kings 12:11
text: And they gave the money, weighed out into the hands of them that did the work, who were appointed over the house of Jehovah; and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders that wrought upon the house of Jehovah,

title: II Kings 12:12
text: and to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the breaches of the house of Jehovah, and for all that had to be laid out on the house for repairs.

title: II Kings 12:13
text: However there were not made for the house of Jehovah basons of silver, knives, bowls, trumpets, nor any utensil of gold or utensil of silver, of the money that was brought [into] the house of Jehovah;

title: II Kings 12:14
text: but they gave that to the workmen, and repaired the house of Jehovah with it.

title: II Kings 12:15
text: And they did not reckon with the men into whose hand they gave the money to be bestowed on workmen; for they dealt faithfully.

title: II Kings 12:16
text: The money of trespass-offerings, and the money of sin-offerings, was not brought into the house of Jehovah: it was for the priests.

title: II Kings 12:17
text: ¶Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it. And Hazael set his face to go up against Jerusalem.

title: II Kings 12:18
text: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold found in the treasures of the house of Jehovah and in the king's house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.

title: II Kings 12:19
text: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

title: II Kings 12:20
text: And his servants rose up and made a conspiracy, and smote Joash in the house of Millo, at the descent of Silla.

title: II Kings 12:21
text: And Jozachar the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Kings 13:1
text: ¶In the three-and-twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, for seventeen years.

title: II Kings 13:2
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin; he departed not from them.

title: II Kings 13:3
text: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-Hadad the son of Hazael, all those days.

title: II Kings 13:4
text: (And Jehoahaz besought Jehovah, and Jehovah hearkened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

title: II Kings 13:5
text: And Jehovah gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents as before.

title: II Kings 13:6
text: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel to sin: they walked therein; and there remained also the Asherah in Samaria.)

title: II Kings 13:7
text: For he had left of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

title: II Kings 13:8
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 13:9
text: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Kings 13:10
text: ¶In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, for sixteen years.

title: II Kings 13:11
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah; he departed not from any of the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin: he walked therein.

title: II Kings 13:12
text: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

title: II Kings 13:13
text: And Joash slept with his fathers, and Jeroboam sat upon his throne; and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

title: II Kings 13:14
text: And Elisha fell sick of his sickness in which he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over his face, and said, My father, my father! the chariot of Israel and the horsemen thereof!

title: II Kings 13:15
text: And Elisha said to him, Take bow and arrows. And he took a bow and arrows.

title: II Kings 13:16
text: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thy hand upon the bow. And he put his hand [upon it]; and Elisha put his hands upon the king's hands,

title: II Kings 13:17
text: and said, Open the window eastward. And he opened [it]. And Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, An arrow of Jehovah's deliverance, even an arrow of deliverance from the Syrians; and thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou hast consumed [them].

title: II Kings 13:18
text: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took [them]. And he said to the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.

title: II Kings 13:19
text: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then wouldest thou have smitten the Syrians till thou hadst consumed [them]; whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.

title: II Kings 13:20
text: ¶And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

title: II Kings 13:21
text: And it came to pass as they were burying a man, that behold, they saw the band, and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha; and the man went [down], and touched the bones of Elisha, and he revived, and stood upon his feet.

title: II Kings 13:22
text: And Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

title: II Kings 13:23
