title: I Chronicles 2:41
text: and Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.

title: I Chronicles 2:42
text: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

title: I Chronicles 2:43
text: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

title: I Chronicles 2:44
text: And Shema begot Raham, the father of Jorkeam. And Rekem begot Shammai;

title: I Chronicles 2:45
text: and the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

title: I Chronicles 2:46
text: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begot Gazez.

title: I Chronicles 2:47
text: And the sons of Jehdai: Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

title: I Chronicles 2:48
text: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah;

title: I Chronicles 2:49
text: and she bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

title: I Chronicles 2:50
text: These are the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah: Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,

title: I Chronicles 2:51
text: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

title: I Chronicles 2:52
text: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, Hazi-Hammenuhoth.

title: I Chronicles 2:53
text: And the families of Kirjath-jearim were the Jithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zoreathites and the Eshtaolites.

title: I Chronicles 2:54
text: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, and the Netophathites. Atroth-Beth-Joab, and the Hazi-Hammana-hethites, the Zorites;

title: I Chronicles 2:55
text: and the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez: the Tireathites, the Shimeathites, the Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

title: I Chronicles 3:1
text: ¶And these are the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jizreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

title: I Chronicles 3:2
text: the third, Absalom the son of Maachah, daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

title: I Chronicles 3:3
text: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah his wife:

title: I Chronicles 3:4
text: six were born to him in Hebron. And there he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.

title: I Chronicles 3:5
text: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;

title: I Chronicles 3:6
text: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

title: I Chronicles 3:7
text: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

title: I Chronicles 3:8
text: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine:

title: I Chronicles 3:9
text: all were sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

title: I Chronicles 3:10
text: ¶And Solomon's son was Rehoboam; Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

title: I Chronicles 3:11
text: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

title: I Chronicles 3:12
text: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

title: I Chronicles 3:13
text: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

title: I Chronicles 3:14
text: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

title: I Chronicles 3:15
text: And the sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

title: I Chronicles 3:16
text: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

title: I Chronicles 3:17
text: And the sons of Jeconiah: Assir; Salathiel his son,

title: I Chronicles 3:18
text: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

title: I Chronicles 3:19
text: And the sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister,

title: I Chronicles 3:20
text: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, [and] Jushab-hesed, five.

title: I Chronicles 3:21
text: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Isaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

title: I Chronicles 3:22
text: And the sons of Shechaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Jigeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

title: I Chronicles 3:23
text: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

title: I Chronicles 3:24
text: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

title: I Chronicles 4:1
text: ¶The sons of Judah: Pherez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

title: I Chronicles 4:2
text: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begot Jahath; and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zoreathites.

title: I Chronicles 4:3
text: And these [were of] the father of Etam: Jizreel, and Jishma, and Jidbash; and the name of their sister was Hazlelponi;

title: I Chronicles 4:4
text: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah: these were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, [and] father of Bethlehem.

title: I Chronicles 4:5
text: --And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

title: I Chronicles 4:6
text: And Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Ahashtari: these were the sons of Naarah.

title: I Chronicles 4:7
text: And the sons of Helah: Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.

title: I Chronicles 4:8
text: And Koz begot Anub, and Hazzobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

title: I Chronicles 4:9
text: And Jabez was more honoured than his brethren; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bore him with pain.

title: I Chronicles 4:10
text: And Jabez called on the God of Israel saying, Oh that thou wouldest richly bless me, and enlarge my border, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God brought about what he had requested.

title: I Chronicles 4:11
text: ¶And Chelub the brother of Shuah begot Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

title: I Chronicles 4:12
text: And Eshton begot Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of the city of Nahash: these were the men of Rechah.

title: I Chronicles 4:13
text: --And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.

title: I Chronicles 4:14
text: And Meonothai begot Ophrah: and Seraiah begot Joab, the father of the valley of craftsmen; for they were craftsmen.

title: I Chronicles 4:15
text: --And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah, ...and Kenaz.

title: I Chronicles 4:16
text: --And the sons of Jehalleleel: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asareel.

title: I Chronicles 4:17
text: --And the sons of Ezra: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon; and she conceived [and bore] Miriam, and Shammai, and Jishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

title: I Chronicles 4:18
text: And his wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took.

title: I Chronicles 4:19
text: --And the sons of the wife of Hodijah, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

title: I Chronicles 4:20
text: --And the sons of Shimon: Amnon and Rinnah, Ben-hanan and Tilon. --And the sons of Jishi: Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.

title: I Chronicles 4:21
text: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lechah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of byssus-workers, of the house of Ashbea,

title: I Chronicles 4:22
text: and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled over Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.

title: I Chronicles 4:23
text: These were the potters, and those that abode among plantations and enclosures: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

title: I Chronicles 4:24
text: ¶The sons of Simeon: Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, [and] Saul;

title: I Chronicles 4:25
text: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

title: I Chronicles 4:26
text: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son;

title: I Chronicles 4:27
text: and Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters. And his brethren had not many sons; neither did all their family multiply like to the sons of Judah.

title: I Chronicles 4:28
text: And they abode at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-Shual,

title: I Chronicles 4:29
text: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

title: I Chronicles 4:30
text: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

title: I Chronicles 4:31
text: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.

title: I Chronicles 4:32
text: And their villages were Etam and Ain, Rimmon and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

title: I Chronicles 4:33
text: and all their villages that were round about these cities, as far as Baal. These were their habitations and their genealogical register.

title: I Chronicles 4:34
text: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

title: I Chronicles 4:35
text: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

title: I Chronicles 4:36
text: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

title: I Chronicles 4:37
text: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah:

title: I Chronicles 4:38
text: these mentioned by name were princes in their families; and their fathers' houses increased greatly.

title: I Chronicles 4:39
text: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

title: I Chronicles 4:40
text: And they found fat and good pasture, and a land widely extended and quiet and fertile, for they who had dwelt there formerly were of Ham.

title: I Chronicles 4:41
text: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their stead; for there was pasture there for their flocks.

title: I Chronicles 4:42
text: And five hundred men of them, of the sons of Simeon, went to mount Seir, having at their head Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Jishi,

title: I Chronicles 4:43
text: and they smote the rest of the Amalekites that had escaped; and they dwelt there unto this day.

title: I Chronicles 5:1
text: ¶And the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn; but, inasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; but the genealogy is not registered according to the birthright,

title: I Chronicles 5:2
text: for Judah prevailed among his brethren, and of him was the prince, but the birthright was Joseph's),

title: I Chronicles 5:3
text: --the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Enoch and Phallu, Hezron and Carmi.

title: I Chronicles 5:4
text: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

title: I Chronicles 5:5
text: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

title: I Chronicles 5:6
text: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

title: I Chronicles 5:7
text: And his brethren by their families, in the genealogical register of their generations, were: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

title: I Chronicles 5:8
text: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon;

title: I Chronicles 5:9
text: and eastward he dwelt as far as the entrance to the wilderness from the river Euphrates; for their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

title: I Chronicles 5:10
text: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout the east side of Gilead.

title: I Chronicles 5:11
text: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan, as far as Salcah:

title: I Chronicles 5:12
text: Joel was the chief and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

title: I Chronicles 5:13
text: And their brethren according to their fathers' houses were Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jaachan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.

title: I Chronicles 5:14
text: --These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz:

title: I Chronicles 5:15
text: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was chief of their fathers' house.

title: I Chronicles 5:16
text: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the pasture-grounds of Sharon, as far as their limits.

title: I Chronicles 5:17
text: All these were registered by genealogy in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 5:18
text: ¶The children of Reuben and the Gadites and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men who carried shield and sword, drawing the bow and skilful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty, able to go forth to war.

title: I Chronicles 5:19
text: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab;

title: I Chronicles 5:20
text: and they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them, because they put their trust in him.

title: I Chronicles 5:21
text: And they took away their cattle: their camels fifty thousand, and two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, and two thousand asses, and a hundred thousand human souls.

title: I Chronicles 5:22
text: For there fell down many slain, for the war was of God. And they dwelt in their stead until the captivity.

title: I Chronicles 5:23
text: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land, from Bashan as far as Baal-Hermon and Senir, and mount Hermon; they were many.

title: I Chronicles 5:24
text: And these were the heads of their fathers' houses: Epher, and Jishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, heads of their fathers' houses.

title: I Chronicles 5:25
text: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

title: I Chronicles 5:26
text: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, --unto this day.

title: I Chronicles 6:1
text: ¶The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

title: I Chronicles 6:2
text: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Jizhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

title: I Chronicles 6:3
text: And the children of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

title: I Chronicles 6:4
text: Eleazar begot Phinehas; Phinehas begot Abishua,

title: I Chronicles 6:5
text: and Abishua begot Bukki, and Bukki begot Uzzi,

title: I Chronicles 6:6
text: and Uzzi begot Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begot Meraioth;

title: I Chronicles 6:7
text: Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,

title: I Chronicles 6:8
text: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz,

title: I Chronicles 6:9
text: and Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan,

title: I Chronicles 6:10
text: and Johanan begot Azariah (he is it that exercised the priesthood in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem);

title: I Chronicles 6:11
text: and Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub,

title: I Chronicles 6:12
text: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum,

title: I Chronicles 6:13
text: and Shallum begot Hilkijah, and Hilkijah begot Azariah,

title: I Chronicles 6:14
text: and Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Jehozadak,

title: I Chronicles 6:15
text: and Jehozadak went away, when Jehovah carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

title: I Chronicles 6:16
text: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

title: I Chronicles 6:17
text: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

title: I Chronicles 6:18
text: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Jizhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

title: I Chronicles 6:19
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of Levi according to their fathers.

title: I Chronicles 6:20
text: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:21
text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeathrai his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:22
text: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:23
text: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:24
text: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Saul his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:25
text: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

title: I Chronicles 6:26
text: Elkanah, --the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:27
text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:28
text: And the sons of Samuel: the firstborn Vashni and Abijah.

title: I Chronicles 6:29
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli; Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:30
text: Shimea his son, Haggijah his son, Asaiah his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:31
text: ¶And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of Jehovah after that the ark was in rest.

title: I Chronicles 6:32
text: And they ministered before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting with singing, until Solomon had built the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem; and they attended to their office according to their order.

title: I Chronicles 6:33
text: And these are they that attended, and their sons: Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

title: I Chronicles 6:34
text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

title: I Chronicles 6:35
text: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

title: I Chronicles 6:36
text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

title: I Chronicles 6:37
text: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

title: I Chronicles 6:38
text: the son of Jizhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 6:39
text: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand: Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

title: I Chronicles 6:40
text: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

title: I Chronicles 6:41
text: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

title: I Chronicles 6:42
text: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

title: I Chronicles 6:43
text: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

title: I Chronicles 6:44
text: And their brethren the sons of Merari were on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

title: I Chronicles 6:45
text: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkijah,

title: I Chronicles 6:46
text: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

title: I Chronicles 6:47
text: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

title: I Chronicles 6:48
text: And their brethren the Levites were given for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

title: I Chronicles 6:49
text: And Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt-offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

title: I Chronicles 6:50
text: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:51
text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:52
text: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

title: I Chronicles 6:53
text: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

title: I Chronicles 6:54
text: ¶And these are their dwelling-places according to their encampments, within their borders. For the sons of Aaron, of the family of the Kohathites, for theirs was the lot;

title: I Chronicles 6:55
text: and they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its suburbs round about it;

title: I Chronicles 6:56
text: but the fields of the city, and the hamlets thereof gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

title: I Chronicles 6:57
text: And to the children of Aaron they gave the city of refuge, Hebron; and Libnah and its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa and its suburbs,

title: I Chronicles 6:58
text: and Hilen and its suburbs, Debir and its suburbs,

title: I Chronicles 6:59
text: and Ashan and its suburbs, and Beth-shemesh and its suburbs;

title: I Chronicles 6:60
text: and, out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba and its suburbs, and Allemeth and its suburbs, and Anathoth and its suburbs: all their cities, thirteen cities, according to their families.

title: I Chronicles 6:61
text: And to the children of Kohath that remained [were given] by lot out of the families of the tribe [of Ephraim and of the tribe of Dan and] of the half tribe, half Manasseh, ten cities.

title: I Chronicles 6:62
text: And to the children of Gershom according to their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

title: I Chronicles 6:63
text: To the children of Merari [were given] by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

title: I Chronicles 6:64
text: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs.

title: I Chronicles 6:65
text: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which were mentioned by name.

title: I Chronicles 6:66
text: And to the families of the children of Kohath who had the cities of their territory out of the tribe of Ephraim,

title: I Chronicles 6:67
text: they gave the city of refuge, Shechem and its suburbs in mount Ephraim; and Gezer and its suburbs,

title: I Chronicles 6:68
text: and Jokmeam and its suburbs, and Beth-horon and its suburbs,

title: I Chronicles 6:69
text: and Ajalon and its suburbs, and Gath-Rimmon and its suburbs;

title: I Chronicles 6:70
text: and out of the half tribe of Manasseh: Aner and its suburbs, and Bileam and its suburbs, --for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

title: I Chronicles 6:71
text: To the children of Gershom [were given] out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and its suburbs, and Ashtaroth and its suburbs;

title: I Chronicles 6:72
text: and out of the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh and its suburbs, Dobrath and its suburbs,

title: I Chronicles 6:73
text: and Ramoth and its suburbs, and Anem and its suburbs;

title: I Chronicles 6:74
text: and out of the tribe of Asher: Mashal and its suburbs, and Abdon and its suburbs,

title: I Chronicles 6:75
text: and Hukok and its suburbs, and Rehob and its suburbs;

title: I Chronicles 6:76
text: and out of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its suburbs, and Hammon and its suburbs, and Kirjathaim and its suburbs.

title: I Chronicles 6:77
text: To the children of Merari that remained [were given] out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono and its suburbs, [and] Tabor and its suburbs;

title: I Chronicles 6:78
text: and on the other side of the Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness and its suburbs, and Jahzah and its suburbs,

title: I Chronicles 6:79
text: and Kedemoth and its suburbs, and Mephaath and its suburbs;

title: I Chronicles 6:80
text: and out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead and its suburbs, and Mahanaim and its suburbs,

title: I Chronicles 6:81
text: and Heshbon and its suburbs, and Jaazer and its suburbs.

title: I Chronicles 7:1
text: ¶And the sons of Issachar were Tola and Puah, Jashub and Shimron, four.

title: I Chronicles 7:2
text: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Samuel, heads of their fathers' houses, of Tola, valiant men of might in their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

title: I Chronicles 7:3
text: And the sons of Uzzi: Jizrahiah; and the sons of Jizrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, [and] Jishijah, five; all of them chief men.

title: I Chronicles 7:4
text: And with them by their generations, according to their fathers' houses, were military bands for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

title: I Chronicles 7:5
text: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar valiant men of might, registered by genealogy, in all eighty-seven thousand.

title: I Chronicles 7:6
text: [The sons of] Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

title: I Chronicles 7:7
text: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers' houses, mighty men of valour; and they were registered by their genealogy twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.

title: I Chronicles 7:8
text: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were the sons of Becher.

title: I Chronicles 7:9
text: And they were registered by their genealogy by their generations, heads of their fathers' houses, mighty men of valour, twenty thousand two hundred.

title: I Chronicles 7:10
text: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

title: I Chronicles 7:11
text: All these were the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, seventeen thousand two hundred, fit for service for war.

title: I Chronicles 7:12
text: And Shuppim, and Huppim, the children of Ir. --Hushim: the sons of Aher.

title: I Chronicles 7:13
text: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

title: I Chronicles 7:14
text: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, ...whom she bore; his Syrian concubine bore Machir the father of Gilead.

title: I Chronicles 7:15
text: And Machir took a wife [the sister] of Huppim and Shuppim, and the name of their sister was Maachah. And the name of the second [son] was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

title: I Chronicles 7:16
text: And Maachah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

title: I Chronicles 7:17
text: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

title: I Chronicles 7:18
text: And his sister Moleketh bore Ishhod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.

title: I Chronicles 7:19
text: And the sons of Shemidah were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

title: I Chronicles 7:20
text: ¶And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

title: I Chronicles 7:21
text: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elad. And the men of Gath born in the land slew them, because they came down to take their cattle.

title: I Chronicles 7:22
text: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

title: I Chronicles 7:23
text: And he went in to his wife; and she conceived, and bore a son; and he called his name Beriah, for [he was born] when calamity was in his house.

title: I Chronicles 7:24
text: And his daughter was Sheerah; and she built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.

title: I Chronicles 7:25
text: And his son was Rephah, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

title: I Chronicles 7:26
text: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

title: I Chronicles 7:27
text: Nun his son, Joshua his son.

title: I Chronicles 7:28
text: And their possession and dwelling-places were Bethel and its dependent villages, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer and its dependent villages, and Shechem and its dependent villages as far as to Gazah and its dependent villages.

title: I Chronicles 7:29
text: And in the hands of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its dependent villages, Taanach and its dependent villages, Megiddo and its dependent villages, Dor and its dependent villages. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 7:30
text: The sons of Asher: Jimnah, and Jishvah, and Jishvi, and Beriah; Serah their sister.

title: I Chronicles 7:31
text: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

title: I Chronicles 7:32
text: And Heber begot Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

title: I Chronicles 7:33
text: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath; these are the sons of Japhlet.

title: I Chronicles 7:34
text: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, and Hubbah, and Aram.

title: I Chronicles 7:35
text: And the sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, and Jimna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

title: I Chronicles 7:36
text: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Jimrah,

title: I Chronicles 7:37
text: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Jithran, and Beera.

title: I Chronicles 7:38
text: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

title: I Chronicles 7:39
text: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.

title: I Chronicles 7:40
text: All these were the sons of Asher, heads of fathers' houses, choice men, mighty of valour, chiefs of the princes. And their number according to their genealogy, registered as fit for service for war, was twenty-six thousand men.

title: I Chronicles 8:1
text: ¶And Benjamin begot Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

title: I Chronicles 8:2
text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

title: I Chronicles 8:3
text: And Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

title: I Chronicles 8:4
text: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

title: I Chronicles 8:5
text: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

title: I Chronicles 8:6
text: --And these are the sons of Ehud (these were the chief fathers of the inhabitants of Geba; and they carried them away to Manahath;

title: I Chronicles 8:7
text: even Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera; he removed them), and he begot Uzza and Ahihud.

title: I Chronicles 8:8
text: And Shaharaim begot [children] in the land of Moab after he had sent away Hushim and Baara his wives.

title: I Chronicles 8:9
text: And he begot of Hodesh his wife: Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

title: I Chronicles 8:10
text: and Jeuz, and Shobia, and Mirmah; these were his sons, chief fathers.

title: I Chronicles 8:11
text: And of Hushim he begot Abitub, and Elpaal.

title: I Chronicles 8:12
text: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemer, who built Ono, and Lod and its dependent villages;

title: I Chronicles 8:13
text: and Beriah, and Shema, who were chief fathers of the inhabitants of Ajalon; they drove away the inhabitants of Gath.

title: I Chronicles 8:14
text: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

title: I Chronicles 8:15
text: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,

title: I Chronicles 8:16
text: and Michael, and Jishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.

title: I Chronicles 8:17
text: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hiski, and Heber,

title: I Chronicles 8:18
text: and Jishmerai, and Jizliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.

title: I Chronicles 8:19
text: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

title: I Chronicles 8:20
text: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

title: I Chronicles 8:21
text: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.

title: I Chronicles 8:22
text: And Jishpah, and Eber, and Eliel,

title: I Chronicles 8:23
text: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

title: I Chronicles 8:24
text: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

title: I Chronicles 8:25
text: and Jiphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.

title: I Chronicles 8:26
text: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

title: I Chronicles 8:27
text: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.

title: I Chronicles 8:28
text: These were the chief fathers, according to their generations, principal men; these dwelt in Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 8:29
text: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; and his wife's name was Maachah.

title: I Chronicles 8:30
text: And his son, the firstborn, was Abdon; and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

title: I Chronicles 8:31
text: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.

title: I Chronicles 8:32
text: And Mikloth begot Shimeah. And these also dwelt beside their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.

title: I Chronicles 8:33
text: ¶And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

title: I Chronicles 8:34
text: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-Baal; and Merib-Baal begot Micah.

title: I Chronicles 8:35
text: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

title: I Chronicles 8:36
text: And Ahaz begot Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;

title: I Chronicles 8:37
text: and Moza begot Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

title: I Chronicles 8:38
text: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bochru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan; all these were sons of Azel.

title: I Chronicles 8:39
text: And the sons of Eshek his brother were Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

title: I Chronicles 8:40
text: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers; and they had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

title: I Chronicles 9:1
text: ¶And all Israel were registered by genealogy; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was carried away to Babylon because of their transgression.

title: I Chronicles 9:2
text: And the inhabitants that were first in their possessions in their cities were the Israelites, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.

title: I Chronicles 9:3
text: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh:

title: I Chronicles 9:4
text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pherez the son of Judah.

title: I Chronicles 9:5
text: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

title: I Chronicles 9:6
text: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel; and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

title: I Chronicles 9:7
text: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,

title: I Chronicles 9:8
text: and Jibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Jibnijah;

title: I Chronicles 9:9
text: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were chief fathers in their fathers' houses.

title: I Chronicles 9:10
text: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

title: I Chronicles 9:11
text: and Azariah the son of Hilkijah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

title: I Chronicles 9:12
text: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Masai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

title: I Chronicles 9:13
text: and their brethren, heads of their fathers' houses, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty; able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

title: I Chronicles 9:14
text: ¶And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

title: I Chronicles 9:15
text: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal; and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

title: I Chronicles 9:16
text: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

title: I Chronicles 9:17
text: And the doorkeepers: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren; Shallum was the chief.

title: I Chronicles 9:18
text: And they have been hitherto in the king's gate eastward: they were the doorkeepers in the camps of the children of Levi.

title: I Chronicles 9:19
text: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent, and their fathers, set over the camp of Jehovah, were keepers of the entrance.

title: I Chronicles 9:20
text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them formerly; Jehovah was with him.

title: I Chronicles 9:21
text: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was doorkeeper at the entrance to the tent of meeting.

title: I Chronicles 9:22
text: All these chosen to be doorkeepers at the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. These were registered by genealogy according to their villages: David and Samuel the seer had instituted them in their trust.

title: I Chronicles 9:23
text: And they and their sons were at the gates of the house of Jehovah, the house of the tent, to keep watch there.

title: I Chronicles 9:24
text: At the four quarters were the doorkeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

title: I Chronicles 9:25
text: And their brethren, in their villages, were to come after [every] seven days from time to time with them.

title: I Chronicles 9:26
text: For in their trust these four were the chief doorkeepers: they were Levites; and they were over the chambers and over the treasuries of the house of God;

title: I Chronicles 9:27
text: for they stayed round about the house of God during the night, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning [pertained] to them.

title: I Chronicles 9:28
text: And [part] of them had the charge of the instruments of service, for by number they brought them in and by number they brought them out.

title: I Chronicles 9:29
text: [Part] of them also were appointed over the vessels, and over all the holy instruments, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

title: I Chronicles 9:30
text: And it was [some one] of the sons of the priests who compounded the ointment of the spices.

title: I Chronicles 9:31
text: And Mattithiah of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was in trust over the things that were made in the pans.

title: I Chronicles 9:32
text: And [some] of the sons of the Kohathites, their brethren, were over the loaves to be set in rows, to prepare them every sabbath.

title: I Chronicles 9:33
text: And these were the singers, chief fathers of the Levites, [who were] in the chambers free from service; for they were employed day and night.

title: I Chronicles 9:34
text: These are the chief fathers of the Levites, heads according to their families; these dwelt in Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 9:35
text: ¶And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and his wife's name was Maachah.

title: I Chronicles 9:36
text: And his son, the firstborn, was Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

title: I Chronicles 9:37
text: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth;

title: I Chronicles 9:38
text: and Mikloth begot Shimeam. And they also dwelt beside their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.

title: I Chronicles 9:39
text: And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

title: I Chronicles 9:40
text: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-Baal; and Merib-Baal begot Micah.

title: I Chronicles 9:41
text: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea.

title: I Chronicles 9:42
text: And Ahaz begot Jarah: and Jarah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;

title: I Chronicles 9:43
text: and Moza begot Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

title: I Chronicles 9:44
text: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bochru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan; these were the sons of Azel.

title: I Chronicles 10:1
text: ¶And the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on mount Gilboa.

title: I Chronicles 10:2
text: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines smote Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul's sons.

title: I Chronicles 10:3
text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers came up with him, and he was terrified by the archers.

title: I Chronicles 10:4
text: Then said Saul to his armour-bearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through with it; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armour-bearer would not; for he was much afraid. So Saul took the sword and fell on it.

title: I Chronicles 10:5
text: And when his armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

title: I Chronicles 10:6
text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

title: I Chronicles 10:7
text: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their cities and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

title: I Chronicles 10:8
text: ¶And it came to pass the next day, that the Philistines came to strip the slain, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on mount Gilboa.

title: I Chronicles 10:9
text: And they stripped him, and took his head, and his armour, and sent [them] into the land of the Philistines round about, to announce the glad tidings to their idols, and to the people.

title: I Chronicles 10:10
text: And they put his armour in the house of their god, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

title: I Chronicles 10:11
text: And when all they of Jabesh-Gilead heard of all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

title: I Chronicles 10:12
text: all the valiant men arose, and took up the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the terebinth of Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

title: I Chronicles 10:13
text: And Saul died for his unfaithfulness which he committed against Jehovah, because of the word of Jehovah which he kept not, and also for having inquired of the spirit of Python, asking counsel of it;

title: I Chronicles 10:14
text: and he asked not counsel of Jehovah; therefore he slew him, and transferred the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.

title: I Chronicles 11:1
text: ¶And all Israel assembled themselves to David to Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

title: I Chronicles 11:2
text: Even aforetime, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel; and Jehovah thy God said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be prince over my people Israel.

title: I Chronicles 11:3
text: And all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Jehovah; and they anointed David king over Israel according to the word of Jehovah through Samuel.

title: I Chronicles 11:4
text: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

title: I Chronicles 11:5
text: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come in hither. But David took the stronghold of Zion, which is the city of David.

title: I Chronicles 11:6
text: And David said, Whoever smites the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. And Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

title: I Chronicles 11:7
text: And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.

title: I Chronicles 11:8
text: And he built the city round about, even from the Millo round about; and Joab renewed the rest of the city.

title: I Chronicles 11:9
text: And David became continually greater; and Jehovah of hosts was with him.

title: I Chronicles 11:10
text: ¶And these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who shewed themselves valiant with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of Jehovah concerning Israel.

title: I Chronicles 11:11
text: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of Hachmoni, the chief of the captains; he brandished his spear against three hundred, slain [by him] at one time.

title: I Chronicles 11:12
text: And after him, Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite; he was one of the three mighty men.

title: I Chronicles 11:13
text: He was with David at Pas-dammim, where the Philistines were gathered together to battle; and there was [there] a plot of ground full of barley; and the people had fled from before the Philistines.

title: I Chronicles 11:14
text: And they stood in the midst of the plot and delivered it, and smote the Philistines; and Jehovah wrought a great deliverance.

title: I Chronicles 11:15
text: And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, to the cave of Adullam, when the army of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

title: I Chronicles 11:16
text: And David was then in the stronghold; and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.

title: I Chronicles 11:17
text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me to drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is in the gate!

title: I Chronicles 11:18
text: And the three broke through the camp of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, which is in the gate, and took it, and brought it to David; David however would not drink of it, but poured it out to Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 11:19
text: And he said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing! should I drink the blood of these men [who went] at the risk of their lives? for at the risk of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.

title: I Chronicles 11:20
text: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was the chief of three; and he brandished his spear against three hundred and slew them; and he had a name among the three.

title: I Chronicles 11:21
text: Of the three he was more honourable than the two, and he was their captain; but he did not attain to the [first] three.

title: I Chronicles 11:22
text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, great in exploits, of Kabzeel: he it was that smote two lions of Moab; and he went down and smote a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.

title: I Chronicles 11:23
text: He also smote the Egyptian, a man of stature, five cubits high: and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

title: I Chronicles 11:24
text: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he had a name among the three mighty men.

title: I Chronicles 11:25
text: Behold, he was honoured above the thirty, but he did not attain to the [first] three. And David set him in his council.

title: I Chronicles 11:26
text: And the valiant men of the forces were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

title: I Chronicles 11:27
text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

title: I Chronicles 11:28
text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

title: I Chronicles 11:29
text: Sibbechai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

title: I Chronicles 11:30
text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

title: I Chronicles 11:31
text: Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

title: I Chronicles 11:32
text: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

title: I Chronicles 11:33
text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

title: I Chronicles 11:34
text: Bene-Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

title: I Chronicles 11:35
text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

title: I Chronicles 11:36
text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

title: I Chronicles 11:37
text: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

title: I Chronicles 11:38
text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

title: I Chronicles 11:39
text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armour-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

title: I Chronicles 11:40
text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

title: I Chronicles 11:41
text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

title: I Chronicles 11:42
text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him;

title: I Chronicles 11:43
text: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

title: I Chronicles 11:44
text: Uzzia the Ashtarothite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

title: I Chronicles 11:45
text: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

title: I Chronicles 11:46
text: Eliel of Mahavim, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Jithmah the Moabite,

title: I Chronicles 11:47
text: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

title: I Chronicles 12:1
text: ¶Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he kept still close because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men who helped him in the conflict;

title: I Chronicles 12:2
text: armed with bows, using both the right hand and the left with stones and with arrows on the bow; [they were] of Saul's brethren of Benjamin:

title: I Chronicles 12:3
text: the chief Ahiezer, and Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Anathothite,

title: I Chronicles 12:4
text: and Jishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite.

title: I Chronicles 12:5
text: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;

title: I Chronicles 12:6
text: Elkanah, and Jishijah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

title: I Chronicles 12:7
text: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

title: I Chronicles 12:8
text: And of the Gadites, there separated themselves to David in the stronghold in the wilderness mighty men of valour, men fit for the service of war, armed with shield and spear; whose faces were [like] the faces of lions, and who were swift as the gazelles upon the mountains:

title: I Chronicles 12:9
text: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

title: I Chronicles 12:10
text: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

title: I Chronicles 12:11
text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

title: I Chronicles 12:12
text: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

title: I Chronicles 12:13
text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.

title: I Chronicles 12:14
text: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over a hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

title: I Chronicles 12:15
text: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it overflows all its banks, and they put to flight all [them] of the valleys, toward the east and toward the west.

title: I Chronicles 12:16
text: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the stronghold to David.

title: I Chronicles 12:17
text: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If ye come peaceably to me to help me, my heart shall be knit unto you; but if to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, the God of our fathers see [it] and rebuke [it].

title: I Chronicles 12:18
text: And the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the captains, [and he said,] Thine [are we], David, And with thee, thou son of Jesse: Peace, peace be to thee! And peace be to thy helpers! For thy God helps thee. And David received them, and made them chiefs of bands.

title: I Chronicles 12:19
text: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not; for the lords of the Philistines upon deliberation sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul at the peril of our heads.

title: I Chronicles 12:20
text: As he went away to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh: Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

title: I Chronicles 12:21
text: And they helped David in his expeditions; for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

title: I Chronicles 12:22
text: For day by day there came [men] to David to help him, until it was a great camp, like the camp of God.

title: I Chronicles 12:23
text: ¶And this is the number of the men equipped for military service, who came to David to Hebron, to transfer the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 12:24
text: The children of Judah that bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, equipped for military service.

title: I Chronicles 12:25
text: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for war, seven thousand one hundred.

title: I Chronicles 12:26
text: Of the children of Levi four thousand six hundred.

title: I Chronicles 12:27
text: And Jehoiada the prince of Aaron, and with him were three thousand seven hundred;

title: I Chronicles 12:28
text: and Zadok, a valiant young man, and his father's house two and twenty chief men.

title: I Chronicles 12:29
text: And of the children of Benjamin, the brethren of Saul, three thousand; but hitherto the greater part of them had adhered to the house of Saul.

title: I Chronicles 12:30
text: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valour, men of name in their fathers' houses.

title: I Chronicles 12:31
text: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

title: I Chronicles 12:32
text: And of the children of Issachar, who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their bidding.

title: I Chronicles 12:33
text: Of Zebulun, such as went forth in the host, armed for war with all weapons of war, fifty thousand, keeping rank without double heart.

title: I Chronicles 12:34
text: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear.

title: I Chronicles 12:35
text: And of the Danites armed for war twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

title: I Chronicles 12:36
text: And of Asher such as went forth in the host, to set themselves in battle array, forty thousand.

title: I Chronicles 12:37
text: And from the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of weapons of war for battle, a hundred and twenty thousand.

title: I Chronicles 12:38
text: All of them men of war, keeping rank in battle array, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

title: I Chronicles 12:39
text: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brethren had prepared for them;

title: I Chronicles 12:40
text: and those too that were near them, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought food on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen; provisions of meal, fig-cakes and raisin-cakes, and wine and oil, and oxen and sheep, abundantly; for there was joy in Israel.

title: I Chronicles 13:1
text: ¶And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, with every prince.

title: I Chronicles 13:2
text: And David said to all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good to you, and it be of Jehovah our God, let us send abroad to our brethren everywhere, that are left in all the lands of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves to us;

title: I Chronicles 13:3
text: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us; for we inquired not of it in the days of Saul.

title: I Chronicles 13:4
text: And all the congregation said that they should do so; for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

title: I Chronicles 13:5
text: And David assembled all Israel from the Shihor of Egypt unto the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

title: I Chronicles 13:6
text: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, of Jehovah, who sitteth between the cherubim, whose name is placed [there].

title: I Chronicles 13:7
text: And they carried the ark of God on a new cart out of the house of Abinadab; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

title: I Chronicles 13:8
text: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with lutes, and with tambours, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

title: I Chronicles 13:9
text: ¶And when they came to the threshing-floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen had stumbled.

title: I Chronicles 13:10
text: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he had put forth his hand to the ark; and there he died before God.

title: I Chronicles 13:11
text: And David was indignant; for Jehovah had made a breach upon Uzza; and he called that place Perez-Uzza to this day.

title: I Chronicles 13:12
text: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God to me?

title: I Chronicles 13:13
text: And David brought not the ark home unto himself into the city of David, but he carried it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

title: I Chronicles 13:14
text: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months. And Jehovah blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that he had.

title: I Chronicles 14:1
text: ¶And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.

title: I Chronicles 14:2
text: And David perceived that Jehovah had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, because of his people Israel.

title: I Chronicles 14:3
text: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begot more sons and daughters.

title: I Chronicles 14:4
text: And these are the names of the children which he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

title: I Chronicles 14:5
text: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpelet,

title: I Chronicles 14:6
text: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

title: I Chronicles 14:7
text: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

title: I Chronicles 14:8
text: ¶And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, and all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard [of it], and went out against them.

title: I Chronicles 14:9
text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

title: I Chronicles 14:10
text: And David inquired of God saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines, and wilt thou give them into my hand? And Jehovah said to him, Go up; and I will give them into thy hand.

title: I Chronicles 14:11
text: And they came up to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there; and David said, God has broken in upon mine enemies by my hand, as the breaking forth of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

title: I Chronicles 14:12
text: And they left their gods there; and David commanded, and they were burned with fire.

title: I Chronicles 14:13
text: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves in the valley.

title: I Chronicles 14:14
text: And David inquired again of God; and God said to him, Go not up after them; turn round them and come upon them opposite the mulberry-trees.

title: I Chronicles 14:15
text: And it shall be, when thou hearest the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle; for God will have gone forth before thee to smite the army of the Philistines.

title: I Chronicles 14:16
text: And David did as God commanded him; and they smote the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

title: I Chronicles 14:17
text: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and Jehovah brought the fear of him upon all the nations.

title: I Chronicles 15:1
text: ¶And he made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and spread a tent for it.

title: I Chronicles 15:2
text: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites, for them has Jehovah chosen to carry the ark of God, and to serve him for ever.

title: I Chronicles 15:3
text: And David assembled all Israel to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Jehovah to its place that he had prepared for it.

title: I Chronicles 15:4
text: And David gathered the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

title: I Chronicles 15:5
text: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twenty;

title: I Chronicles 15:6
text: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty;

title: I Chronicles 15:7
text: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and thirty;

title: I Chronicles 15:8
text: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred;

title: I Chronicles 15:9
text: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brethren eighty;

title: I Chronicles 15:10
text: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twelve.

title: I Chronicles 15:11
text: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab;

title: I Chronicles 15:12
text: and he said to them, Ye are the chief fathers of the Levites; hallow yourselves, ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of Jehovah the God of Israel to [the place that] I have prepared for it.

title: I Chronicles 15:13
text: For because ye did [it] not at the first, Jehovah our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

title: I Chronicles 15:14
text: So the priests and the Levites hallowed themselves to bring up the ark of Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 15:15
text: And the children of the Levites bore the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves upon them, as Moses had commanded according to the word of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 15:16
text: And David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren, the singers, with instruments of music, lutes, and harps, and cymbals, that they should sound aloud, lifting up the voice with joy.

title: I Chronicles 15:17
text: And the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

title: I Chronicles 15:18
text: and with them their brethren of the second [rank], Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers;

title: I Chronicles 15:19
text: and the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, to sound aloud with cymbals of brass;

title: I Chronicles 15:20
text: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with lutes on Alamoth;

title: I Chronicles 15:21
text: and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to lead [the singing].

title: I Chronicles 15:22
text: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites for the music, gave instruction in music, for he was skilful.

title: I Chronicles 15:23
text: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

title: I Chronicles 15:24
text: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew with the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehijah were doorkeepers for the ark.

title: I Chronicles 15:25
text: ¶And David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

title: I Chronicles 15:26
text: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bore the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, that they sacrificed seven bullocks and seven rams.

title: I Chronicles 15:27
text: And David was clothed with a robe of byssus, and all the Levites that bore the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah chief of the music of the singers; and David had upon him a linen ephod.

title: I Chronicles 15:28
text: And all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah with shouting, and with sound of the trumpet, and with clarions, and with cymbals, playing aloud with lutes and harps.

title: I Chronicles 15:29
text: And it came to pass as the ark of the covenant of Jehovah came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked through a window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

title: I Chronicles 16:1
text: ¶And they brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had spread for it; and they presented burnt-offerings and peace-offerings before God.

title: I Chronicles 16:2
text: And when David had ended offering up the burnt-offerings and the peace-offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 16:3
text: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread and a measure [of wine] and a raisin-cake.

title: I Chronicles 16:4
text: And he appointed certain of the Levites to do the service before the ark of Jehovah, and to celebrate, and to thank and praise Jehovah the God of Israel:

title: I Chronicles 16:5
text: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with instruments of lutes and with harps; and Asaph sounding with cymbals;

title: I Chronicles 16:6
text: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

title: I Chronicles 16:7
text: ¶Then on that day David delivered first [this psalm] to give thanks to Jehovah through Asaph and his brethren.

title: I Chronicles 16:8
text: Give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known his acts among the peoples.

title: I Chronicles 16:9
text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him; Meditate upon all his wondrous works.

title: I Chronicles 16:10
text: Glory in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 16:11
text: Seek Jehovah and his strength, Seek his face continually;

title: I Chronicles 16:12
text: Remember his wondrous works which he hath done; His miracles, and the judgments of his mouth:

title: I Chronicles 16:13
text: Ye seed of Israel his servant, Ye sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

title: I Chronicles 16:14
text: He, Jehovah, is our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

title: I Chronicles 16:15
text: Be ye ever mindful of his covenant, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations, --

title: I Chronicles 16:16
text: Which he made with Abraham, And of his oath unto Isaac;

title: I Chronicles 16:17
text: And he confirmed it unto Jacob for a statute, Unto Israel for an everlasting covenant,

title: I Chronicles 16:18
text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;

title: I Chronicles 16:19
text: When ye were a few men in number, Of small account, and strangers in it.

title: I Chronicles 16:20
text: And they went from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people.

title: I Chronicles 16:21
text: He suffered no man to oppress them, And reproved kings for their sakes,

title: I Chronicles 16:22
text: [Saying,] Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.

title: I Chronicles 16:23
text: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth; Publish his salvation from day to day.

title: I Chronicles 16:24
text: Declare his glory among the nations, His wondrous works among all peoples.

title: I Chronicles 16:25
text: For Jehovah is great, and exceedingly to be praised; And he is terrible above all gods.

title: I Chronicles 16:26
text: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.

title: I Chronicles 16:27
text: Majesty and splendour are before him; Strength and gladness in his place.

title: I Chronicles 16:28
text: Give unto Jehovah, ye families of peoples, Give unto Jehovah glory and strength!

title: I Chronicles 16:29
text: Give unto Jehovah the glory of his name! Bring an oblation, and come before him: Worship Jehovah in holy splendour.

title: I Chronicles 16:30
text: Tremble before him, all the earth: The world also is established, it shall not be moved.

title: I Chronicles 16:31
text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; And let them say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth!

title: I Chronicles 16:32
text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; Let the field exult, and all that is therein.

title: I Chronicles 16:33
text: Then shall the trees of the forest sing out at the presence of Jehovah, For he cometh to judge the earth.

title: I Chronicles 16:34
text: Give thanks unto Jehovah, for he is good; For his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: I Chronicles 16:35
text: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us, and deliver us from the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, To triumph in thy praise.

title: I Chronicles 16:36
text: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, from eternity and to eternity! And all the people said, Amen! and praised Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 16:37
text: ¶And he left there, before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, Asaph and his brethren, to do the service before the ark continually, as every day's duty required;

title: I Chronicles 16:38
text: and Obed-Edom, and their brethren, sixty-eight; Obed-Edom also, the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah as doorkeepers.

title: I Chronicles 16:39
text: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of Jehovah in the high place that was at Gibeon,

title: I Chronicles 16:40
text: to offer up burnt-offerings to Jehovah on the altar of burnt-offering continually, morning and evening, and according to all that is written in the law of Jehovah, which he commanded Israel;

title: I Chronicles 16:41
text: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to Jehovah, because his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever;

title: I Chronicles 16:42
text: and with them, [with] Heman and Jeduthun, trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud; and the musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were at the gate.

title: I Chronicles 16:43
text: And all the people departed every one to his house; and David returned to bless his household.

title: I Chronicles 17:1
text: ¶And it came to pass as David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Behold, I dwell in a house of cedars, and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah under curtains.

title: I Chronicles 17:2
text: And Nathan said to David, Do all that is in thy heart; for God is with thee.

title: I Chronicles 17:3
text: And it came to pass that night that the word of God came to Nathan saying,

title: I Chronicles 17:4
text: Go and say to David my servant, Thus saith Jehovah: Thou shalt not build me a house to dwell in;

title: I Chronicles 17:5
text: for I have not dwelt in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day; but I have been from tent to tent, and from [one] tabernacle [to another].

title: I Chronicles 17:6
text: In all my going about with all Israel, did I speak a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why build ye me not a house of cedars?

title: I Chronicles 17:7
text: And now, thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: I took thee from the pasture-grounds, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel;

title: I Chronicles 17:8
text: and I have been with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name, like unto the name of the great men that are on the earth.

title: I Chronicles 17:9
text: And I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and be disturbed no more; neither shall the sons of wickedness waste them any more, as formerly,

title: I Chronicles 17:10
text: and since the days that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. And I will subdue all thine enemies; and I tell thee that Jehovah will build thee a house.

title: I Chronicles 17:11
text: And it shall come to pass, when thy days are fulfilled that thou must go [to be] with thy fathers, that I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

title: I Chronicles 17:12
text: It is he who shall build me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.

title: I Chronicles 17:13
text: I will be his father, and he shall be my son; and I will not take away my mercy from him, as I took it from him that was before thee;

title: I Chronicles 17:14
text: and I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom for ever; and his throne shall be established for ever.

title: I Chronicles 17:15
text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak to David.

title: I Chronicles 17:16
text: ¶And king David went in and sat before Jehovah, and said, Who am I, Jehovah Elohim, and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

title: I Chronicles 17:17
text: And this hath been a small thing in thy sight, O God; and thou hast spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree, Jehovah Elohim.

title: I Chronicles 17:18
text: What can David [say] more to thee for the glory of thy servant? thou indeed knowest thy servant.

title: I Chronicles 17:19
text: Jehovah, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

title: I Chronicles 17:20
text: Jehovah, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

title: I Chronicles 17:21
text: And who is like thy people Israel, the one nation in the earth that God went to redeem to be a people to himself, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, which thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

title: I Chronicles 17:22
text: And thy people Israel hast thou made thine own people for ever; and thou, Jehovah, art become their God.

title: I Chronicles 17:23
text: And now, Jehovah, let the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

title: I Chronicles 17:24
text: Let it even be established, and let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, is God to Israel; and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

title: I Chronicles 17:25
text: For thou, my God, hast revealed to thy servant that thou wilt build him a house; therefore hath thy servant found [in his heart] to pray before thee.

title: I Chronicles 17:26
text: And now, Jehovah, thou art that God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant;

title: I Chronicles 17:27
text: and now, let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever; for thou, Jehovah, hast blessed [it], and it shall be blessed for ever.

title: I Chronicles 18:1
text: ¶And after this it came to pass that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

title: I Chronicles 18:2
text: And he smote the Moabites; and the Moabites became David's servants, [and] brought gifts.

title: I Chronicles 18:3
text: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah, at Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

title: I Chronicles 18:4
text: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David houghed all the chariot [horses], but reserved of them [for] a hundred chariots.

title: I Chronicles 18:5
text: And the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, and David smote of the Syrians twenty-two thousand men.

title: I Chronicles 18:6
text: And David put [garrisons] in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, [and] brought gifts. And Jehovah preserved David whithersoever he went.

title: I Chronicles 18:7
text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 18:8
text: And from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, David took very much brass, of which Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

title: I Chronicles 18:9
text: ¶And Tou king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the forces of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

title: I Chronicles 18:10
text: and he sent Hadoram his son to king David to inquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer and smitten him; for Hadarezer was continually at war with Tou; [he sent] also all manner of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

title: I Chronicles 18:11
text: Them also king David dedicated to Jehovah, with the silver and the gold that he had brought from all the nations: from the Edomites, and from the Moabites, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from the Amalekites.

title: I Chronicles 18:12
text: And Abishai the son of Zeruiah smote of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

title: I Chronicles 18:13
