text: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all they of Edom became servants to David. And Jehovah preserved David whithersoever he went.

title: I Chronicles 18:14
text: And David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice to all his people.

title: I Chronicles 18:15
text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was chronicler;

title: I Chronicles 18:16
text: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

title: I Chronicles 18:17
text: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were the first at the king's hand.

title: I Chronicles 19:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after this that Nahash king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Chronicles 19:2
text: And David said, I will shew kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

title: I Chronicles 19:3
text: And the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Is it, in thine eyes, to honour thy father that David has sent comforters to thee? Is it not to search and overthrow, and to spy out the land that his servants are come to thee?

title: I Chronicles 19:4
text: And Hanun took David's servants, and had them shaved, and their raiment cut off in the midst, as far as the hip, and sent them away.

title: I Chronicles 19:5
text: And [certain] went and told David concerning the men; and he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Abide at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

title: I Chronicles 19:6
text: ¶And the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David; and Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and from the Syrians of Maacah, and from Zobah.

title: I Chronicles 19:7
text: And they hired thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people; and they came and encamped before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered together from their cities, and came to battle.

title: I Chronicles 19:8
text: And David heard [of it], and he sent Joab, and all the host, the mighty men.

title: I Chronicles 19:9
text: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the city; and the kings that had come were by themselves on the field.

title: I Chronicles 19:10
text: And Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind; and he chose out of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians;

title: I Chronicles 19:11
text: and the rest of the people he gave into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

title: I Chronicles 19:12
text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me; and if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

title: I Chronicles 19:13
text: Be strong, and let us shew ourselves valiant for our people, and for the cities of our God; and Jehovah will do what is good in his sight.

title: I Chronicles 19:14
text: And Joab and the people that were with him drew near in front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

title: I Chronicles 19:15
text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. And Joab came to Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 19:16
text: And when the Syrians saw that they were routed before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river; and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer [went] before them.

title: I Chronicles 19:17
text: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over the Jordan, and came upon them, and set [the battle] in array against them. And David put the battle in array against the Syrians, and they fought with him.

title: I Chronicles 19:18
text: And the Syrians fled from before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand [in] chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and slew Shophach the captain of the host.

title: I Chronicles 19:19
text: And the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were routed before Israel, and they made peace with David, and became his servants. And the Syrians would no more help the children of Ammon.

title: I Chronicles 20:1
text: ¶And it came to pass at the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go forth, that Joab led forth the power of the army, and laid waste the land of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David abode at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and overthrew it.

title: I Chronicles 20:2
text: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was [set] upon David's head: and he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

title: I Chronicles 20:3
text: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with the saw, and with harrows of iron, and with saws. And so David did to all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 20:4
text: ¶And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; then Sibbechai the Hushathite smote Sippai, one of the children of Rapha; and they were subdued.

title: I Chronicles 20:5
text: And there was again a battle with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair smote Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite; now the shaft of his spear was like a weaver's beam.

title: I Chronicles 20:6
text: And there was again a battle, at Gath; and there was a man [there] of great stature, whose fingers [and toes] were four and twenty, six [on each hand], and six [on each foot]; and he also was born to Rapha.

title: I Chronicles 20:7
text: And he defied Israel; but Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother smote him.

title: I Chronicles 20:8
text: These were born to Rapha in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

title: I Chronicles 21:1
text: ¶And Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.

title: I Chronicles 21:2
text: And David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.

title: I Chronicles 21:3
text: And Joab said, Jehovah add to his people, how many soever they be, a hundredfold: are they not all, my lord O king, my lord's servants? why does my lord require this thing? why should he become a trespass to Israel?

title: I Chronicles 21:4
text: But the king's word prevailed against Joab; and Joab departed, and went through all Israel, and came [again] to Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 21:5
text: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to David. And all they of Israel were eleven hundred thousand men that drew sword; and of Judah, four hundred and seventy thousand men that drew sword.

title: I Chronicles 21:6
text: But Levi and Benjamin he did not count among them; for the king's word was abominable to Joab.

title: I Chronicles 21:7
text: ¶And God was displeased on account of this thing, and he smote Israel.

title: I Chronicles 21:8
text: And David said to God, I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing; and now, I beseech thee, put away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

title: I Chronicles 21:9
text: And Jehovah spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying,

title: I Chronicles 21:10
text: Go and speak to David saying, Thus saith Jehovah: I offer thee three [things]; choose one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

title: I Chronicles 21:11
text: And Gad came to David, and said to him, Thus saith Jehovah:

title: I Chronicles 21:12
text: Choose thee, either three years of famine, or three months to be destroyed before thine adversaries while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee, or three days the sword of Jehovah and the pestilence in the land, and the angel of Jehovah destroying through all the borders of Israel. And now consider what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

title: I Chronicles 21:13
text: And David said to Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall, I pray thee, into the hand of Jehovah, for his mercies are very great; but let me not fall into the hand of man.

title: I Chronicles 21:14
text: And Jehovah sent a pestilence upon Israel; and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

title: I Chronicles 21:15
text: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it; and as he was destroying, Jehovah beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough; withdraw now thine hand. And the angel of Jehovah stood by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

title: I Chronicles 21:16
text: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of Jehovah stand between the earth and the heavens, and his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem. And David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

title: I Chronicles 21:17
text: And David said to God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? It is I that have sinned and done evil; but these sheep, what have they done? Let thy hand, I pray thee, Jehovah my God, be on me and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be smitten.

title: I Chronicles 21:18
text: ¶And the angel of Jehovah commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up and rear an altar to Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

title: I Chronicles 21:19
text: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he had spoken in the name of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 21:20
text: And Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

title: I Chronicles 21:21
text: And David came to Ornan, and Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing-floor, and bowed himself to David with [his] face to the ground.

title: I Chronicles 21:22
text: And David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of the threshing-floor, that I may build an altar in it to Jehovah: grant it to me for the full money, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

title: I Chronicles 21:23
text: And Ornan said to David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his sight: see, I give the oxen for the burnt-offering, and the threshing-sledges for wood, and the wheat for the oblation; I give it all.

title: I Chronicles 21:24
text: And king David said to Ornan, No; but I will in any case buy [them] for the full money; for I will not take that which is thine for Jehovah, to offer up a burnt-offering without cost.

title: I Chronicles 21:25
text: And David gave to Ornan for the place in shekels of gold the weight of six hundred [shekels].

title: I Chronicles 21:26
text: And David built there an altar to Jehovah, and offered up burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and called upon Jehovah; and he answered him from the heavens by fire upon the altar of burnt-offering.

title: I Chronicles 21:27
text: And Jehovah spoke to the angel; and he put up his sword again into its sheath.

title: I Chronicles 21:28
text: At that time when David saw that Jehovah had answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

title: I Chronicles 21:29
text: And the tabernacle of Jehovah, which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt-offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

title: I Chronicles 21:30
text: But David could not go before it to inquire of God; for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 22:1
text: ¶And David said, This is the house of Jehovah Elohim, and this is the altar of burnt-offering for Israel.

title: I Chronicles 22:2
text: And David commanded to collect the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

title: I Chronicles 22:3
text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joists, and brass in abundance without weight;

title: I Chronicles 22:4
text: and cedar-trees innumerable; for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought cedar-wood in abundance to David.

title: I Chronicles 22:5
text: For David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Jehovah must be exceeding great in fame and in beauty in all lands: I will therefore make preparation for it. And David prepared abundantly before his death.

title: I Chronicles 22:6
text: ¶And he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 22:7
text: And David said to Solomon, As for me, my son, I was minded to build a house unto the name of Jehovah my God.

title: I Chronicles 22:8
text: But the word of Jehovah came to me saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build a house unto my name, for thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

title: I Chronicles 22:9
text: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about; for his name shall be Solomon, and in his days I will give peace and quietness unto Israel.

title: I Chronicles 22:10
text: He shall build a house unto my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

title: I Chronicles 22:11
text: Now, my son, Jehovah be with thee, that thou mayest prosper, and build the house of Jehovah thy God, as he has said of thee.

title: I Chronicles 22:12
text: Only, Jehovah give thee wisdom and understanding, and place thee over Israel, and to keep the law of Jehovah thy God.

title: I Chronicles 22:13
text: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to perform the statutes and ordinances which Jehovah commanded Moses for Israel: be strong and courageous; fear not, neither be dismayed.

title: I Chronicles 22:14
text: And behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the house of Jehovah a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight, for it is in abundance; and timber and stone have I prepared; and thou shalt add to it.

title: I Chronicles 22:15
text: And there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of skilful men for every kind of work.

title: I Chronicles 22:16
text: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing and Jehovah be with thee.

title: I Chronicles 22:17
text: ¶And David commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, [saying,]

title: I Chronicles 22:18
text: Is not Jehovah your God with you? and has he [not] given you rest on every side? for he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Jehovah, and before his people.

title: I Chronicles 22:19
text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek Jehovah your God; and arise and build the sanctuary of Jehovah Elohim, to bring the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and the vessels of the sanctuary of God into the house that is to be built unto the name of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 23:1
text: ¶And David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

title: I Chronicles 23:2
text: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

title: I Chronicles 23:3
text: And the Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward; and their number, by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

title: I Chronicles 23:4
text: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to preside over the work of the house of Jehovah; and six thousand were officers and judges;

title: I Chronicles 23:5
text: and four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised Jehovah with the instruments which I made, [said David,] to praise [therewith].

title: I Chronicles 23:6
text: And David divided them into courses according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

title: I Chronicles 23:7
text: Of the Gershonites: Laadan and Shimei.

title: I Chronicles 23:8
text: The sons of Laadan: the head was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

title: I Chronicles 23:9
text: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief fathers of Laadan.

title: I Chronicles 23:10
text: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Ziza, and Jeush, and Beriah. These were the four sons of Shimei.

title: I Chronicles 23:11
text: And Jahath was the head, and Ziza the second; and Jeush and Beriah had not many sons: as father's house, therefore, they were reckoned as one.

title: I Chronicles 23:12
text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Jizhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

title: I Chronicles 23:13
text: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was separated, that he should be hallowed as most holy, he and his sons for ever, to offer before Jehovah, to do service to him, and to bless in his name for ever.

title: I Chronicles 23:14
text: --And as to Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

title: I Chronicles 23:15
text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

title: I Chronicles 23:16
text: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the head.

title: I Chronicles 23:17
text: And the sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the head; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

title: I Chronicles 23:18
text: --The sons of Jizhar: Shelomith the head.

title: I Chronicles 23:19
text: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the head, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

title: I Chronicles 23:20
text: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the head, and Jishijah the second.

title: I Chronicles 23:21
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

title: I Chronicles 23:22
text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters; and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

title: I Chronicles 23:23
text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

title: I Chronicles 23:24
text: ¶These were the sons of Levi according to their fathers' houses, the chief fathers, as they were reckoned, by number of names by their polls, who did the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, from twenty years old and upward.

title: I Chronicles 23:25
text: For David said, Jehovah the God of Israel has given rest to his people, and he will dwell in Jerusalem for ever;

title: I Chronicles 23:26
text: and the Levites also have no more to carry the tabernacle, nor any of its vessels for its service.

title: I Chronicles 23:27
text: For by the last words of David was this [done], --the numbering of the sons of Levi from twenty years old and upward.

title: I Chronicles 23:28
text: For their place was by the side of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of Jehovah, over the courts, and over the chambers, and over the purifying of all holy things, and [for] the work of the service of the house of God;

title: I Chronicles 23:29
text: and for the loaves to be set in rows, and for the fine flour for the oblation, and for the unleavened cakes, and for [what is baked in] the pan, and for that which is saturated [with oil], and for all measure of capacity and size;

title: I Chronicles 23:30
text: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Jehovah, and likewise at even;

title: I Chronicles 23:31
text: and for all burnt-offerings offered up to Jehovah on the sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the ordinance concerning them, continually, before Jehovah;

title: I Chronicles 23:32
text: and they kept the charge of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 24:1
text: ¶And the divisions of the sons of Aaron: the sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

title: I Chronicles 24:2
text: And Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar exercised the priesthood.

title: I Chronicles 24:3
text: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their office in their service.

title: I Chronicles 24:4
text: And there were more head-men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and [thus] were they divided: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen heads of fathers' houses, and eight of the sons of Ithamar according to their fathers' houses.

title: I Chronicles 24:5
text: And they were divided by lot, one with another; for the princes of the sanctuary and the princes of God were of the sons of Eleazar and of the sons of Ithamar.

title: I Chronicles 24:6
text: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, [one] of the Levites, inscribed them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the chief fathers of the priests and Levites: one father's house was drawn for Eleazar, and one drawn for Ithamar.

title: I Chronicles 24:7
text: And the first lot came forth for Jehoiarib, the second for Jedaiah,

title: I Chronicles 24:8
text: the third for Harim, the fourth for Seorim,

title: I Chronicles 24:9
text: the fifth for Malchijah, the sixth for Mijamin,

title: I Chronicles 24:10
text: the seventh for Hakkoz, the eighth for Abijah,

title: I Chronicles 24:11
text: the ninth for Jeshuah, the tenth for Shecaniah,

title: I Chronicles 24:12
text: the eleventh for Eliashib, the twelfth for Jakim,

title: I Chronicles 24:13
text: the thirteenth for Huppah, the fourteenth for Jeshebeab,

title: I Chronicles 24:14
text: the fifteenth for Bilgah, the sixteenth for Immer,

title: I Chronicles 24:15
text: the seventeenth for Hezir, the eighteenth for Happizez,

title: I Chronicles 24:16
text: the nineteenth for Pethahiah, the twentieth for Ezekiel,

title: I Chronicles 24:17
text: the twenty-first for Jachin, the twenty-second for Gamul,

title: I Chronicles 24:18
text: the twenty-third for Delaiah, the twenty-fourth for Maaziah.

title: I Chronicles 24:19
text: This is their ordering in their service to come into the house of Jehovah, according to their ordinance, through Aaron their father, as Jehovah the God of Israel had commanded him.

title: I Chronicles 24:20
text: ¶And as for the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

title: I Chronicles 24:21
text: Of Rehabiah, of the sons of Rehabiah, the head was Jishijah.

title: I Chronicles 24:22
text: Of the Jizharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

title: I Chronicles 24:23
text: --And the sons [of Hebron]: Jerijah [the head], Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

title: I Chronicles 24:24
text: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir;

title: I Chronicles 24:25
text: the brother of Micah was Jishijah; of the sons of Jishijah, Zechariah.

title: I Chronicles 24:26
text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, his son.

title: I Chronicles 24:27
text: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah his son: Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

title: I Chronicles 24:28
text: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

title: I Chronicles 24:29
text: Of Kish, the sons of Kish: Jerahmeel.

title: I Chronicles 24:30
text: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.

title: I Chronicles 24:31
text: These likewise cast lots just as their brethren the sons of Aaron before David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief fathers of the priests and Levites, --the chief fathers just as the youngest of their brethren.

title: I Chronicles 25:1
text: ¶And David and the captains of the host separated for the service those of the sons of Asaph and of Heman and of Jeduthun who were to prophesy with harps and lutes and cymbals; and the number of the men employed according to their service was:

title: I Chronicles 25:2
text: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asharelah, the sons of Asaph under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied at the direction of the king.

title: I Chronicles 25:3
text: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Isaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, [and Shimei] six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the harp, to give thanks and to praise Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 25:4
text: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkijah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth:

title: I Chronicles 25:5
text: all these were sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to exalt his power; and God had given to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

title: I Chronicles 25:6
text: All these were under the direction of their fathers Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman, for song in the house of Jehovah, with cymbals, lutes and harps, for the service of the house of God, under the direction of the king.

title: I Chronicles 25:7
text: And the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of Jehovah, all of them skilful, was two hundred and eighty-eight.

title: I Chronicles 25:8
text: ¶And they cast lots with one another over the charges, the small as well as the great, the teacher with the scholar.

title: I Chronicles 25:9
text: And the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph; to Gedaliah the second: he and his brethren and his sons were twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:10
text: The third to Zaccur; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:11
text: The fourth to Jizri; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:12
text: The fifth to Nethaniah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:13
text: The sixth to Bukkijah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:14
text: The seventh to Jesharelah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:15
text: The eighth to Isaiah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:16
text: The ninth to Mattaniah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:17
text: The tenth to Shimei; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:18
text: The eleventh to Azareel; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:19
text: The twelfth to Hashabiah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:20
text: The thirteenth to Shubael; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:21
text: The fourteenth to Mattithiah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:22
text: The fifteenth to Jeremoth; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:23
text: The sixteenth to Hananiah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:24
text: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:25
text: The eighteenth to Hanani; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:26
text: The nineteenth to Mallothi; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:27
text: The twentieth to Elijathah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:28
text: The twenty-first to Hothir; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:29
text: The twenty-second to Giddalti; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:30
text: The twenty-third to Mahazioth; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 25:31
text: The twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer; his sons and his brethren, twelve.

title: I Chronicles 26:1
text: ¶The divisions of the doorkeepers. Of the Korahites: Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

title: I Chronicles 26:2
text: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

title: I Chronicles 26:3
text: Elam the fifth, Johanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

title: I Chronicles 26:4
text: --And the sons of Obed-Edom: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

title: I Chronicles 26:5
text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God had blessed him.

title: I Chronicles 26:6
text: And to Shemaiah his son were sons born, who were rulers in their father's house; for they were mighty men of valour.

title: I Chronicles 26:7
text: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, [and] Elzabad, whose brethren were valiant men, Elihu and Semachiah.

title: I Chronicles 26:8
text: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men in strength for the service, were sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

title: I Chronicles 26:9
text: --And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, men of valour, eighteen.

title: I Chronicles 26:10
text: --And Hosah, of the sons of Merari, had sons: Shimri the head, for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the head;

title: I Chronicles 26:11
text: Hilkijah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

title: I Chronicles 26:12
text: Among these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, among the head-men, as to the charges together with their brethren, for performing the service in the house of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 26:13
text: And they cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers' houses, for every gate.

title: I Chronicles 26:14
text: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah; and they cast lots for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, and his lot came out northward;

title: I Chronicles 26:15
text: to Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

title: I Chronicles 26:16
text: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the ascent, watch against watch.

title: I Chronicles 26:17
text: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and in the storehouse two [and] two.

title: I Chronicles 26:18
text: At the portico westward, four at the causeway, two at the portico.

title: I Chronicles 26:19
text: These are the divisions of the doorkeepers among the sons of the Korahites and among the sons of Merari.

title: I Chronicles 26:20
text: ¶And the Levites: Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

title: I Chronicles 26:21
text: The sons of Laadan, the sons of the Gershonites of Laadan, chief fathers of Laadan the Gershonite: Jehieli;

title: I Chronicles 26:22
text: the sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the house of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 26:23
text: As to the Amramites, the Jizharites, the Hebronites, the Uzzielites....

title: I Chronicles 26:24
text: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was overseer of the treasures.

title: I Chronicles 26:25
text: And his brethren, of Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, and Isaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

title: I Chronicles 26:26
text: This Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which king David, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated

title: I Chronicles 26:27
text: (from the wars and out of the spoils had they dedicated [them], to maintain the house of Jehovah),

title: I Chronicles 26:28
text: and all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated: all that was dedicated was under the hand of Shelomith and of his brethren.

title: I Chronicles 26:29
text: ¶Of the Jizharites, Chenaniah and his sons were over Israel, for the outward business for officers and judges.

title: I Chronicles 26:30
text: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, for the administration of Israel on this side Jordan westward, for all the business of Jehovah, and for the service of the king.

title: I Chronicles 26:31
text: Of the Hebronites was Jerijah the head; (as to the Hebronites, according to their families according to the fathers: in the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jaazer in Gilead;)

title: I Chronicles 26:32
text: and his brethren, men of valour, two thousand seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God, and the affairs of the king.

title: I Chronicles 27:1
text: ¶And [these] are the children of Israel after their number, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in every matter of the divisions, which came in and went out month by month throughout the months of the year; in every division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:2
text: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:3
text: He was of the children of Pherez, the head of all the captains of the hosts for the first month.

title: I Chronicles 27:4
text: And over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite; and in his division was Mikloth ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:5
text: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah (the son of Jehoiada, a principal officer): [he was] head; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:6
text: This Benaiah was a mighty man among the thirty, and above the thirty; and in his division was Ammizabad his son.

title: I Chronicles 27:7
text: The fourth for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:8
text: The fifth for the fifth month was the captain Shamhuth the Jizrahite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:9
text: The sixth for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:10
text: The seventh for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:11
text: The eighth for the eighth month was Sibbechai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:12
text: The ninth for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjaminites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:13
text: The tenth for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:14
text: The eleventh for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:15
text: The twelfth for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

title: I Chronicles 27:16
text: ¶And over the tribes of Israel were: for the Reubenites Eliezer the son of Zichri was the prince; for the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah;

title: I Chronicles 27:17
text: for the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; for Aaron, Zadok;

title: I Chronicles 27:18
text: for Judah, Elihu of the brethren of David; for Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

title: I Chronicles 27:19
text: for Zebulun, Jishmaiah the son of Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel;

title: I Chronicles 27:20
text: for the children of Ephraim, Hosea the son of Azaziah; for the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

title: I Chronicles 27:21
text: for the half [tribe] of Manasseh in Gilead, Jiddo the son of Zechariah; for Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

title: I Chronicles 27:22
text: for Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.

title: I Chronicles 27:23
text: And David took not their number from twenty years old and under; for Jehovah had said he would increase Israel as the stars of heaven.

title: I Chronicles 27:24
text: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he did not finish; and there fell wrath for it upon Israel; and the number was not put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

title: I Chronicles 27:25
text: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel; and over the storehouses in the country, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah.

title: I Chronicles 27:26
text: And over them that worked in the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

title: I Chronicles 27:27
text: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite; and over what was in the vineyards of stores of wine was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

title: I Chronicles 27:28
text: and over the olive-trees and the sycamore-trees that were in the lowland was Baal-hanan the Gederite; and over the cellars of oil was Joash.

title: I Chronicles 27:29
text: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; and over the herds in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.

title: I Chronicles 27:30
text: And over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite; and over the asses was Jehdiah the Meronothite.

title: I Chronicles 27:31
text: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagarite. All these were comptrollers of the substance which was king David's.

title: I Chronicles 27:32
text: And Jonathan, David's uncle, was counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons;

title: I Chronicles 27:33
text: and Ahithophel was the king's counsellor; and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend;

title: I Chronicles 27:34
text: and after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar; and Joab was captain of the king's army.

title: I Chronicles 28:1
text: ¶And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the princes of the divisions that ministered to the king, and the captains over thousands, and the captains over hundreds, and the comptrollers of all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the chamberlains, and the mighty men, and all the men of valour, unto Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 28:2
text: And king David stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren and my people! I had in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of Jehovah and for the footstool of our God, and I have prepared to build.

title: I Chronicles 28:3
text: But God said to me, Thou shalt not build a house unto my name, for thou art a man of war, and hast shed blood.

title: I Chronicles 28:4
text: And Jehovah the God of Israel chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever; for he has chosen Judah to be the prince; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel;

title: I Chronicles 28:5
text: and of all my sons, (for Jehovah has given me many sons,) he has chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of Jehovah over Israel.

title: I Chronicles 28:6
text: And he said to me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

title: I Chronicles 28:7
text: And I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be firm to do my commandments and mine ordinances, as at this day.

title: I Chronicles 28:8
text: And now in the sight of all Israel, the congregation of Jehovah, and in the audience of our God, --keep and seek for all the commandments of Jehovah your God; that ye may possess the good land, and leave it as an inheritance to your children after you for ever.

title: I Chronicles 28:9
text: And thou, Solomon my son, know the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Jehovah searches all hearts, and discerns all the imaginations of the thoughts. If thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cut thee off for ever.

title: I Chronicles 28:10
text: Consider now, that Jehovah has chosen thee to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do [it].

title: I Chronicles 28:11
text: ¶And David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of its houses, and of its treasuries, and of its upper chambers, and of its inner chambers, and of the house of the mercy-seat;

title: I Chronicles 28:12
text: and the pattern of all that he had by the Spirit, of the courts of the house of Jehovah, and of all the chambers round about, for the treasuries of the house of God, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

title: I Chronicles 28:13
text: and for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, and for all the instruments of service in the house of Jehovah:

title: I Chronicles 28:14
text: gold by weight for [things] of gold, for all utensils of each kind of service; for all utensils of silver, by weight, for all utensils of each kind of service;

title: I Chronicles 28:15
text: and the weight of the golden candlesticks, and of their golden lamps, by weight for every candlestick, and for its lamps; and for the silver candlesticks, by weight, for the candlestick and for its lamps, according to the use of every candlestick;

title: I Chronicles 28:16
text: and gold by weight for the tables of the [loaves] to be set in rows, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

title: I Chronicles 28:17
text: and pure gold for the forks, and the bowls, and the goblets; and for the golden basons by weight for every bason; and for the silver basons by weight for every bason;

title: I Chronicles 28:18
text: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and the pattern of the chariot of the cherubim of gold, which spread out [their wings] and cover the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.

title: I Chronicles 28:19
text: All this [said David,] in writing, by Jehovah's hand upon me, instructing as to all the works of the pattern.

title: I Chronicles 28:20
text: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and courageous, and do it; fear not nor be dismayed: for Jehovah Elohim, my God, will be with thee; he will not leave thee, neither forsake thee, until all the work for the service of the house of Jehovah is finished.

title: I Chronicles 28:21
text: And behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites are for all the service of the house of God; and thou hast with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing man, skilful for every sort of service; and the princes and all the people are wholly at thy commandment.

title: I Chronicles 29:1
text: ¶And king David said to all the congregation, Solomon my son, the one whom God has chosen, is young and tender, and the work is great; for this palace is not to be for man, but for Jehovah Elohim.

title: I Chronicles 29:2
text: And I have prepared according to all my power for the house of my God gold for [things of] gold, and silver for [things of] silver, and brass for [things of] brass, iron for [things of] iron, and wood for [things of] wood; onyx stones, and [stones] to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and white marble in abundance.

title: I Chronicles 29:3
text: And moreover, in my affection for the house of my God I have given of my own property of gold and silver, for the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the house of the sanctuary:

title: I Chronicles 29:4
text: three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses;

title: I Chronicles 29:5
text: gold for [things of] gold, and silver for [things of] silver, and for all manner of work by the hands of artificers. And who is willing to offer to Jehovah this day?

title: I Chronicles 29:6
text: And the chief fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and the comptrollers of the king's business, offered willingly.

title: I Chronicles 29:7
text: And they gave for the service of the house of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of brass, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

title: I Chronicles 29:8
text: And they with whom stones were found gave [them] to the treasure of the house of Jehovah, into the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

title: I Chronicles 29:9
text: And the people rejoiced because they offered willingly, for with perfect heart they offered willingly to Jehovah; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

title: I Chronicles 29:10
text: ¶And David blessed Jehovah in the sight of all the congregation; and David said, Blessed be thou, Jehovah, the God of our father Israel, for ever and ever.

title: I Chronicles 29:11
text: Thine, Jehovah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the splendour, and the majesty; for all that is in the heavens and on the earth is thine: thine, Jehovah, is the kingdom, and thou art exalted as Head above all;

title: I Chronicles 29:12
text: and riches and glory are of thee, and thou rulest over everything; and in thy hand is power and might; and in thy hand it is to make all great and strong.

title: I Chronicles 29:13
text: And now, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

title: I Chronicles 29:14
text: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer willingly after this manner? for all is of thee, and of that which is from thy hand have we given thee.

title: I Chronicles 29:15
text: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no hope [of life].

title: I Chronicles 29:16
text: Jehovah our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee a house to thy holy name, is of thy hand, and is all thine own.

title: I Chronicles 29:17
text: And I know, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. In the uprightness of my heart have I willingly offered all these things; and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, offer willingly to thee.

title: I Chronicles 29:18
text: Jehovah, God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and direct their hearts to thee!

title: I Chronicles 29:19
text: And give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.

title: I Chronicles 29:20
text: And David said to all the congregation, Bless now Jehovah your God. And all the congregation blessed Jehovah the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and did homage to Jehovah and the king.

title: I Chronicles 29:21
text: And they sacrificed sacrifices to Jehovah, and offered up burnt-offerings to Jehovah, on the morrow after that day: a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

title: I Chronicles 29:22
text: And they ate and drank before Jehovah on that day with great joy. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him to Jehovah to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

title: I Chronicles 29:23
text: ¶And Solomon sat on the throne of Jehovah as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

title: I Chronicles 29:24
text: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

title: I Chronicles 29:25
text: And Jehovah magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him royal majesty such as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

title: I Chronicles 29:26
text: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

title: I Chronicles 29:27
text: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years: he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

title: I Chronicles 29:28
text: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour; and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

title: I Chronicles 29:29
text: And the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer;

title: I Chronicles 29:30
text: with all his reign and his might, and the times that passed over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

title: II Chronicles 1:1
text: ¶And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and Jehovah his God was with him and magnified him exceedingly.

title: II Chronicles 1:2
text: And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to all the princes of all Israel, the chief fathers;

title: II Chronicles 1:3
text: and Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place at Gibeon; for there was God's tent of meeting which Moses the servant of Jehovah had made in the wilderness.

title: II Chronicles 1:4
text: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the [place] that David had prepared for it; for he had spread a tent for it at Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 1:5
text: And the brazen altar that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, was there before the tabernacle of Jehovah; and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

title: II Chronicles 1:6
text: And Solomon offered there upon the brazen altar before Jehovah which was at the tent of meeting; and he offered up a thousand burnt-offerings upon it.

title: II Chronicles 1:7
text: In that night God appeared to Solomon, and said to him, Ask what I shall give thee.

title: II Chronicles 1:8
text: And Solomon said to God, Thou hast shewn unto David my father great loving-kindness, and hast made me king in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 1:9
text: Now, Jehovah Elohim, let thy word unto David my father be firm; for thou hast made me king over a people numerous as the dust of the earth.

title: II Chronicles 1:10
text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this thy great people?

title: II Chronicles 1:11
text: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thy heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of them that hate thee, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked for thyself wisdom and knowledge, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

title: II Chronicles 1:12
text: wisdom and knowledge are granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches and wealth and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall any after thee have the like.

title: II Chronicles 1:13
text: ¶Then Solomon came back [from] the high place at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tent of meeting, and reigned over Israel.

title: II Chronicles 1:14
text: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; and he had a thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen; and he placed them in the chariot-cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 1:15
text: And the king made silver and gold in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he as the sycamores that are in the lowland for abundance.

title: II Chronicles 1:16
text: And the exportation of horses that Solomon had was from Egypt: a caravan of the king's merchants fetched a drove [of horses], at a price.

title: II Chronicles 1:17
text: And they fetched up and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred [shekels] of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty; and so they brought [them] by their means, for all the kings of the Hittites and for the kings of Syria.

title: II Chronicles 2:1
text: ¶And Solomon purposed to build a house for the name of Jehovah, and a house for his kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 2:2
text: And Solomon numbered seventy thousand men to bear burdens, and eighty thousand stone-masons in the mountain, and three thousand six hundred to superintend them.

title: II Chronicles 2:3
text: And Solomon sent to Huram king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him a house to dwell therein [so do for me].

title: II Chronicles 2:4
text: Behold, I build a house unto the name of Jehovah my God to dedicate it to him, to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual arrangement [of the shewbread], and for the morning and evening burnt-offerings [and] on the sabbaths and on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Jehovah our God. This is [an ordinance] for ever to Israel.

title: II Chronicles 2:5
text: And the house that I will build is great; for great is our God above all gods.

title: II Chronicles 2:6
text: But who is able to build him a house, seeing the heavens and the heaven of heavens cannot contain him? And who am I that I should build him a house, except to burn sacrifice before him?

title: II Chronicles 2:7
text: And now send me a man skilful to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze, and in iron, and in purple and crimson and blue, and experienced in carving, besides the skilful men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

title: II Chronicles 2:8
text: Send me also cedar-trees, cypress-trees, and sandal-wood trees, out of Lebanon; for I know that thy servants are experienced in cutting timber in Lebanon; and behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,

title: II Chronicles 2:9
text: even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house that I build shall be great and wonderful.

title: II Chronicles 2:10
text: And behold, I will give to thy servants the hewers that fell timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

title: II Chronicles 2:11
text: ¶And Huram king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because Jehovah loved his people, he made thee king over them.

title: II Chronicles 2:12
text: And Huram said, Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, that made the heavens and the earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, who will build a house for Jehovah and a house for his kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 2:13
text: And now, I send a skilful man, endued with understanding, Huram Abi,

title: II Chronicles 2:14
text: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and whose father was a man of Tyre, experienced in working in gold, and in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in byssus, and in crimson, and for doing any manner of engraving, and for inventing every device which shall be put to him, besides thy skilful men, and the skilful men of my lord David thy father.

title: II Chronicles 2:15
text: And now the wheat and the barley, the oil and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants.

title: II Chronicles 2:16
text: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need; and we will bring it to thee [in] floats by sea to Joppa, and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 2:17
text: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the account that David his father had taken of them, and there were found a hundred and fifty-three thousand six hundred.

title: II Chronicles 2:18
text: And he set seventy thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and eighty thousand to be stone-masons in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to set the people to work.

title: II Chronicles 3:1
text: ¶And Solomon began to build the house of Jehovah at Jerusalem on mount Moriah, where he appeared to David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

title: II Chronicles 3:2
text: And he began to build on the second of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

title: II Chronicles 3:3
text: And this was Solomon's foundation for the construction of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

title: II Chronicles 3:4
text: And the porch which was in front was twenty cubits in length, in front of the house broadways, and the height was a hundred and twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

title: II Chronicles 3:5
text: And the greater house he boarded with cypress-wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set on it palm-trees and chains.

title: II Chronicles 3:6
text: And he overlaid the house with precious stones for beauty; and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

title: II Chronicles 3:7
text: And he covered the house, the beams, the threshold, and its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

title: II Chronicles 3:8
text: And he made the house of the most holy place, the length of which was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and its breadth twenty cubits; and he covered it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

title: II Chronicles 3:9
text: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he covered the upper chambers with gold.

title: II Chronicles 3:10
text: ¶And in the house of the most holy place he made two cherubim of image work, and they overlaid them with gold.

title: II Chronicles 3:11
text: And the wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: one wing of five cubits touched the wall of the house; and the other wing of five cubits touched the wing of the other cherub.

title: II Chronicles 3:12
text: And the wing of the other cherub of five cubits touched the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits joining the wing of the other cherub.

title: II Chronicles 3:13
text: The wings of these cherubim spread forth were twenty cubits; and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

title: II Chronicles 3:14
text: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and byssus, and made cherubim upon it.

title: II Chronicles 3:15
text: And before the house he made two pillars thirty-five cubits long; and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

title: II Chronicles 3:16
text: And he made chains [as] in the oracle, and he put them on the top of the pillars; and he made a hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

title: II Chronicles 3:17
text: And he set up the pillars in front of the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and he called the name of that on the right Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

title: II Chronicles 4:1
text: ¶And he made a brazen altar: its length was twenty cubits, and its breadth twenty cubits, and its height ten cubits.

title: II Chronicles 4:2
text: And he made the sea, molten, ten cubits from brim to brim, round all about; and its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encompassed it round about.

title: II Chronicles 4:3
text: And under it was the similitude of oxen, encompassing it round about, ten in a cubit enclosing the sea round about, two rows of oxen, cast when it was cast.

title: II Chronicles 4:4
text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

title: II Chronicles 4:5
text: And its thickness was a hand-breadth, and its brim like the work of the brim of a cup, with lily-blossoms; in capacity it held three thousand baths.

title: II Chronicles 4:6
text: And he made ten lavers, and put five on the right and five on the left, to wash in them: they rinsed in them what they prepared for the burnt-offering; and the sea was for the priests to wash in.

title: II Chronicles 4:7
text: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to the ordinance respecting them, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.

title: II Chronicles 4:8
text: And he made ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left. And he made a hundred golden bowls.

title: II Chronicles 4:9
text: And he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors thereof with bronze.

title: II Chronicles 4:10
text: And he set the sea on the right side eastward, over against the south.

title: II Chronicles 4:11
text: ¶And Huram made the pots and the shovels and the bowls. So Huram ended doing the work that he made for king Solomon in the house of God:

title: II Chronicles 4:12
text: two pillars, and the globes and the capitals on the top of the pillars, two; and the two networks, to cover the two globes of the capitals which were on the top of the pillars;

title: II Chronicles 4:13
text: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two globes of the capitals which were upon the pillars.

title: II Chronicles 4:14
text: And he made the bases, and he made the lavers on the bases;

title: II Chronicles 4:15
text: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

title: II Chronicles 4:16
text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the forks, and all their instruments did Huram Abiv make king Solomon for the house of Jehovah, of bright brass.

title: II Chronicles 4:17
text: In the plain of the Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay-ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

title: II Chronicles 4:18
text: And Solomon made all these vessels in great number; for the weight of the brass was not ascertained.

title: II Chronicles 4:19
text: And Solomon made all the vessels that were [in] the house of God: the golden altar; and the tables whereon was the shewbread;

title: II Chronicles 4:20
text: and the candlesticks with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the oracle, of pure gold;

title: II Chronicles 4:21
text: and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold (it was perfect gold);

title: II Chronicles 4:22
text: and the knives, and the bowls, and the cups, and the censers, of pure gold; and the entrance of the house, the inner folding-doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

title: II Chronicles 5:1
text: ¶And all the work was finished that Solomon made for the house of Jehovah. And Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the vessels he put among the treasures of the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 5:2
text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah out of the city of David, which is Zion.

title: II Chronicles 5:3
text: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, that of the seventh month.

title: II Chronicles 5:4
text: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

title: II Chronicles 5:5
text: And they brought up the ark, and the tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the tent: the priests, the Levites, brought them up.

title: II Chronicles 5:6
text: And king Solomon, and all the assembly of Israel, that were assembled to him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen which could not be counted nor numbered for multitude.

title: II Chronicles 5:7
text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Jehovah to its place, into the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, under the wings of the cherubim;

title: II Chronicles 5:8
text: and the cherubim stretched forth [their] wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its staves above.

title: II Chronicles 5:9
text: And the staves were long, so that the ends of the staves were seen outside the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there they are to this day.

title: II Chronicles 5:10
text: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put there at Horeb, when Jehovah made [a covenant] with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 5:11
text: ¶And it came to pass when the priests were come out of the holy place (for all the priests that were present were hallowed without observing the courses;

title: II Chronicles 5:12
text: and the Levites the singers, all they of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, clad in byssus, with cymbals and lutes and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them a hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets),

title: II Chronicles 5:13
text: --it came to pass when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one voice to be heard in praising and thanking Jehovah; and when they lifted up their voice with trumpets, and cymbals, and instruments of music, and praised Jehovah: For he is good, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever; that then the house, the house of Jehovah, was filled with a cloud,

title: II Chronicles 5:14
text: and the priests could not stand to do their service because of the cloud; for the glory of Jehovah had filled the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 6:1
text: ¶Then said Solomon: Jehovah said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

title: II Chronicles 6:2
text: But I have built a house of habitation for thee, even a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

title: II Chronicles 6:3
text: And the king turned his face and blessed the whole congregation of Israel; and the whole congregation of Israel stood.

title: II Chronicles 6:4
text: And he said: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

title: II Chronicles 6:5
text: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be prince over my people Israel:

title: II Chronicles 6:6
text: but I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:7
text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build a house unto the name of Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:8
text: But Jehovah said to David my father, Whereas it was in thy heart to build a house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thy heart;

title: II Chronicles 6:9
text: nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

title: II Chronicles 6:10
text: And Jehovah has performed his word which he spoke; and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as Jehovah promised, and I have built the house unto the name of Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:11
text: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of Jehovah, which he made with the children of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 6:12
text: ¶And he stood before the altar of Jehovah in the presence of the whole congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands.

title: II Chronicles 6:13
text: For Solomon had made a platform of bronze, five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court; and upon it he stood, and he kneeled down on his knees before the whole congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward the heavens,

title: II Chronicles 6:14
text: and said, Jehovah, God of Israel! there is no God like thee, in the heavens or on the earth, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart;

title: II Chronicles 6:15
text: who hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou didst promise him; thou spokest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled [it] with thy hand as at this day.

title: II Chronicles 6:16
text: And now, Jehovah, God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only thy sons take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

title: II Chronicles 6:17
text: And now, Jehovah, God of Israel, let thy word be verified which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

title: II Chronicles 6:18
text: But will God indeed dwell with man on the earth? behold, the heavens and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

title: II Chronicles 6:19
text: Yet have respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, Jehovah, my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee;

title: II Chronicles 6:20
text: that thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place in which thou hast said thou wouldest put thy name: to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

title: II Chronicles 6:21
text: And hearken unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall pray toward this place, and hear thou from thy dwelling-place, from the heavens, and when thou hearest, forgive.

title: II Chronicles 6:22
text: If a man have sinned against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to adjure him, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

title: II Chronicles 6:23
text: then hear thou from the heavens, and do, and judge thy servants, requiting the wicked, to bring his way upon his own head; and justifying the righteous, giving him according to his righteousness.

title: II Chronicles 6:24
text: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication before thee in this house;

title: II Chronicles 6:25
text: then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land that thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 6:26
text: When the heavens are shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, because thou hast afflicted them;

title: II Chronicles 6:27
text: then hear thou in the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou teachest them the good way wherein they should walk; and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

title: II Chronicles 6:28
text: If there be famine in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their gates; whatever plague or whatever sickness there be:

title: II Chronicles 6:29
text: what prayer, what supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, when they shall know every man his own plague, and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands toward this house;

title: II Chronicles 6:30
text: then hear thou from the heavens, the settled place of thy dwelling, and forgive, and render unto every man according to all his ways, whose heart thou knowest (for thou, thou only, knowest the hearts of the children of men),

title: II Chronicles 6:31
text: that they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, all the days that they live upon the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

title: II Chronicles 6:32
text: And as to the stranger also, who is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand and thy stretched-out arm; when they shall come and pray toward this house,

title: II Chronicles 6:33
text: then hear thou from the heavens, the settled place of thy dwelling, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; in order that all peoples of the earth may know thy name, and may fear thee as do thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.

title: II Chronicles 6:34
text: If thy people go out to battle against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city that thou hast chosen, and the house that I have built unto thy name;

title: II Chronicles 6:35
text: then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their right.

title: II Chronicles 6:36
text: If they have sinned against thee (for there is no man that sinneth not), and thou be angry with them, and give them up to the enemy, and they have carried them away captives unto a land far off or near;

title: II Chronicles 6:37
text: and if they shall take it to heart in the land whither they were carried captive, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done iniquity and have dealt perversely;

title: II Chronicles 6:38
text: and if they return unto thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land which thou gavest unto their fathers, and the city that thou hast chosen, and the house that I have built unto thy name;

title: II Chronicles 6:39
text: then hear thou from the heavens, from the settled place of thy dwelling, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their right, and forgive thy people their sin against thee.

title: II Chronicles 6:40
text: Now, my God, I beseech thee, let thine eyes be open and let thine ears be attentive unto the prayer [that is made] in this place.

title: II Chronicles 6:41
text: And now, arise, Jehovah Elohim, into thy resting-place, thou and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, Jehovah Elohim, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in [thy] goodness.

title: II Chronicles 6:42
text: Jehovah Elohim, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember mercies to David thy servant.

title: II Chronicles 7:1
text: ¶And when Solomon had ended praying, the fire came down from the heavens and consumed the burnt-offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of Jehovah filled the house.

title: II Chronicles 7:2
text: And the priests could not enter into the house of Jehovah, because the glory of Jehovah filled Jehovah's house.

title: II Chronicles 7:3
text: And all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of Jehovah upon the house, and bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, and worshipped and thanked Jehovah: For he is good, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

title: II Chronicles 7:4
text: And the king and all the people offered sacrifices before Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 7:5
text: And king Solomon sacrificed a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 7:6
text: And the priests stood in their charges, and the Levites with Jehovah's instruments of music, which David the king had made to praise Jehovah, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever, when David praised by their means; and the priests sounded the trumpets opposite to them, and all Israel stood.

title: II Chronicles 7:7
text: And Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of Jehovah; for there he offered the burnt-offerings, and the fat of the peace-offerings, because the brazen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt-offerings and the oblations and the fat.

title: II Chronicles 7:8
text: And at that time Solomon held the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entrance of Hamath unto the torrent of Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 7:9
text: And on the eighth day they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

title: II Chronicles 7:10
text: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that Jehovah had done to David and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

title: II Chronicles 7:11
text: And Solomon completed the house of Jehovah, and the king's house; and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of Jehovah, and in his own house, he did prosperously.

title: II Chronicles 7:12
text: ¶Then Jehovah appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him: I have heard thy prayer, and I have chosen for myself this place for a house of sacrifice.

title: II Chronicles 7:13
text: If I shut up the heavens that there be no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

title: II Chronicles 7:14
text: and my people, who are called by my name, humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from the heavens, and forgive their sin, and heal their land.

title: II Chronicles 7:15
text: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attentive to the prayer [made] in this place;

title: II Chronicles 7:16
text: for I have now chosen and hallowed this house, that my name may be there for ever; and mine eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

title: II Chronicles 7:17
text: And [as for] thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and mine ordinances;

title: II Chronicles 7:18
text: then will I establish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to rule over Israel.

title: II Chronicles 7:19
text: But if ye turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them;

title: II Chronicles 7:20
text: then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed to my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

title: II Chronicles 7:21
text: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passes by it; so that he shall say, Why has Jehovah done thus to this land and to this house?

title: II Chronicles 7:22
text: And they shall say, Because they forsook Jehovah the God of their fathers, who brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and have attached themselves to other gods, and have worshipped them and served them; therefore he has brought upon them all this evil.

title: II Chronicles 8:1
text: ¶And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the house of Jehovah and his own house,

title: II Chronicles 8:2
