text: that the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, Solomon built them and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

title: II Chronicles 8:3
text: And Solomon went to Hamath-Zobah, and overcame it.

title: II Chronicles 8:4
text: And he built Tadmor, in the wilderness, and all the store-cities, which he built in Hamath.

title: II Chronicles 8:5
text: And he built upper Beth-Horon and lower Beth-Horon, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

title: II Chronicles 8:6
text: and Baalath, and all the store-cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for chariots, and the cities for the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and on Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

title: II Chronicles 8:7
text: All the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel,

title: II Chronicles 8:8
text: their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel had not destroyed, upon them did Solomon impose tribute-service until this day.

title: II Chronicles 8:9
text: But of the children of Israel, of them did Solomon make no bondmen for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and his horsemen.

title: II Chronicles 8:10
text: And these were the chief of king Solomon's superintendents, two hundred and fifty, that ruled over the people.

title: II Chronicles 8:11
text: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David to the house which he had built for her; for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the [places] are holy to which the ark of Jehovah has come.

title: II Chronicles 8:12
text: ¶Then Solomon offered up burnt-offerings to Jehovah on the altar of Jehovah, which he had built before the porch;

title: II Chronicles 8:13
text: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and at the set feasts, three times in the year, --at the feast of unleavened bread, and at the feast of weeks, and at the feast of tabernacles.

title: II Chronicles 8:14
text: And he appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests for their service, and the Levites for their charges, to praise and serve before the priests, as the duty of every day required; and the doorkeepers by their divisions at every gate: for such was the commandment of David the man of God;

title: II Chronicles 8:15
text: and they did not depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and the Levites concerning any matter, nor concerning the treasures.

title: II Chronicles 8:16
text: And all the work of Solomon was prepared, to the day of the foundation of the house of Jehovah and to its completion. [So] the house of Jehovah was finished.

title: II Chronicles 8:17
text: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

title: II Chronicles 8:18
text: And Huram sent him by his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and fetched thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 9:1
text: ¶And the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, and came to Jerusalem to prove Solomon with enigmas; with a very great train, and camels that bore spices and gold in great abundance, and precious stones; and she came to Solomon, and spoke with him of all that was in her heart.

title: II Chronicles 9:2
text: And Solomon explained to her all she spoke of, and there was not a thing hidden from Solomon that he did not explain to her.

title: II Chronicles 9:3
text: And when the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

title: II Chronicles 9:4
text: and the food of his table, and the deportment of his servants, and the order of service of his attendants and their apparel, and his cupbearers and their apparel, and his ascent by which he went up to the house of Jehovah, there was no more spirit in her.

title: II Chronicles 9:5
text: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thine affairs and of thy wisdom;

title: II Chronicles 9:6
text: but I gave no credit to their words, until I came and mine eyes had seen; and behold, the half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: thou exceedest the report that I heard.

title: II Chronicles 9:7
text: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, who stand continually before thee and hear thy wisdom!

title: II Chronicles 9:8
text: Blessed be Jehovah thy God, who delighted in thee, to set thee on his throne, to be king to Jehovah thy God! Because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore did he make thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

title: II Chronicles 9:9
text: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and spices in very great abundance, and precious stones; neither was there any such spice as that which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 9:10
text: (And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, brought sandal-wood and precious stones.

title: II Chronicles 9:11
text: And the king made of the sandal-wood stairs for the house of Jehovah, and for the king's house, and harps and lutes for the singers. And there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.)

title: II Chronicles 9:12
text: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, besides what she had brought to the king. And she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

title: II Chronicles 9:13
text: ¶And the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,

title: II Chronicles 9:14
text: besides [what] dealers and merchants brought, and [what] all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought of gold and silver to Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 9:15
text: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold, --he applied six hundred [shekels] of beaten gold to one target;

title: II Chronicles 9:16
text: and three hundred shields of beaten gold, --he applied three hundred [shekels] of gold to one shield; and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

title: II Chronicles 9:17
text: And the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold;

title: II Chronicles 9:18
text: and the throne had six steps, with a footstool of gold fastened to the throne; and there were arms on each side at the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the arms;

title: II Chronicles 9:19
text: and twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 9:20
text: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of precious gold: silver was not of the least account in the days of Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 9:21
text: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: once in three years came the ships of Tarshish, bringing gold and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

title: II Chronicles 9:22
text: And king Solomon was greater than all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

title: II Chronicles 9:23
text: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

title: II Chronicles 9:24
text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver and vessels of gold, and clothing, armour, and spices, horses and mules, a rate year by year.

title: II Chronicles 9:25
text: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; and he placed them in the chariot-cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 9:26
text: And he ruled over all the kings from the river as far as the land of the Philistines, and up to the border of Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 9:27
text: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he as the sycamores that are in the lowland for abundance.

title: II Chronicles 9:28
text: And they brought to Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

title: II Chronicles 9:29
text: And the rest of the acts of Solomon first and last, are they not written in the words of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

title: II Chronicles 9:30
text: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

title: II Chronicles 9:31
text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David his father; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 10:1
text: ¶And Rehoboam went to Shechem; for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

title: II Chronicles 10:2
text: And it came to pass when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard it (now he was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of king Solomon) that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 10:3
text: And they sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam saying,

title: II Chronicles 10:4
text: Thy father made our yoke grievous; and now lighten the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

title: II Chronicles 10:5
text: And he said to them, Come again to me after three days. And the people departed.

title: II Chronicles 10:6
text: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, How do ye advise to return answer to this people?

title: II Chronicles 10:7
text: And they spoke to him saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

title: II Chronicles 10:8
text: But he forsook the advice of the old men which they had given him, and consulted with the young men, who had grown up with him, that stood before him.

title: II Chronicles 10:9
text: And he said to them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me saying, Lighten the yoke which thy father put upon us?

title: II Chronicles 10:10
text: And the young men that had grown up with him spoke to him saying, Thus shalt thou say to the people who have spoken to thee saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, and lighten thou it for us, --thus shalt thou say to them: My little [finger] is thicker than my father's loins;

title: II Chronicles 10:11
text: and whereas my father laid a heavy yoke upon you, *I* will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but *I* [will chastise you] with scorpions.

title: II Chronicles 10:12
text: ¶And Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed saying, Come again to me on the third day.

title: II Chronicles 10:13
text: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the advice of the old men,

title: II Chronicles 10:14
text: and spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but *I* will add to it; my father chastised you with whips, but *I* [will chastise you] with scorpions.

title: II Chronicles 10:15
text: So the king hearkened not to the people; for it was brought about by God, that Jehovah might give effect to his word, which he spoke through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

title: II Chronicles 10:16
text: And all Israel saw that the king hearkened not to them; and the people answered the king saying, What portion have we in David? and [we have] no inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel. Now see to thine own house, David! And all Israel went to their tents.

title: II Chronicles 10:17
text: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

title: II Chronicles 10:18
text: And king Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the levy; but the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. And king Rehoboam hastened to mount his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 10:19
text: And Israel rebelled against the house of David, unto this day.

title: II Chronicles 11:1
text: ¶And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem; and he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men apt for war, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

title: II Chronicles 11:2
text: But the word of Jehovah came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

title: II Chronicles 11:3
text: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

title: II Chronicles 11:4
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Go not up, nor fight with your brethren; return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. And they hearkened to the words of Jehovah, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

title: II Chronicles 11:5
text: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

title: II Chronicles 11:6
text: And he built Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

title: II Chronicles 11:7
text: and Beth-zur, and Soco, and Adullam,

title: II Chronicles 11:8
text: and Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

title: II Chronicles 11:9
text: and Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

title: II Chronicles 11:10
text: and Zorah, and Ajalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin, fortified cities.

title: II Chronicles 11:11
text: And he fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of victuals, and of oil and wine;

title: II Chronicles 11:12
text: and in every several city, targets and spears, and made them exceedingly strong. And Judah and Benjamin were his.

title: II Chronicles 11:13
text: ¶And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their districts;

title: II Chronicles 11:14
text: for the Levites left their suburbs and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from exercising the priesthood to Jehovah;

title: II Chronicles 11:15
text: and he ordained for himself priests for the high places, and for the he-goats and for the calves that he had made.

title: II Chronicles 11:16
text: --And after them, those out of all the tribes of Israel that set their heart to seek Jehovah the God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice to Jehovah the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 11:17
text: And they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong three years; for during three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

title: II Chronicles 11:18
text: And Rehoboam took Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David as wife, [and of] Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.

title: II Chronicles 11:19
text: And she bore him children: Jeush, and Shemariah, and Zaham.

title: II Chronicles 11:20
text: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

title: II Chronicles 11:21
text: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he had taken eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and he begot twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

title: II Chronicles 11:22
text: And Rehoboam established Abijah the son of Maachah at the head, to be ruler among his brethren; for [he thought] to make him king.

title: II Chronicles 11:23
text: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to all the fortified cities; and he gave them food in abundance. And he desired [for them] a multitude of wives.

title: II Chronicles 12:1
text: ¶And it came to pass when the kingdom of Rehoboam was established, and when he had become strong, [that] he forsook the law of Jehovah, and all Israel with him.

title: II Chronicles 12:2
text: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, because they had transgressed against Jehovah, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem,

title: II Chronicles 12:3
text: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen; and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt: Libyans, Sukkites, and Ethiopians.

title: II Chronicles 12:4
text: And he took the fortified cities that belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 12:5
text: And Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and [to] the princes of Judah that had gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, Thus saith Jehovah: Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

title: II Chronicles 12:6
text: And the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, Jehovah is righteous.

title: II Chronicles 12:7
text: And when Jehovah saw that they humbled themselves, the word of Jehovah came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves: I will not destroy them, but I will grant them a little deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

title: II Chronicles 12:8
text: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

title: II Chronicles 12:9
text: And Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king's house; he took away all; and he took away the shields of gold that Solomon had made.

title: II Chronicles 12:10
text: And king Rehoboam made in their stead shields of bronze, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the couriers who kept the entrance of the king's house.

title: II Chronicles 12:11
text: And it was so, that as often as the king entered into the house of Jehovah, the couriers came and fetched them, and brought them again into the chamber of the couriers.

title: II Chronicles 12:12
text: And when he humbled himself, the anger of Jehovah turned away from him, that he would not destroy him altogether; and also in Judah there were good things.

title: II Chronicles 12:13
text: ¶And king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that Jehovah had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there: and his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

title: II Chronicles 12:14
text: And he did evil, for he applied not his heart to seek Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 12:15
text: And the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the words of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogical registers? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

title: II Chronicles 12:16
text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David. And Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 13:1
text: ¶In the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

title: II Chronicles 13:2
text: He reigned three years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Michaiah, the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

title: II Chronicles 13:3
text: And Abijah began the war with an army of men of war, four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, mighty men of valour.

title: II Chronicles 13:4
text: And Abijah stood up on the top of mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, Jeroboam, and all Israel!

title: II Chronicles 13:5
text: Ought ye not to know that Jehovah the God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, to him and to his sons [by] a covenant of salt?

title: II Chronicles 13:6
text: But Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up and rebelled against his lord.

title: II Chronicles 13:7
text: And vain men, sons of Belial, gathered to him and strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, and Rehoboam was young and faint-hearted, and did not shew himself strong against them.

title: II Chronicles 13:8
text: And now ye think to shew yourselves strong against the kingdom of Jehovah in the hand of the sons of David; and ye are a great multitude, and ye have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made you for gods.

title: II Chronicles 13:9
text: Have ye not cast out the priests of Jehovah, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made you priests as the peoples of the lands? whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, he becomes a priest of what is not God.

title: II Chronicles 13:10
text: But as for us, Jehovah is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests that serve Jehovah are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites are at their work:

title: II Chronicles 13:11
text: and they burn to Jehovah every morning and every evening burnt-offerings and sweet incense; the loaves also are set in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with its lamps to burn every evening: for *we* keep the charge of Jehovah our God; but *ye* have forsaken him.

title: II Chronicles 13:12
text: And behold, we have God with us at our head, and his priests, and the loud-sounding trumpets to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, do not fight with Jehovah the God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

title: II Chronicles 13:13
text: ¶But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; and they were before Judah, and the ambush behind them.

title: II Chronicles 13:14
text: And Judah looked back, and behold, they had the battle in front and behind; and they cried to Jehovah, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

title: II Chronicles 13:15
text: And the men of Judah gave a shout; and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

title: II Chronicles 13:16
text: And the children of Israel fled before Judah; and God delivered them into their hand.

title: II Chronicles 13:17
text: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter; and there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

title: II Chronicles 13:18
text: And the children of Israel were humbled at that time, and the children of Judah were strengthened, because they relied upon Jehovah the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 13:19
text: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its dependent villages, and Jeshanah with its dependent villages, and Ephron with its dependent villages.

title: II Chronicles 13:20
text: And Jeroboam did not recover strength again in the days of Abijah; and Jehovah smote him, and he died.

title: II Chronicles 13:21
text: But Abijah strengthened himself, and took fourteen wives, and begot twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

title: II Chronicles 13:22
text: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways and his sayings, are written in the treatise of the prophet Iddo.

title: II Chronicles 14:1
text: ¶And Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

title: II Chronicles 14:2
text: And Asa did what was good and right in the sight of Jehovah his God;

title: II Chronicles 14:3
text: and he took away the altars of the strange [gods] and the high places, and broke the columns, and cut down the Asherahs;

title: II Chronicles 14:4
text: and commanded Judah to seek Jehovah the God of their fathers, and to practise the law and the commandment.

title: II Chronicles 14:5
text: And he removed out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun-images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.

title: II Chronicles 14:6
text: And he built fortified cities in Judah, for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because Jehovah had given him rest.

title: II Chronicles 14:7
text: And he said to Judah, Let us build these cities, and surround them with walls and towers, gates and bars, while the land is yet before us; for we have sought Jehovah our God; we have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side. And they built and prospered.

title: II Chronicles 14:8
text: And Asa had an army that bore targets and spears: out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bore shields and drew the bow, two hundred and eighty thousand: all these, mighty men of valour.

title: II Chronicles 14:9
text: ¶And Zerah the Ethiopian came out against him with a host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

title: II Chronicles 14:10
text: And Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.

title: II Chronicles 14:11
text: And Asa cried unto Jehovah his God, and said, Jehovah, it maketh no difference to thee to help, whether there be much or no power: help us, O Jehovah our God, for we rely on thee, and in thy name have we come against this multitude. Jehovah, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

title: II Chronicles 14:12
text: And Jehovah smote the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

title: II Chronicles 14:13
text: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them to Gerar; and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that none of them was left alive; for they were crushed before Jehovah and before his army. And they carried away very much spoil.

title: II Chronicles 14:14
text: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar, for the terror of Jehovah came upon them; and they spoiled all the cities, for there was very much spoil in them.

title: II Chronicles 14:15
text: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 15:1
text: ¶And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded.

title: II Chronicles 15:2
text: And he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: Jehovah is with you while ye are with him; and if ye seek him he will be found of you, but if ye forsake him he will forsake you.

title: II Chronicles 15:3
text: Now for a long while Israel [was] without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law;

title: II Chronicles 15:4
text: but in their trouble they turned to Jehovah the God of Israel, and sought him, and he was found of them.

title: II Chronicles 15:5
text: And in those times there [was] no peace to him that went out nor to him that came in, but great disturbances were amongst all the inhabitants of the countries.

title: II Chronicles 15:6
text: And nation was broken against nation, and city against city; for God disturbed them with all manner of distress.

title: II Chronicles 15:7
text: But as for you, be firm and let not your hands be weak; for there is a reward for your deeds.

title: II Chronicles 15:8
text: ¶And when Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities that he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of Jehovah, that was before the porch of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 15:9
text: And he assembled all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon; for they fell away to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that Jehovah his God was with him.

title: II Chronicles 15:10
text: And they assembled themselves at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

title: II Chronicles 15:11
text: And they sacrificed to Jehovah in that day, of the spoil that they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

title: II Chronicles 15:12
text: And they entered into a covenant to seek Jehovah the God of their fathers, with all their heart, and with all their soul,

title: II Chronicles 15:13
text: and that whoever would not seek Jehovah the God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

title: II Chronicles 15:14
text: And they swore to Jehovah with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

title: II Chronicles 15:15
text: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath; for they took the oath with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them. And Jehovah gave them rest round about.

title: II Chronicles 15:16
text: And also Maachah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol for the Asherah; and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burned it in the valley Kidron.

title: II Chronicles 15:17
text: But the high places were not removed from Israel; only, Asa's heart was perfect all his days.

title: II Chronicles 15:18
text: And he brought into the house of God the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

title: II Chronicles 15:19
text: And there was no war until the thirty-fifth year of the reign of Asa.

title: II Chronicles 16:1
text: ¶In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, in order to let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 16:2
text: And Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of Jehovah and of the king's house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, who dwelt at Damascus, saying,

title: II Chronicles 16:3
text: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I send thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

title: II Chronicles 16:4
text: And Ben-hadad hearkened to king Asa, and sent the captains of his forces against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon and Dan and Abelmaim, and all the store-magazines of the cities of Naphtali.

title: II Chronicles 16:5
text: And it came to pass when Baasha heard of it, that he left off building Ramah, and let his work cease.

title: II Chronicles 16:6
text: And king Asa took all Judah; and they carried away the stones and the timber from Ramah, with which Baasha had been building, and he built with them Geba and Mizpah.

title: II Chronicles 16:7
text: ¶And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and hast not relied on Jehovah thy God, therefore has the army of the king of Syria escaped out of thy hand.

title: II Chronicles 16:8
text: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge army, with very many chariots and horsemen? but when thou didst rely on Jehovah, he delivered them into thy hand.

title: II Chronicles 16:9
text: For the eyes of Jehovah run to and fro through the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of those whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly; for from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

title: II Chronicles 16:10
text: And Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was enraged with him because of this. And Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.

title: II Chronicles 16:11
text: And behold the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

title: II Chronicles 16:12
text: And Asa in the thirty-ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was extremely great; yet in his disease he did not seek Jehovah, but the physicians.

title: II Chronicles 16:13
text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one-and-fortieth year of his reign.

title: II Chronicles 16:14
text: And they buried him in his own sepulchre, which he had excavated for himself in the city of David, and laid him in a bed filled with spices, a mixture of divers kinds prepared by the perfumer's art; and they made a very great burning for him.

title: II Chronicles 17:1
text: ¶And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

title: II Chronicles 17:2
text: And he placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim that Asa his father had taken.

title: II Chronicles 17:3
text: And Jehovah was with Jehoshaphat, for he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto the Baals;

title: II Chronicles 17:4
text: but he sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 17:5
text: And Jehovah established the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah gave gifts to Jehoshaphat; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

title: II Chronicles 17:6
text: And he took courage in the ways of Jehovah; moreover, he removed the high places and Asherahs out of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 17:7
text: And in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, Ben-hail, and Obadiah, and Zechariah, and Nethaneel, and Micah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

title: II Chronicles 17:8
text: and with them the Levites: Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

title: II Chronicles 17:9
text: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of Jehovah with them; and they went about through all the cities of Judah, and taught among the people.

title: II Chronicles 17:10
text: ¶And the terror of Jehovah was upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, and they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

title: II Chronicles 17:11
text: And some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and tribute-silver. The Arabians also brought him flocks, seven thousand seven hundred rams, and seven thousand seven hundred he-goats.

title: II Chronicles 17:12
text: And Jehoshaphat waxed exceeding great; and he built in Judah castles and store-cities.

title: II Chronicles 17:13
text: And he had much business in the cities of Judah; and men of war, strong and valiant, in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 17:14
text: And these are the numbers of them according to their fathers' houses. Of Judah the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valour;

title: II Chronicles 17:15
text: and next to him was Johanan the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand;

title: II Chronicles 17:16
text: and next to him, Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to Jehovah; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

title: II Chronicles 17:17
text: And of Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valour, and with him two hundred thousand, armed with bow and shield;

title: II Chronicles 17:18
text: and next to him was Jehozabad, and with him a hundred and eighty thousand ready prepared for war.

title: II Chronicles 17:19
text: These were they that waited on the king, besides those that the king had put in the fortified cities throughout Judah.

title: II Chronicles 18:1
text: ¶And Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.

title: II Chronicles 18:2
text: And after [certain] years he went down to Ahab, to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that were with him, and urged him to go up against Ramoth-Gilead.

title: II Chronicles 18:3
text: And Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-Gilead? And he said to him, I am as thou, and my people as thy people; and [I will be] with thee in the war.

title: II Chronicles 18:4
text: ¶And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Inquire, I pray thee, this day of the word of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 18:5
text: And the king of Israel assembled the prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, Shall we go against Ramoth-Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up, and God will give it into the king's hand.

title: II Chronicles 18:6
text: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Jehovah besides, that we might inquire of him?

title: II Chronicles 18:7
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Jehovah; but I hate him, for he prophesies no good concerning me, but always evil: [it is] Micah the son of Imlah. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

title: II Chronicles 18:8
text: Then the king of Israel called a chamberlain, and said, Fetch quickly Micah the son of Imlah.

title: II Chronicles 18:9
text: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, having put on their robes, sat each on his throne; and they sat in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

title: II Chronicles 18:10
text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron, and he said, Thus saith Jehovah: With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have exterminated them.

title: II Chronicles 18:11
text: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-Gilead, and prosper; for Jehovah will give it into the king's hand.

title: II Chronicles 18:12
text: And the messenger that went to call Micah spoke to him saying, Behold, the words of the prophets [declare] good to the king with one assent: let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and declare good.

title: II Chronicles 18:13
text: And Micah said, As Jehovah liveth, even what my God shall say, that will I declare.

title: II Chronicles 18:14
text: And he came to the king. And the king said to him, Micah, shall we go against Ramoth-Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper; and they will be given into your hands.

title: II Chronicles 18:15
text: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but truth in the name of Jehovah?

title: II Chronicles 18:16
text: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. And Jehovah said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

title: II Chronicles 18:17
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he prophesies no good concerning me, but evil?

title: II Chronicles 18:18
text: And he said, Hear ye therefore the word of Jehovah: I saw Jehovah sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left;

title: II Chronicles 18:19
text: and Jehovah said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-Gilead? And one spoke saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

title: II Chronicles 18:20
text: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before Jehovah and said, I will entice him. And Jehovah said unto him, Wherewith?

title: II Chronicles 18:21
text: And he said, I will go forth, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt entice [him], and also succeed: go forth, and do so.

title: II Chronicles 18:22
text: And now, behold, Jehovah has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets; and Jehovah has spoken evil concerning thee.

title: II Chronicles 18:23
text: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micah upon the cheek, and said, Which way now went the Spirit of Jehovah from me to speak to thee?

title: II Chronicles 18:24
text: And Micah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go from chamber to chamber to hide thyself.

title: II Chronicles 18:25
text: And the king of Israel said, Take ye Micah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

title: II Chronicles 18:26
text: and ye shall say, Thus says the king: Put this [man] in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

title: II Chronicles 18:27
text: And Micah said, If thou return at all in peace, Jehovah has not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O peoples, all of you!

title: II Chronicles 18:28
text: ¶And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-Gilead.

title: II Chronicles 18:29
text: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.

title: II Chronicles 18:30
text: And the king of Syria commanded the captains of his chariots saying, Fight neither with small nor great, but with the king of Israel only.

title: II Chronicles 18:31
text: And it came to pass when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, That is the king of Israel; and they surrounded him to fight; and Jehoshaphat cried out, and Jehovah helped him; and God diverted them from him.

title: II Chronicles 18:32
text: And it came to pass that when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

title: II Chronicles 18:33
text: And a man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the fastenings and the corslet. And he said to the charioteer, Turn thy hand and drive me out of the camp; for I am wounded.

title: II Chronicles 18:34
text: And the battle increased that day; and the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even; and about the time of the going down of the sun he died.

title: II Chronicles 19:1
text: ¶And Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 19:2
text: And Jehu the son of Hanani, the seer, went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate Jehovah? Therefore is wrath upon thee from Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 19:3
text: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee; for thou hast put away the Asherahs out of the land, and hast directed thy heart to seek God.

title: II Chronicles 19:4
text: And Jehoshaphat dwelt in Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back to Jehovah the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 19:5
text: ¶And he set judges in the land throughout the fortified cities of Judah, city by city.

title: II Chronicles 19:6
text: And he said to the judges, Take heed what ye do; for ye judge not for man, but for Jehovah, who will be with you in the matter of judgment.

title: II Chronicles 19:7
text: And now, let the terror of Jehovah be upon you; be careful what ye do, for there is no iniquity with Jehovah, nor respect of persons, nor taking of presents.

title: II Chronicles 19:8
text: --And moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set some of the Levites and priests, and of the chief fathers of Israel, for the judgment of Jehovah and for causes. --And they returned to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 19:9
text: And he charged them saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of Jehovah faithfully and with a perfect heart.

title: II Chronicles 19:10
text: And what cause soever comes to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against Jehovah, and so wrath come upon you and upon your brethren: this do and ye shall not trespass.

title: II Chronicles 19:11
text: And behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of Jehovah, and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, prince of the house of Judah, in all the king's matters; and ye have the Levites before you as officers. Be strong and do it, and Jehovah will be with the good.

title: II Chronicles 20:1
text: ¶And it came to pass after this [that] the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them certain of the Maonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

title: II Chronicles 20:2
text: And they came and told Jehoshaphat saying, A great multitude is come against thee from beyond the sea, from Syria; and behold, they are in Hazazon-tamar, which is Engedi.

title: II Chronicles 20:3
text: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek Jehovah, and proclaimed a fast throughout Judah.

title: II Chronicles 20:4
text: And Judah gathered themselves together to ask [help] of Jehovah: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 20:5
text: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of Jehovah, before the new court;

title: II Chronicles 20:6
text: and he said, Jehovah, God of our fathers, art not thou God in the heavens, and rulest thou not over all the kingdoms of the nations? And in thy hand there is power and might, and none can withstand thee.

title: II Chronicles 20:7
text: Hast not thou, our God, dispossessed the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and given it for ever to the seed of Abraham, thy friend?

title: II Chronicles 20:8
text: And they have dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,

title: II Chronicles 20:9
text: If evil come upon us, sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, and we stand before this house and before thee--for thy name is in this house--and cry unto thee in our distress, then thou wilt hear and save.

title: II Chronicles 20:10
text: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab, and those of mount Seir, amongst whom thou wouldest not let Israel go when they came out of the land of Egypt, (for they turned from them, and destroyed them not,)

title: II Chronicles 20:11
text: behold, they reward us, in coming to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to possess.

title: II Chronicles 20:12
text: Our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might in presence of this great company which cometh against us, neither know we what to do; but our eyes are upon thee.

title: II Chronicles 20:13
text: And all Judah stood before Jehovah, with their little ones, their wives, and their sons.

title: II Chronicles 20:14
text: ¶And upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, upon him came the Spirit of Jehovah, in the midst of the congregation;

title: II Chronicles 20:15
text: and he said, Be attentive, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat! Thus saith Jehovah unto you: Fear not, nor be dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.

title: II Chronicles 20:16
text: To-morrow go down against them: behold, they come up by the ascent of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

title: II Chronicles 20:17
text: Ye shall not have to fight on this occasion: set yourselves, stand and see the salvation of Jehovah [who is] with you! Judah and Jerusalem, fear not nor be dismayed; to-morrow go out against them, and Jehovah will be with you.

title: II Chronicles 20:18
text: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before Jehovah, worshipping Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 20:19
text: And the Levites, of the sons of the Kohathites, and of the sons of the Korahites, stood up to praise Jehovah the God of Israel with an exceeding loud voice.

title: II Chronicles 20:20
text: ¶And they rose early in the morning, and went forth towards the wilderness of Tekoa; and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in Jehovah your God, and ye shall be established; believe his prophets, and ye shall prosper!

title: II Chronicles 20:21
text: And he consulted with the people, and appointed singers to Jehovah, and those that should praise in holy splendour, as they went forth before the armed men, and say, Give thanks to Jehovah; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever!

title: II Chronicles 20:22
text: And when they began the song of triumph and praise, Jehovah set liers-in-wait against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, who had come against Judah, and they were smitten.

title: II Chronicles 20:23
text: And the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, to exterminate and destroy [them]; and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, they helped to destroy one another.

title: II Chronicles 20:24
text: And Judah came on to the mountain-watch in the wilderness, and they looked toward the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none had escaped.

title: II Chronicles 20:25
text: And Jehoshaphat and his people came to plunder the spoil of them, and they found among them in abundance, both riches with the dead bodies, and precious things, and they stripped off for themselves more than they could carry away; and they were three days in plundering the spoil, it was so much.

title: II Chronicles 20:26
text: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah, for there they blessed Jehovah; therefore the name of that place was called The valley of Berachah, to this day.

title: II Chronicles 20:27
text: And they returned, all the men of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat at their head, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for Jehovah had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

title: II Chronicles 20:28
text: And they came to Jerusalem with lutes and harps and trumpets, to the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 20:29
text: And the terror of God was on all the kingdoms of the lands, when they had heard that Jehovah fought against the enemies of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 20:30
text: And the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet; and his God gave him rest round about.

title: II Chronicles 20:31
text: ¶And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Azubah, daughter of Shilhi.

title: II Chronicles 20:32
text: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and turned not aside from it, doing what was right in the sight of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 20:33
text: Only, the high places were not removed; and as yet the people had not directed their hearts to the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 20:34
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the words of Jehu the son of Hanani, which are inserted in the book of the kings of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 20:35
text: And after this Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly.

title: II Chronicles 20:36
text: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish; and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.

title: II Chronicles 20:37
text: And Eliezer the son of Dodavah, of Mareshah, prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, Jehovah has broken thy works. And the ships were broken, and could not go to Tarshish.

title: II Chronicles 21:1
text: ¶And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 21:2
text: And he had brethren, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 21:3
text: And their father had given them great gifts of silver and of gold and of precious things, besides fortified cities in Judah; but the kingdom he gave to Jehoram, for he was the firstborn.

title: II Chronicles 21:4
text: And Jehoram established himself over the kingdom of his father, and strengthened himself; and he slew all his brethren with the sword, and [certain] also of the princes of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 21:5
text: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 21:6
text: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab, for the daughter of Ahab was his wife; and he did evil in the sight of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 21:7
text: But Jehovah would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he had promised to give to him always a lamp, and to his sons.

title: II Chronicles 21:8
text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and they set a king over themselves.

title: II Chronicles 21:9
text: And Jehoram went over with his captains, and all the chariots with him; and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites who had surrounded him, and the captains of the chariots.

title: II Chronicles 21:10
text: But the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken Jehovah the God of his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 21:11
text: Moreover he made high places on the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah [thereto].

title: II Chronicles 21:12
text: ¶And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet saying, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of David thy father: Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

title: II Chronicles 21:13
text: but hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, like the fornications of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren, thy father's house who were better than thyself:

title: II Chronicles 21:14
text: behold, Jehovah will smite with a great stroke thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy substance,

title: II Chronicles 21:15
text: and thyself with sore sicknesses, with a disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

title: II Chronicles 21:16
text: And Jehovah stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, who [are] near the Ethiopians;

title: II Chronicles 21:17
text: and they came up into Judah, and broke into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was no son left him, except Jehoahaz the youngest of his sons.

title: II Chronicles 21:18
text: And after all this, Jehovah smote him in his bowels with an incurable sickness.

title: II Chronicles 21:19
text: And it came to pass, from day to day, and at the time when the second year was drawing to a close, that his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died in cruel sufferings. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 21:20
text: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being regretted. And they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

title: II Chronicles 22:1
text: ¶And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead; for the band of men that came in the camp with the Arabians had slain all the elder ones. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

title: II Chronicles 22:2
text: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Athaliah, daughter of Omri.

title: II Chronicles 22:3
text: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab; for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.

title: II Chronicles 22:4
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah like the house of Ahab; for they were his counsellors after the death of his father, to his destruction.

title: II Chronicles 22:5
text: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab, king of Israel, to the war against Hazael the king of Syria at Ramoth-Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

title: II Chronicles 22:6
text: And he returned to be healed in Jizreel because of the wounds that were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jizreel; for he was sick.

title: II Chronicles 22:7
text: But his coming to Joram was from God the complete ruin of Ahaziah. And when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Jehovah had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

title: II Chronicles 22:8
text: And it came to pass when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, that he found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that attended upon Ahaziah, and he slew them.

title: II Chronicles 22:9
text: And he sought Ahaziah; and they caught him (for he had hid himself in Samaria), and brought him to Jehu, and slew him; and they buried him, for they said, He is a son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Jehovah with all his heart. And in the house of Ahaziah there was no one who was able to [hold] the kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 22:10
text: ¶And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she rose up and exterminated all the royal seed of the house of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 22:11
text: But Jehoshabeath the daughter of the king took Joash the son of Ahaziah and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she did not slay him;

title: II Chronicles 22:12
text: and he was with them hid in the house of God six years. And Athaliah reigned over the land.

title: II Chronicles 23:1
text: ¶And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of the hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

title: II Chronicles 23:2
text: And they went about in Judah and gathered together the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief fathers of Israel; and they came to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 23:3
text: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said to them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as Jehovah has said of the sons of David.

title: II Chronicles 23:4
text: This is the thing which ye shall do: a third part of you that come in on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be keepers of the doors;

title: II Chronicles 23:5
text: and a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation; and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 23:6
text: But let none come into the house of Jehovah except the priests and those of the Levites that do the service; they shall go in, for they are holy; but all the people shall keep the watch of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 23:7
text: And the Levites shall encompass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he that comes into the house shall be put to death; and ye shall be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.

title: II Chronicles 23:8
text: And the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they took every man his men, those that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go forth on the sabbath; for Jehoiada the priest did not liberate the divisions.

title: II Chronicles 23:9
text: And Jehoiada the priest gave to the captains of the hundreds king David's spears and shields and targets, which were in the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 23:10
text: And he set all the people, every man with his javelin in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, toward the altar and the house, by the king round about.

title: II Chronicles 23:11
text: And they brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and [gave him] the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, Long live the king!

title: II Chronicles 23:12
text: ¶And Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, and she came to the people into the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 23:13
text: And she looked, and behold, the king stood on his dais at the entrance, and the princes and the trumpets were by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets; and the singers [were there] with the instruments of music, and such as taught to sing praise. And Athaliah rent her garments, and said, Conspiracy! Conspiracy!

title: II Chronicles 23:14
text: And Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of the hundreds that were set over the host, and said to them, Lead her forth without the ranks; and whosoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword; for the priest said, Ye shall not put her to death in the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 23:15
text: And they made way for her, and she went through the entrance of the horse-gate into the king's house, and they put her to death there.

title: II Chronicles 23:16
text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between himself and all the people and the king, that they should be the people of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 23:17
text: And all the people went into the house of Baal, and broke it down; and they broke his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

title: II Chronicles 23:18
text: And Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of Jehovah under the hand of the priests, the Levites, whom David had set by classes over the house of Jehovah to offer up Jehovah's burnt-offerings, as it is written in the law of Moses, --with rejoicing and with singing according to the directions of David.

title: II Chronicles 23:19
text: And he set the doorkeepers at the gates of the house of Jehovah, that no one unclean in anything should enter in.

title: II Chronicles 23:20
text: And he took the captains of the hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of Jehovah; and they came through the upper gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

title: II Chronicles 23:21
text: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet; and they had slain Athaliah with the sword.

title: II Chronicles 24:1
text: ¶Joash was seven years old when he began to reign; and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

title: II Chronicles 24:2
text: And Joash did what was right in the sight of Jehovah all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

title: II Chronicles 24:3
text: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begot sons and daughters.

title: II Chronicles 24:4
text: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to renew the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 24:5
text: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out to the cities of Judah and collect of all Israel money for the repair of the house of your God from year to year, and ye shall hasten the matter. But the Levites hastened it not.

title: II Chronicles 24:6
text: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the tribute of Moses the servant of Jehovah [laid upon] the congregation of Israel, for the tent of the testimony?

title: II Chronicles 24:7
text: For the wicked Athaliah [and] her sons had devastated the house of God; and also all the hallowed things of the house of Jehovah had they employed for the Baals.

title: II Chronicles 24:8
text: And the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it at the gate of the house of Jehovah without,

title: II Chronicles 24:9
text: and they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring to Jehovah the tribute of Moses the servant of God [laid upon] Israel in the wilderness.

title: II Chronicles 24:10
text: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in and cast into the chest, until they had finished.

title: II Chronicles 24:11
text: And it came to pass at the time the chest was brought for the king's control by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and high priest's officer came, and they emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

title: II Chronicles 24:12
text: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of Jehovah, and they hired masons and carpenters to renew the house of Jehovah, and also such as wrought in iron and bronze, to repair the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 24:13
text: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in its state, and strengthened it.

title: II Chronicles 24:14
text: And when they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada; and they made of it vessels for the house of Jehovah, utensils to minister, and with which to offer up, and cups, and utensils of gold and silver. And they offered up burnt-offerings in the house of Jehovah continually all the days of Jehoiada.

title: II Chronicles 24:15
text: ¶And Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died; he was a hundred and thirty years old when he died.

title: II Chronicles 24:16
text: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God and toward his house.

title: II Chronicles 24:17
text: And after the death of Jehoiada the princes of Judah came and made obeisance to the king; then the king hearkened to them.

title: II Chronicles 24:18
text: And they forsook the house of Jehovah the God of their fathers, and served the Asherahs and idols; and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

title: II Chronicles 24:19
text: And he sent prophets among them to bring them again to Jehovah, and they testified against them; but they would not give ear.

title: II Chronicles 24:20
text: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood up above the people and said unto them, Thus saith God: Wherefore do ye transgress the commandments of Jehovah? And ye cannot prosper; for ye have forsaken Jehovah, and he hath forsaken you.

title: II Chronicles 24:21
text: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the command of the king in the court of the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 24:22
text: And king Joash remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, Jehovah see and require [it]!

title: II Chronicles 24:23
text: And it came to pass at the end of the year [that] the army of Syria came up against him; and they entered into Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them to the king at Damascus.

title: II Chronicles 24:24
text: Truly with a small company of men came the army of the Syrians, but Jehovah delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken Jehovah the God of their fathers; and they executed judgment upon Joash.

title: II Chronicles 24:25
text: And when they had departed from him (for they left him in great diseases), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died; and they buried him in the city of David, but they did not bury him in the sepulchres of the kings.

title: II Chronicles 24:26
text: And these are they that conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

title: II Chronicles 24:27
text: And as to his sons, and the greatness of the burdens [laid] upon him, and the building of the house of God, behold, they are written in the treatise of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 25:1
text: ¶Amaziah was twenty-five years old [when] he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 25:2
text: And he did what was right in the sight of Jehovah, yet not with a perfect heart.

title: II Chronicles 25:3
text: And it came to pass when the kingdom was established unto him, that he killed his servants who had smitten the king his father.

title: II Chronicles 25:4
text: But their children he did not put to death, but [did] according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, wherein Jehovah commanded saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, nor shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

title: II Chronicles 25:5
text: And Amaziah gathered Judah together and arranged them according to the fathers' houses, according to the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, throughout Judah and Benjamin; and he numbered them from twenty years old and upwards, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able for military service, that could handle spear and target.

title: II Chronicles 25:6
text: He hired also a hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for a hundred talents of silver.

title: II Chronicles 25:7
text: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the host of Israel go with thee; for Jehovah is not with Israel, [with] all the children of Ephraim.

title: II Chronicles 25:8
text: But if thou wilt go, do [it]; be strong for the battle: God will make thee fall before the enemy, for there is with God power to help and to cast down.

title: II Chronicles 25:9
text: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what is to be done for the hundred talents which I have given to the troop of Israel? And the man of God said, Jehovah is able to give thee much more than this.

title: II Chronicles 25:10
text: Then Amaziah separated them, --the troop that was come to him out of Ephraim, --to go home again. And their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.

title: II Chronicles 25:11
text: But Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

title: II Chronicles 25:12
text: And the children of Judah took ten thousand captive, alive, and brought them to the top of the cliff, and cast them down from the top of the cliff, so that they all were broken in pieces.

title: II Chronicles 25:13
text: But those of the troop that Amaziah had sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah from Samaria as far as Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.

title: II Chronicles 25:14
text: ¶And it came to pass after Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed himself down before them, and burned incense to them.

title: II Chronicles 25:15
text: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet, who said to him, Why dost thou seek after the gods of a people who have not delivered their own people out of thy hand?

title: II Chronicles 25:16
text: And it came to pass as he talked with him, that [Amaziah] said to him, Hast thou been made the king's counsellor? Forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbore, and said, I know that God has determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened to my counsel.

title: II Chronicles 25:17
text: ¶And Amaziah king of Judah took counsel, and sent to Joash the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

title: II Chronicles 25:18
text: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thorn-bush that is in Lebanon sent to the cedar that is in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son as wife; and there passed by the wild beast that is in Lebanon, and trode down the thorn-bush.

title: II Chronicles 25:19
text: Thou thinkest, Lo, thou hast smitten Edom; and thy heart has lifted thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou contend with misfortune, that thou shouldest fall, thou and Judah with thee?

title: II Chronicles 25:20
text: But Amaziah would not hear; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into [the enemy's] hand, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.

title: II Chronicles 25:21
text: And Joash king of Israel went up; and they looked one another in the face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which is in Judah.

title: II Chronicles 25:22
text: And Judah was routed before Israel; and they fled every man to his tent.

title: II Chronicles 25:23
text: And Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and he broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

title: II Chronicles 25:24
text: And he [took] all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

title: II Chronicles 25:25
text: And Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.

title: II Chronicles 25:26
text: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

title: II Chronicles 25:27
text: And from the time that Amaziah turned aside from following Jehovah, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish; and they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

title: II Chronicles 25:28
text: And they brought him on horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 26:1
text: ¶And all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

title: II Chronicles 26:2
text: It was he that built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after the king slept with his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 26:3
text: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 26:4
text: And he did what was right in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

title: II Chronicles 26:5
text: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God; and in the days that he sought Jehovah, God made him to prosper.

title: II Chronicles 26:6
text: And he went forth and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

title: II Chronicles 26:7
text: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-Baal, and the Maonites.

title: II Chronicles 26:8
text: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad to the entrance of Egypt; for he became exceeding strong.

title: II Chronicles 26:9
text: And Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the angle, and fortified them.

title: II Chronicles 26:10
text: And he built towers in the desert and digged many cisterns; for he had much cattle, both in the lowland and on the plateau, husbandmen [also] and vinedressers on the mountains and in Carmel; for he loved husbandry.

title: II Chronicles 26:11
text: And Uzziah had an army of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.

title: II Chronicles 26:12
text: The whole number of the chief fathers of the mighty men of valour was two thousand six hundred.

title: II Chronicles 26:13
text: And under their hand was an army-host of three hundred and seven thousand five hundred, that made war with mighty power to help the king against the enemy.

title: II Chronicles 26:14
text: And Uzziah prepared for them, throughout the host, shields, and spears, and helmets, and coats of mail, and bows, and even slinging-stones.

title: II Chronicles 26:15
text: And he made in Jerusalem machines invented by skilful men, to be upon the towers and upon the bulwarks, wherewith to shoot arrows and great stones. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he became strong.

title: II Chronicles 26:16
text: ¶But when he became strong his heart was lifted up to [his] downfall; and he transgressed against Jehovah his God, and went into the temple of Jehovah to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

title: II Chronicles 26:17
text: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him priests of Jehovah, eighty valiant men;

title: II Chronicles 26:18
text: and they withstood Uzziah the king, and said to him, It is not for thee, Uzziah, to burn incense to Jehovah, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast transgressed; neither shall it be for thine honour from Jehovah Elohim.

title: II Chronicles 26:19
text: And Uzziah was wroth; and he had a censer in his hand to burn incense; and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of Jehovah, beside the incense altar.

title: II Chronicles 26:20
text: And Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked upon him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; even he himself hasted to go out, because Jehovah had smitten him.

title: II Chronicles 26:21
text: And Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and dwelt in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of Jehovah. And Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.

title: II Chronicles 26:22
text: And the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz write.

title: II Chronicles 26:23
text: And Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the burial-ground of the kings, for they said, He is a leper. And Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 27:1
text: ¶Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Jerushah, daughter of Zadok.

title: II Chronicles 27:2
text: And he did what was right in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that his father Uzziah had done; only he entered not into the temple of Jehovah. And the people still acted corruptly.

title: II Chronicles 27:3
text: It was he who built the upper gate of the house of Jehovah, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

title: II Chronicles 27:4
