text: And he built cities in the hill-country of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

title: II Chronicles 27:5
text: And he fought against the king of the children of Ammon, and overcame them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year a hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. This the children of Ammon brought again to him also in the second year, and in the third.

title: II Chronicles 27:6
text: And Jotham became strong, for he prepared his ways before Jehovah his God.

title: II Chronicles 27:7
text: And the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

title: II Chronicles 27:8
text: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 27:9
text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David; and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 28:1
text: ¶Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And he did not what was right in the sight of Jehovah, like David his father,

title: II Chronicles 28:2
text: but walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and even made molten images for the Baals;

title: II Chronicles 28:3
text: and he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his sons in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations that Jehovah had dispossessed from before the children of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 28:4
text: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

title: II Chronicles 28:5
text: Therefore Jehovah his God gave him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also given into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

title: II Chronicles 28:6
text: ¶And Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah a hundred and twenty thousand in one day, all valiant men, because they had forsaken Jehovah the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 28:7
text: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah the second to the king.

title: II Chronicles 28:8
text: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took away also much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

title: II Chronicles 28:9
text: But a prophet of Jehovah was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because Jehovah the God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he gave them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reaches up to heaven.

title: II Chronicles 28:10
text: And now ye think to subjugate the children of Judah and Jerusalem as your bondmen and bondwomen. Are there not with you, even with you, trespasses against Jehovah your God?

title: II Chronicles 28:11
text: And now hear me, and send back the captives again, whom ye have taken captive of your brethren; for the fierce wrath of Jehovah is upon you.

title: II Chronicles 28:12
text: And certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Hezekiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

title: II Chronicles 28:13
text: and said to them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither; because, for our guilt before Jehovah, ye think to increase our sins and our trespasses: for our trespass is great, and fierce wrath is upon Israel.

title: II Chronicles 28:14
text: Then the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

title: II Chronicles 28:15
text: And the men that have been expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them on asses, and brought them to Jericho the city of palm-trees, to their brethren. And they returned to Samaria.

title: II Chronicles 28:16
text: ¶At that time king Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

title: II Chronicles 28:17
text: And again the Edomites came and smote Judah, and carried away captives.

title: II Chronicles 28:18
text: And the Philistines invaded the cities of the lowland, and of the south of Judah, and took Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Socho and its dependent villages, and Timnah and its dependent villages, and Guimzo and its dependent villages; and they dwelt there.

title: II Chronicles 28:19
text: For Jehovah humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had made Judah lawless, and transgressed much against Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 28:20
text: And Tilgath-Pilneser king of Assyria came to him, and troubled him, and did not support him.

title: II Chronicles 28:21
text: For Ahaz stripped the house of Jehovah, and the house of the king and of the princes, and gave to the king of Assyria; but he was of no help to him.

title: II Chronicles 28:22
text: And in the time of his trouble he transgressed yet more against Jehovah, this king Ahaz.

title: II Chronicles 28:23
text: And he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, which had smitten him; and he said, Since the gods of the kings of Syria help them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.

title: II Chronicles 28:24
text: And Ahaz gathered the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and closed the doors of the house of Jehovah, and he made for himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 28:25
text: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked to anger Jehovah the God of his fathers.

title: II Chronicles 28:26
text: And the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

title: II Chronicles 28:27
text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, in Jerusalem; but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 29:1
text: ¶Hezekiah began to reign being twenty-five years old; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Abijah, daughter of Zechariah.

title: II Chronicles 29:2
text: And he did what was right in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that David his father had done.

title: II Chronicles 29:3
text: He, in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of Jehovah, and repaired them.

title: II Chronicles 29:4
text: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them into the open place eastward;

title: II Chronicles 29:5
text: and he said to them, Hear me, ye Levites: hallow yourselves now, and hallow the house of Jehovah the God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the sanctuary.

title: II Chronicles 29:6
text: For our fathers have transgressed, and done evil in the sight of Jehovah our God, and have forsaken him and turned away their faces from the habitation of Jehovah, and have turned their backs.

title: II Chronicles 29:7
text: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered up burnt-offerings in the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 29:8
text: Therefore the wrath of Jehovah has been upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to vexation, to desolation, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

title: II Chronicles 29:9
text: And behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

title: II Chronicles 29:10
text: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Jehovah the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.

title: II Chronicles 29:11
text: My sons, be not now negligent; for Jehovah has chosen you to stand before him, to do service unto him, and to be his ministers and incense-burners.

title: II Chronicles 29:12
text: ¶Then the Levites rose up, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalleleel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

title: II Chronicles 29:13
text: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

title: II Chronicles 29:14
text: and of the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

title: II Chronicles 29:15
text: And they gathered their brethren, and hallowed themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king by the words of Jehovah, to cleanse the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 29:16
text: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of Jehovah to cleanse it, and carried forth all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of Jehovah, into the court of the house of Jehovah. And the Levites took it to carry it forth into the brook Kidron.

title: II Chronicles 29:17
text: And they began on the first of the first month to hallow, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the porch of Jehovah; and they hallowed the house of Jehovah eight days; and on the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

title: II Chronicles 29:18
text: And they went in to king Hezekiah, and said, We have cleansed all the house of Jehovah, and the altar of burnt-offering with all its vessels, and the table of the [bread] to be set in rows, and all its vessels;

title: II Chronicles 29:19
text: and all the vessels that king Ahaz in his reign cast away in his transgression have we prepared and hallowed, and behold, they are before the altar of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 29:20
text: ¶And Hezekiah the king arose early, and gathered the princes of the city, and went up to the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 29:21
text: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he-goats for a sin-offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer [them] upon the altar of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 29:22
text: And they slaughtered the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar; and they slaughtered the rams, and sprinkled the blood on the altar; and they slaughtered the lambs, and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

title: II Chronicles 29:23
text: And they brought near the he-goats of the sin-offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them.

title: II Chronicles 29:24
text: And the priests slaughtered them, and they made purification for sin with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel; because for all Israel, said the king, is the burnt-offering and the sin-offering.

title: II Chronicles 29:25
text: And he set the Levites in the house of Jehovah with cymbals, with lutes, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and of Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was of Jehovah through his prophets.

title: II Chronicles 29:26
text: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

title: II Chronicles 29:27
text: And Hezekiah commanded to offer up the burnt-offering on the altar. And at the moment the burnt-offering began, the song of Jehovah began, and the trumpets, accompanied by the instruments of David king of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 29:28
text: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded, all [the time] until the burnt-offering was finished.

title: II Chronicles 29:29
text: And when they had ended offering the burnt-offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves and worshipped.

title: II Chronicles 29:30
text: And king Hezekiah and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise to Jehovah with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and bowed their heads and worshipped.

title: II Chronicles 29:31
text: And Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves to Jehovah, come near and bring sacrifices and thank-offerings into the house of the Lord. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank-offerings; and as many as were of a willing heart, burnt-offerings.

title: II Chronicles 29:32
text: And the number of the burnt-offerings, which the congregation brought, was seventy bullocks, a hundred rams, two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt-offering to Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 29:33
text: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

title: II Chronicles 29:34
text: Only the priests were too few, and they could not flay all the burnt-offerings; therefore their brethren the Levites helped them, until the work was ended, and until the priests had hallowed themselves; for the Levites were more upright in heart to hallow themselves than the priests.

title: II Chronicles 29:35
text: And also the burnt-offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace-offerings, and with the drink-offerings for the burnt-offering. And the service of the house of Jehovah was set in order.

title: II Chronicles 29:36
text: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

title: II Chronicles 30:1
text: ¶And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of Jehovah at Jerusalem, to hold the passover to Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 30:2
text: And the king took counsel, and his princes, and the whole congregation in Jerusalem, to hold the passover in the second month.

title: II Chronicles 30:3
text: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not hallowed themselves in sufficient number, neither had the people been gathered together to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 30:4
text: And the thing pleased the king and the whole congregation.

title: II Chronicles 30:5
text: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to hold the passover to Jehovah the God of Israel, at Jerusalem; because they had not held it for a long time as it was written.

title: II Chronicles 30:6
text: And the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, return to Jehovah the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

title: II Chronicles 30:7
text: And be not like your fathers and like your brethren, who transgressed against Jehovah the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

title: II Chronicles 30:8
text: Now, harden not your necks, as your fathers; yield yourselves to Jehovah, and come to his sanctuary, which he has sanctified for ever; and serve Jehovah your God, that the fierceness of his anger may turn away from you.

title: II Chronicles 30:9
text: For if ye return to Jehovah, your brethren and your children shall find compassion with those that have carried them captive, so that they shall come again unto this land; for Jehovah your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return to him.

title: II Chronicles 30:10
text: And the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun; but they laughed them to scorn and mocked them.

title: II Chronicles 30:11
text: Nevertheless certain of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 30:12
text: The hand of God was also upon Judah to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 30:13
text: ¶And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to hold the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

title: II Chronicles 30:14
text: And they rose up and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem; and they took away all the incense-altars, and cast them into the torrent Kidron.

title: II Chronicles 30:15
text: And they slaughtered the passover on the fourteenth of the second month; and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and hallowed themselves; and they brought the burnt-offerings into the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 30:16
text: And they stood in their place after their custom, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood [receiving it] from the hand of the Levites.

title: II Chronicles 30:17
text: For there were many in the congregation that were not hallowed; therefore the Levites had the charge of the slaughtering of the passover-lambs for every one not clean, to hallow them unto Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 30:18
text: For a multitude of the people, many of Ephraim and Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, and they ate the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them saying, Jehovah, who is good, forgive every one

title: II Chronicles 30:19
text: that has directed his heart to seek God, Jehovah the God of his fathers, although not according to the purification of the sanctuary.

title: II Chronicles 30:20
text: And Jehovah hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

title: II Chronicles 30:21
text: ¶And the children of Israel, that were present at Jerusalem, held the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness; and the Levites and the priests praised Jehovah day by day, with the instruments of praise to Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 30:22
text: And Hezekiah spoke consolingly to all the Levites that had understanding in the good knowledge of Jehovah; and they ate the feast-offerings the seven days, sacrificing peace-offerings, and extolling Jehovah the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 30:23
text: And the whole congregation took counsel to observe other seven days; and they observed the seven days with gladness.

title: II Chronicles 30:24
text: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the congregation as heave-offering: a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests hallowed themselves.

title: II Chronicles 30:25
text: And the whole congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.

title: II Chronicles 30:26
text: And there was great joy in Jerusalem; for since the time of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel, there had not been the like in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 30:27
text: And the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people; and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, to the heavens.

title: II Chronicles 31:1
text: ¶And when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and broke the columns, and hewed down the Asherahs, and demolished the high places and the altars in all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. And all the children of Israel returned every man to his possession, into their cities.

title: II Chronicles 31:2
text: And Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests, and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, as well the priests as the Levites, for burnt-offerings and for peace-offerings, to serve and to give thanks and to praise in the gates of the courts of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 31:3
text: And [he ordered] that the king's portion [should be taken] from his substance for the burnt-offerings: for the morning and evening burnt-offerings, for the burnt-offerings of the sabbaths, and of the new moons, and of the set feasts, as it is written in the law of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 31:4
text: And he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 31:5
text: And as soon as the commandment was published, the children of Israel gave in abundance the firstfruits of corn, new wine and oil and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in abundantly the tithe of all [things].

title: II Chronicles 31:6
text: And the children of Israel and of Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated to Jehovah their God, and laid them by heaps.

title: II Chronicles 31:7
text: In the third month they began to lay the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

title: II Chronicles 31:8
text: And Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, and they blessed Jehovah, and his people Israel.

title: II Chronicles 31:9
text: And Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

title: II Chronicles 31:10
text: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok spoke to him and said, Since they began to bring the heave-offerings into the house of Jehovah, we have eaten and been satisfied and have left plenty; for Jehovah has blessed his people; and what is left is this great store.

title: II Chronicles 31:11
text: ¶And Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of Jehovah; and they prepared [them],

title: II Chronicles 31:12
text: and brought in the heave-offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully; and over these Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was second.

title: II Chronicles 31:13
text: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Jismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the command of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 31:14
text: And Kore the son of Jimnah the Levite, the doorkeeper toward the east, was over the voluntary-offerings of God, to distribute the heave-offerings of Jehovah, and the most holy things.

title: II Chronicles 31:15
text: And under him were Eden and Miniamin and Jeshua and Shemaiah, Amariah and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in [their] set trust, to make distributions to their brethren by [their] divisions, to the great as to the small,

title: II Chronicles 31:16
text: besides those from three years old and upward who as males were entered in the genealogical register, --all that came into the house of Jehovah, as the duty of every day required, for their service in their charges, according to their divisions,

title: II Chronicles 31:17
text: --both to the priests enregistered according to their fathers' houses, and to the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges, by their divisions;

title: II Chronicles 31:18
text: and to all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, the whole congregation of those entered in the register; for in their trust they hallowed themselves to be holy.

title: II Chronicles 31:19
text: And for the sons of Aaron the priests who were in the country, in the suburbs of their cities, there were, in every several city, men expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all the Levites that were entered in the register.

title: II Chronicles 31:20
text: And thus did Hezekiah throughout Judah, and wrought what was good and right and true before Jehovah his God.

title: II Chronicles 31:21
text: And in every work that he undertook in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.

title: II Chronicles 32:1
text: ¶After these things and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fortified cities, and thought to break into them.

title: II Chronicles 32:2
text: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was minded to fight against Jerusalem,

title: II Chronicles 32:3
text: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the fountains of waters that were outside the city; and they helped him.

title: II Chronicles 32:4
text: And there was gathered together much people, and they stopped all the fountains, and the torrent that flows through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come and find much water?

title: II Chronicles 32:5
text: And he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, and [built] another wall outside, and fortified the Millo of the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

title: II Chronicles 32:6
text: And he set captains of war over the people, and assembled them to him on the open place at the gate of the city, and spoke consolingly to them saying,

title: II Chronicles 32:7
text: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him; for there are more with us than with him:

title: II Chronicles 32:8
text: with him is an arm of flesh, but with us is Jehovah our God to help us and to fight our battles. And the people depended upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 32:9
text: ¶After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem (but he himself was before Lachish, and all his power with him), unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,

title: II Chronicles 32:10
text: Thus says Sennacherib king of Assyria: On what do ye rely that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

title: II Chronicles 32:11
text: Does not Hezekiah persuade you, to give yourselves over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, Jehovah our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

title: II Chronicles 32:12
text: Has not the same Hezekiah removed his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem saying, Ye shall worship before *one* altar, and burn incense upon it?

title: II Chronicles 32:13
text: Do ye not know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the countries? Were the gods of the nations of the countries in any wise able to deliver their country out of my hand?

title: II Chronicles 32:14
text: Who is there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers have utterly destroyed, that was able to deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

title: II Chronicles 32:15
text: And now, let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you in this manner, neither yet believe him; for no +god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, nor out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of my hand?

title: II Chronicles 32:16
text: And his servants spoke yet more against Jehovah, the [true] God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

title: II Chronicles 32:17
text: And he wrote a letter to rail at Jehovah the God of Israel, and to speak against him saying, As the gods of the nations of the countries have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of my hand.

title: II Chronicles 32:18
text: And they cried with a loud voice in the Jewish [language] to the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

title: II Chronicles 32:19
text: And they spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, the work of man's hand.

title: II Chronicles 32:20
text: And because of this, king Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz prayed and cried to heaven.

title: II Chronicles 32:21
text: And Jehovah sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the princes and the captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. And he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels made him fall there with the sword.

title: II Chronicles 32:22
text: And Jehovah saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all, and protected them on every side.

title: II Chronicles 32:23
text: And many brought gifts unto Jehovah to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah; and he was thenceforth magnified in the sight of all the nations.

title: II Chronicles 32:24
text: ¶In those days Hezekiah was sick unto death, and he prayed to Jehovah; and he spoke to him and gave him a sign.

title: II Chronicles 32:25
text: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit [done] to him, for his heart was lifted up; and there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 32:26
text: And Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of Jehovah came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

title: II Chronicles 32:27
text: And Hezekiah had very much riches and honour; and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant vessels;

title: II Chronicles 32:28
text: storehouses also for the increase of corn and new wine and oil, and stalls for all manner of beasts, and [he procured] flocks for the stalls.

title: II Chronicles 32:29
text: And he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God gave him very much substance.

title: II Chronicles 32:30
text: And he, Hezekiah, stopped the upper outlet of the waters of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

title: II Chronicles 32:31
text: However in [the matter of] the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all [that was] in his heart.

title: II Chronicles 32:32
text: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

title: II Chronicles 32:33
text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the highest place of the sepulchres of the sons of David; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 33:1
text: ¶Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 33:2
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah, like the abominations of the nations that Jehovah had dispossessed from before the children of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:3
text: And he built again the high places that Hezekiah his father had broken down; and he reared up altars to the Baals, and made Asherahs, and worshipped all the host of heaven and served them.

title: II Chronicles 33:4
text: And he built altars in the house of Jehovah, of which Jehovah had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

title: II Chronicles 33:5
text: And he built altars to all the host of heaven in both courts of the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 33:6
text: He also caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he used magic and divination and sorcery, and appointed necromancers and soothsayers: he wrought evil beyond measure in the sight of Jehovah, to provoke him to anger.

title: II Chronicles 33:7
text: And he set the graven image of the idol that he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever;

title: II Chronicles 33:8
text: neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land that I have appointed to your fathers; if they will only take heed to do all that I commanded them through Moses, according to all the law and the statutes and the ordinances.

title: II Chronicles 33:9
text: And Manasseh led Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem astray, to do more evil than the nations that Jehovah had destroyed from before the children of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:10
text: And Jehovah spoke to Manasseh and to his people; but they did not hearken.

title: II Chronicles 33:11
text: ¶And Jehovah brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh with fetters, and bound him with chains of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 33:12
text: And when he was in affliction, he besought Jehovah his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

title: II Chronicles 33:13
text: and prayed to him. And he was intreated of him and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Jehovah, he was God.

title: II Chronicles 33:14
text: And after this he built the outer wall of the city of David, on the west, toward Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance of the fish-gate, and carried it round Ophel, and raised it up a very great height; and he put captains of war in all the fortified cities of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 33:15
text: And he removed the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of Jehovah, and all the altars that he had built on the mount of the house of Jehovah and in Jerusalem, and cast [them] out of the city.

title: II Chronicles 33:16
text: And he reinstated the altar of Jehovah, and sacrificed on it peace-offerings and thank-offerings, and commanded Judah to serve Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:17
text: Nevertheless, the people sacrificed still on the high places, although to Jehovah their God only.

title: II Chronicles 33:18
text: And the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers that spoke to him in the name of Jehovah the God of Israel, behold, they [are written] in the acts of the kings of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:19
text: And his prayer, and [how God] was intreated of him, and all his sin and his unfaithfulness, and the places in which he built high places, and set up Asherahs and graven images, before he was humbled, behold, they are written among the words of Hozai.

title: II Chronicles 33:20
text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 33:21
text: ¶Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 33:22
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah, as Manasseh his father had done; and Amon sacrificed to all the graven images that Manasseh his father had made, and served them.

title: II Chronicles 33:23
text: And he did not humble himself before Jehovah, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; for he, Amon, multiplied trespass.

title: II Chronicles 33:24
text: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

title: II Chronicles 33:25
text: But the people of the land smote all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 34:1
text: ¶Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:2
text: And he did what was right in the sight of Jehovah, and walked in the ways of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand nor to the left.

title: II Chronicles 34:3
text: And in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the Asherahs, and the graven images, and the molten images.

title: II Chronicles 34:4
text: And they broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and the sun-pillars that were on high above them he cut down; and the Asherahs and the graven images and the molten images he broke in pieces, and made dust [of them] and strewed it upon the graves of those that had sacrificed to them;

title: II Chronicles 34:5
text: and he burned the bones of the priests upon their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:6
text: And [so did he] in the cities of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon, even to Naphtali, in their ruins round about;

title: II Chronicles 34:7
text: and he broke down the altars, and beat the Asherahs and the graven images into powder, and cut down all the sun-pillars throughout the land of Israel, and returned to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:8
text: ¶And in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the chronicler, to repair the house of Jehovah his God.

title: II Chronicles 34:9
text: And they came to Hilkijah the high priest, and they delivered [to them] the money that had been brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:10
text: And they gave [it] into the hand of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of Jehovah; and they gave it to the workmen who wrought in the house of Jehovah to reinstate and repair the house:

title: II Chronicles 34:11
text: they gave [it] to the carpenters and the builders, to buy hewn stone, and timber for the joists, and to floor the houses that the kings of Judah had destroyed.

title: II Chronicles 34:12
text: And the men did the work faithfully. And over them were appointed Jahath and Obadiah, Levites, of the children of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the children of the Kohathites, for the oversight; and all these Levites were skilled in instruments of music.

title: II Chronicles 34:13
text: They were also over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that worked in any manner of service. And of the Levites were the scribes, and officers, and doorkeepers.

title: II Chronicles 34:14
text: ¶And when they brought out the money that had been brought into the house of Jehovah, Hilkijah the priest found the book of the law of Jehovah by Moses.

title: II Chronicles 34:15
text: Then Hilkijah spoke and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of Jehovah. And Hilkijah gave the book to Shaphan.

title: II Chronicles 34:16
text: And Shaphan carried the book to the king. And moreover he brought the king word again saying, All that was committed to the hand of thy servants, they do;

title: II Chronicles 34:17
text: and they have emptied out the money that was found in the house of Jehovah, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and into the hand of the workmen.

title: II Chronicles 34:18
text: And Shaphan the scribe informed the king saying, Hilkijah the priest has given me a book. And Shaphan read out of it before the king.

title: II Chronicles 34:19
text: And it came to pass when the king heard the words of the law, that he rent his garments.

title: II Chronicles 34:20
text: And the king commanded Hilkijah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king, saying,

title: II Chronicles 34:21
text: Go, inquire of Jehovah for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book which is found; for great is the wrath of Jehovah that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of Jehovah, to do according to all that is written in this book.

title: II Chronicles 34:22
text: And Hilkijah and they that the king [had appointed] went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokehath, son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe: now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the second quarter [of the town]; and they spoke with her to that effect.

title: II Chronicles 34:23
text: And she said to them, Thus saith Jehovah the God of Israel: Tell the man that sent you to me,

title: II Chronicles 34:24
text: Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 34:25
text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my fury shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

title: II Chronicles 34:26
text: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Jehovah, thus shall ye say to him: Thus saith Jehovah the God of Israel touching the words which thou hast heard:

title: II Chronicles 34:27
text: Because thy heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy garments and weep before me, I also have heard [thee], saith Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 34:28
text: Behold, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof. And they brought the king word again.

title: II Chronicles 34:29
text: ¶And the king sent and gathered all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:30
text: And the king went up into the house of Jehovah, and all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests and the Levites, and all the people, great and small; and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which had been found in the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 34:31
text: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before Jehovah, to walk after Jehovah, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that are written in this book.

title: II Chronicles 34:32
text: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand [to it]. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 34:33
text: And Josiah removed all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made to serve all that were found in Israel, --to serve Jehovah their God: all his days they did not depart from following Jehovah, the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 35:1
text: ¶And Josiah held a passover to Jehovah in Jerusalem; and they slaughtered the passover on the fourteenth of the first month.

title: II Chronicles 35:2
text: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 35:3
text: And he said to the Levites, that taught all Israel, [and] who were holy to Jehovah, Put the holy ark in the house that Solomon the son of David, king of Israel, built; ye have not to carry it upon your shoulders. Serve now Jehovah your God, and his people Israel;

title: II Chronicles 35:4
text: and prepare yourselves by your fathers' houses, in your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son;

title: II Chronicles 35:5
text: and stand in the sanctuary for the classes of the fathers' houses, for your brethren, the children of the people, and [according] to the divisions of the fathers' houses of the Levites;

title: II Chronicles 35:6
text: and slaughter the passover, and hallow yourselves, and prepare it for your brethren, that they may do according to the word of Jehovah through Moses.

title: II Chronicles 35:7
text: And Josiah gave for the children of the people a heave-offering of the flocks, lambs and goats, all for the passover-offerings, for all that were present--to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king's substance.

title: II Chronicles 35:8
text: And his princes gave a voluntary heave-offering for the people, for the priests, and for the Levites: Hilkijah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the passover-offerings two thousand six hundred [small cattle] and three hundred oxen;

title: II Chronicles 35:9
text: and Conaniah, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave as heave-offering to the Levites for the passover-offerings five thousand [small cattle] and five hundred oxen.

title: II Chronicles 35:10
text: And the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their divisions, according to the king's commandment.

title: II Chronicles 35:11
text: And they slaughtered the passover, and the priests sprinkled [the blood] from their hand, and the Levites flayed them.

title: II Chronicles 35:12
text: And they set apart the burnt-offerings to give them to the classes of the fathers' houses of the children of the people, to present them to Jehovah, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so [did they] with the oxen.

title: II Chronicles 35:13
text: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance; and the consecrated things they boiled in pots and in cauldrons and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the children of the people.

title: II Chronicles 35:14
text: And afterwards they made ready for themselves and for the priests; because the priests, the sons of Aaron, [were engaged] in offering up the burnt-offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.

title: II Chronicles 35:15
text: And the singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the doorkeepers were at every gate; they had not to depart from their service, for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

title: II Chronicles 35:16
text: And all the service of Jehovah was prepared the same day, to hold the passover, and to offer burnt-offerings on the altar of Jehovah according to the commandment of king Josiah.

title: II Chronicles 35:17
text: And the children of Israel that were present held the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

title: II Chronicles 35:18
text: And there was no passover like to that holden in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel hold such a passover as Josiah held, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 35:19
text: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover holden.

title: II Chronicles 35:20
text: ¶After all this, when Josiah had arranged the house, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Karkemish at the Euphrates; and Josiah went out against him.

title: II Chronicles 35:21
text: And he sent messengers to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house with which I have war; and God has told me to make haste: keep aloof from God who is with me, that he destroy thee not.

title: II Chronicles 35:22
text: But Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight against him; and he hearkened not to the words of Necho from the mouth of God; and he came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

title: II Chronicles 35:23
text: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away, for I am sore wounded.

title: II Chronicles 35:24
text: And his servants took him out from the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem. And he died, and was buried in the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

title: II Chronicles 35:25
text: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah; and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance for Israel. And behold, they are written in the lamentations.

title: II Chronicles 35:26
text: And the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his good deeds, according to that which is written in the law of Jehovah,

title: II Chronicles 35:27
text: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

title: II Chronicles 36:1
text: ¶And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead, in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:2
text: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:3
text: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and imposed a fine upon the land of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

title: II Chronicles 36:4
text: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 36:5
text: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; and he did evil in the sight of Jehovah his God.

title: II Chronicles 36:6
text: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him with chains of brass to carry him to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:7
text: And Nebuchadnezzar carried [part] of the vessels of the house of Jehovah to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:8
text: And the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. And Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

title: II Chronicles 36:9
text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem; and he did evil in the sight of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 36:10
text: And at the turn of the year king Nebuchadnezzar sent and had him brought to Babylon, with the precious vessels of the house of Jehovah; and he made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:11
text: ¶Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:12
text: And he did evil in the sight of Jehovah his God; he humbled not himself before the prophet Jeremiah speaking from the mouth of Jehovah.

title: II Chronicles 36:13
text: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him take oath by God; and he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from returning to Jehovah the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 36:14
text: All the chiefs of the priests also, and the people, increased their transgressions, according to all the abominations of the nations; and they defiled the house of Jehovah which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:15
text: And Jehovah the God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending; because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling-place.

title: II Chronicles 36:16
text: But they mocked at the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until the fury of Jehovah rose against his people, and there was no remedy.

title: II Chronicles 36:17
text: And he brought up [against] them the king of the Chaldees, and slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and spared not young man nor maiden, old man nor him of hoary head: he gave [them] all into his hand.

title: II Chronicles 36:18
text: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of Jehovah, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, he brought all to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:19
text: And they burned the house of God, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and burned all the palaces thereof with fire, and all the precious vessels thereof were given up to destruction.

title: II Chronicles 36:20
text: And them that had escaped from the sword he carried away to Babylon; and they became servants to him and his sons, until the reign of the kingdom of Persia;

title: II Chronicles 36:21
text: to fulfil the word of Jehovah by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed its sabbaths. All the days of its desolation it kept sabbath, to fulfil seventy years.

title: II Chronicles 36:22
text: ¶And in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of Jehovah by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Jehovah stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, and he made a proclamation throughout his kingdom, and also in writing, saying,

title: II Chronicles 36:23
text: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: All the kingdoms of the earth has Jehovah the God of the heavens given to me, and he has charged me to build him a house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whosoever there is among you of all his people, Jehovah his God be with him, and let him go up.

title: Ezra 1:1
text: ¶And in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of Jehovah by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Jehovah stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, and he made a proclamation throughout his kingdom, and also in writing, saying,

title: Ezra 1:2
text: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: All the kingdoms of the earth has Jehovah the God of the heavens given to me, and he has charged me to build him a house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

title: Ezra 1:3
text: Whosoever there is among you of all his people, his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of Jehovah the God of Israel--he is God--which is at Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:4
text: And whosoever remains in any place where he sojourns, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, besides the voluntary offering for the house of God which is at Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:5
text: ¶And the chief fathers of Judah and Benjamin rose up, and the priests, and the Levites, even all those whose spirit God had stirred, to go up to build the house of Jehovah which is at Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:6
text: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with articles of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, besides all that was willingly offered.

title: Ezra 1:7
text: And king Cyrus brought forth the vessels of the house of Jehovah, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem and had put in the house of his god.

title: Ezra 1:8
text: And Cyrus king of Persia brought them forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

title: Ezra 1:9
text: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine-and-twenty knives,

title: Ezra 1:10
text: thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second [sort] four hundred and ten, [and] other vessels a thousand.

title: Ezra 1:11
text: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. The whole did Sheshbazzar bring up, when they of the captivity were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 2:1
text: ¶And these are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one to his city,

title: Ezra 2:2
text: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Saraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

title: Ezra 2:3
text: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred and seventy-two.

title: Ezra 2:4
text: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.

title: Ezra 2:5
text: The children of Arah, seven hundred and seventy-five.

title: Ezra 2:6
text: The children of Pahath-Moab, of the children of Jeshua [and] Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

title: Ezra 2:7
text: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:8
text: The children of Zattu, nine hundred and forty-five.

title: Ezra 2:9
text: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

title: Ezra 2:10
text: The children of Bani, six hundred and forty-two.

title: Ezra 2:11
text: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:12
text: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred and twenty-two.

title: Ezra 2:13
text: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-six.

title: Ezra 2:14
text: The children of Bigvai, two thousand and fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:15
text: The children of Adin, four hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:16
text: The children of Ater of [the family of] Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

title: Ezra 2:17
text: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:18
text: The children of Jorah, a hundred and twelve.

title: Ezra 2:19
text: The children of Hashum, two hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:20
text: The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.

title: Ezra 2:21
text: The children of Bethlehem, a hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:22
text: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:23
text: The men of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.

title: Ezra 2:24
text: The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.

title: Ezra 2:25
text: The children of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three.

title: Ezra 2:26
text: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.

title: Ezra 2:27
text: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty-two.

title: Ezra 2:28
text: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:29
text: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:30
text: The children of Magbish, a hundred and fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:31
text: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:32
text: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

title: Ezra 2:33
text: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-five.

title: Ezra 2:34
text: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.

title: Ezra 2:35
text: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred and thirty.

title: Ezra 2:36
text: ¶The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.

title: Ezra 2:37
text: The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:38
text: The children of Pashhur, a thousand two hundred and forty-seven.

title: Ezra 2:39
text: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

title: Ezra 2:40
text: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

title: Ezra 2:41
text: The singers: the children of Asaph, a hundred and twenty-eight.

title: Ezra 2:42
text: The children of the doorkeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all a hundred and thirty-nine.

title: Ezra 2:43
text: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

title: Ezra 2:44
text: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

title: Ezra 2:45
text: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

title: Ezra 2:46
text: the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,

title: Ezra 2:47
text: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

title: Ezra 2:48
text: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

title: Ezra 2:49
text: the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah, the children of Besai,

title: Ezra 2:50
text: the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephusim,

title: Ezra 2:51
text: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

title: Ezra 2:52
text: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

title: Ezra 2:53
text: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,

title: Ezra 2:54
text: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

title: Ezra 2:55
text: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,

title: Ezra 2:56
text: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

title: Ezra 2:57
text: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth-Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

title: Ezra 2:58
text: All the Nethinim and the children of Solomon's servants, three hundred and ninety-two.

title: Ezra 2:59
text: And these are they that went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub-Addan, Immer; but they could not shew their fathers' house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.

title: Ezra 2:60
text: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobijah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:61
text: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

title: Ezra 2:62
text: These sought their genealogical register, but they were not found; therefore were they, as polluted, removed from the priesthood.

title: Ezra 2:63
text: And the Tirshatha said to them that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

title: Ezra 2:64
text: ¶The whole congregation together was forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,

title: Ezra 2:65
text: besides their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.

title: Ezra 2:66
text: Their horses were seven hundred and thirty-six; their mules two hundred and forty-five;

title: Ezra 2:67
text: their camels four hundred and thirty-five; the asses six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

title: Ezra 2:68
text: And some of the chief fathers, when they came to the house of Jehovah which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in its place.

title: Ezra 2:69
text: They gave after their ability to the treasure of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, and five thousand pounds of silver, and one hundred priests' coats.

title: Ezra 2:70
text: And the priests, and the Levites, and [some] of the people, and the singers, and the doorkeepers, and the Nethinim dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

title: Ezra 3:1
text: ¶And when the seventh month came, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered together as one man to Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 3:2
text: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer up burnt-offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

title: Ezra 3:3
text: And they set the altar on its base; for fear was upon them because of the people of the countries; and they offered up burnt-offerings on it to Jehovah, the morning and evening burnt-offerings.

title: Ezra 3:4
text: And they held the feast of tabernacles as it is written, and [offered] daily burnt-offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;

title: Ezra 3:5
text: and afterwards the continual burnt-offering, and those of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of Jehovah that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a voluntary offering to Jehovah.

title: Ezra 3:6
text: From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer up burnt-offerings to Jehovah. But the foundation of the temple of Jehovah was not [yet] laid.

title: Ezra 3:7
text: And they gave money to the masons and to the carpenters; and meat and drink and oil to the Zidonians and to the Tyrians, to bring cedar-trees from Lebanon to the sea at Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

title: Ezra 3:8
text: ¶And in the second year of their coming to the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem; and they appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to superintend the work of the house of Jehovah.

title: Ezra 3:9
text: And Jeshua stood up, his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, as one [man], to superintend the workmen in the house of God; [also] the sons of Henadad, their sons and their brethren, the Levites.

title: Ezra 3:10
text: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of Jehovah, they set the priests in their apparel, with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph, with cymbals, to praise Jehovah according to the directions of David king of Israel.

title: Ezra 3:11
text: And they sang alternately together in praising and giving thanks to Jehovah: For he is good, for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout to the praise of Jehovah, because the foundation of the house of Jehovah was laid.

title: Ezra 3:12
text: But many of the priests and Levites and chief fathers, the ancient men that had seen the first house, wept with a loud voice, [when] the foundation of this house was laid in their sight; and many shouted aloud for joy.

title: Ezra 3:13
text: And the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people; for the people shouted with a great shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

title: Ezra 4:1
text: ¶And the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building the temple to Jehovah the God of Israel;

title: Ezra 4:2
text: and they came to Zerubbabel and to the chief fathers, and said to them, We would build with you; for we seek your God, as ye; and we have sacrificed to him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up hither.

title: Ezra 4:3
text: But Zerubbabel and Jeshua and the rest of the chief fathers of Israel said to them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build a house to our God, but we alone will build to Jehovah the God of Israel, as king Cyrus, the king of Persia, has commanded us.

title: Ezra 4:4
text: And the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building;

title: Ezra 4:5
text: and they hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

title: Ezra 4:6
text: ¶And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 4:7
text: And in the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions, wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Aramaic, and interpreted in Aramaic.

title: Ezra 4:8
text: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king after this sort:

title: Ezra 4:9
text: Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the Dinaites, and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,

title: Ezra 4:10
text: and the rest of the peoples whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the cities of Samaria, and the rest [of the country] on this side the river, and so forth.

title: Ezra 4:11
text: This is the copy of the letter that they sent to him: To Artaxerxes the king: Thy servants the men on this side the river, and so forth.

title: Ezra 4:12
text: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from thee unto us have come to Jerusalem; they are building the rebellious and the bad city, and they complete the walls and join up the foundations.

title: Ezra 4:13
text: Be it known therefore unto the king, that, if this city be built and the walls be completed, they will not pay tribute, tax, and toll, and in the end it will bring damage to the kings.

title: Ezra 4:14
text: Now, since we eat the salt of the palace, and it is not right for us to see the king's injury, therefore have we sent and informed the king;

title: Ezra 4:15
text: that search may be made in the book of the annals of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the annals and know that this city is a rebellious city, which has done damage to kings and provinces, and that they have raised sedition within the same of old time, for which cause this city was destroyed.

title: Ezra 4:16
text: We inform the king that if this city be built and its walls be completed, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.

title: Ezra 4:17
text: ¶The king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and the other places beyond the river: Peace, and so forth.

title: Ezra 4:18
text: The letter that ye sent to us has been read before me distinctly.

title: Ezra 4:19
text: And I gave orders, and search has been made, and it has been found that this city of old time has made insurrection against the kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been raised therein.

title: Ezra 4:20
text: And there have been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all beyond the river; and tribute, tax, and toll were paid to them.

title: Ezra 4:21
text: Now give order to make these men to cease, and that this city be not built, until the order shall be given from me;

title: Ezra 4:22
text: and take heed that ye fail not to do this: why should harm grow to the damage of the kings?

title: Ezra 4:23
text: As soon as the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them cease by force and power.

title: Ezra 4:24
text: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem; and it ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

title: Ezra 5:1
text: ¶Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem; in the name of the God of Israel [did they prophesy] to them.

title: Ezra 5:2
text: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, who helped them.

title: Ezra 5:3
text: ¶At that time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus to them: Who gave you orders to build this house and to complete this wall?

title: Ezra 5:4
text: And they said to them after this manner: What are the names of the men that build this building?

title: Ezra 5:5
text: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, and they did not make them cease till the matter came to Darius; and then they returned answer by letter concerning it.

title: Ezra 5:6
text: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, who were on this side the river, sent to Darius the king.

title: Ezra 5:7
text: They sent a report to him in which was written thus: To Darius the king, all peace!

title: Ezra 5:8
text: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work is being carried on with diligence, and prospers in their hand.

title: Ezra 5:9
text: Then asked we those elders: thus we said to them, Who gave you orders to build this house and to complete this wall?

title: Ezra 5:10
text: We asked their names also, to inform thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.

title: Ezra 5:11
text: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of the heavens and the earth, and build the house that was built these many years ago; and a great king of Israel built and completed it.

title: Ezra 5:12
text: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of the heavens to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, and he destroyed this house, and carried the people away unto Babylon.

title: Ezra 5:13
text: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, king Cyrus gave orders to build this house of God.

title: Ezra 5:14
text: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was at Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, those did king Cyrus take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one Sheshbazzar by name, whom he had appointed governor.

title: Ezra 5:15
text: And he said to him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is at Jerusalem, and let the house of God be built in its place.

title: Ezra 5:16
text: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, [and] laid the foundation of the house of God which is at Jerusalem; and since that time even until now has it been in building, and it is not completed.

title: Ezra 5:17
text: And now, if it seem good to the king, let search be made in the king's treasure-house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that orders were given by king Cyrus to build this house of God at Jerusalem; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.

title: Ezra 6:1
text: ¶Then king Darius gave orders, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

title: Ezra 6:2
text: And there was found at Achmetha in the fortress that is in the province of Media a roll, and therein was a record thus written:

title: Ezra 6:3
text: In the first year of king Cyrus, king Cyrus made a decree [concerning] the house of God at Jerusalem: Let the house be built for a place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be solidly laid; its height sixty cubits, its breadth sixty cubits,

title: Ezra 6:4
text: [with] three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber; and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:

title: Ezra 6:5
text: and also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that is at Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought again to the temple that is at Jerusalem, in their place; and thou shalt put [them] in the house of God.

title: Ezra 6:6
text: Therefore Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:

title: Ezra 6:7
text: let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

title: Ezra 6:8
text: Moreover, I give orders what ye shall do to these elders of the Jews, for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, of the tribute beyond the river, expenses be diligently given to these men, that they be not hindered.

title: Ezra 6:9
text: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks and rams and lambs, for the burnt-offerings to the God of the heavens, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests that are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail;

title: Ezra 6:10
text: that they may present sweet odours to the God of the heavens, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.

title: Ezra 6:11
text: Also I have given order that whosoever shall alter this rescript, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon, and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

title: Ezra 6:12
text: And the God that has caused his name to dwell there overthrow every king and people that shall put forth their hand to alter [or] to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have given [this] order; let it be done diligently.

title: Ezra 6:13
text: ¶Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, because of that which king Darius had sent, did so diligently.

title: Ezra 6:14
text: And the elders of the Jews built; and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they built and completed [it] according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

title: Ezra 6:15
text: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of king Darius.

title: Ezra 6:16
text: And the children of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy;

title: Ezra 6:17
text: and they presented at the dedication of this house of God a hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and for a sin-offering for all Israel, twelve he-goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

title: Ezra 6:18
text: And they set the priests in their classes, and the Levites in their divisions, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem: as it is written in the book of Moses.

title: Ezra 6:19
text: And the children of the captivity held the passover upon the fourteenth of the first month.

title: Ezra 6:20
text: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves as one [man]: they were all pure; and they killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.

title: Ezra 6:21
text: And the children of Israel that were come back out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land, to seek Jehovah the God of Israel, did eat;

title: Ezra 6:22
text: and they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; for Jehovah had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

title: Ezra 7:1
