text: ¶And after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes, king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkijah,

title: Ezra 7:2
text: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

title: Ezra 7:3
text: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

title: Ezra 7:4
text: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

title: Ezra 7:5
text: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest,

title: Ezra 7:6
text: --this Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which Jehovah the God of Israel had given. And the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of Jehovah his God upon him.

title: Ezra 7:7
text: (And there went up [some] of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the doorkeepers, and the Nethinim, to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.)

title: Ezra 7:8
text: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

title: Ezra 7:9
text: For upon the first of the first month the project of going up from Babylon was determined on, and on the first of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.

title: Ezra 7:10
text: For Ezra had directed his heart to seek the law of Jehovah and to do it, and to teach in Israel the statutes and the ordinances.

title: Ezra 7:11
text: ¶And this is the copy of the letter that king Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, a scribe of the words of the commandments of Jehovah, and of his statutes to Israel:

title: Ezra 7:12
text: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, an accomplished scribe of the law of the God of the heavens, and so forth.

title: Ezra 7:13
text: I have given orders that all they of the people of Israel, and of their priests and the Levites, in my realm, who are disposed to go to Jerusalem, go with thee.

title: Ezra 7:14
text: Because thou art sent by the king, and by his seven counsellors, to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thy hand;

title: Ezra 7:15
text: and to carry the silver and gold which the king and his counsellors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is at Jerusalem,

title: Ezra 7:16
text: and all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, besides the voluntary offering of the people, and of the priests, who offer willingly for the house of their God which is at Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 7:17
text: Therefore thou shalt buy diligently with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their oblations and their drink-offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is at Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 7:18
text: And whatever shall seem good to thee and to thy brethren to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do according to the will of your God.

title: Ezra 7:19
text: And the vessels that have been given thee for the service of the house of thy God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 7:20
text: And whatever more shall be needful for the house of thy God which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.

title: Ezra 7:21
text: And I, I Artaxerxes the king, do give orders to all the treasurers that are beyond the river, that whatever Ezra the priest and scribe of the law of the God of the heavens shall require of you, it be done diligently,

title: Ezra 7:22
text: unto a hundred talents of silver, and to a hundred measures of wheat, and to a hundred baths of wine, and to a hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing [how much].

title: Ezra 7:23
text: Whatever is commanded by the God of the heavens, let it be carefully done for the house of the God of the heavens; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

title: Ezra 7:24
text: Also we inform you, as regards all the priests and Levites, singers, doorkeepers, Nethinim, and ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, tax, and toll upon them.

title: Ezra 7:25
text: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, which is in thy hand, set magistrates and judges who may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye him that knows [them] not.

title: Ezra 7:26
text: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed diligently upon him, whether unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

title: Ezra 7:27
text: ¶Blessed be Jehovah the God of our fathers, who has put [such a thing] as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of Jehovah which is at Jerusalem;

title: Ezra 7:28
text: and has extended mercy to me before the king and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened, as the hand of Jehovah my God was upon me; and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

title: Ezra 8:1
text: ¶And these are the chief fathers, and their genealogy, who went up with me from Babylon in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

title: Ezra 8:2
text: Of the children of Phinehas, Gershom; of the children of Ithamar, Daniel; of the children of David, Hattush;

title: Ezra 8:3
text: of the children of Shecaniah, of the children of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were registered by genealogy of the males a hundred and fifty.

title: Ezra 8:4
text: Of the children of Pahath-Moab, Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

title: Ezra 8:5
text: Of the children of Shechaniah, the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

title: Ezra 8:6
text: And of the children of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

title: Ezra 8:7
text: And of the children of Elam, Isaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

title: Ezra 8:8
text: And of the children of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him eighty males.

title: Ezra 8:9
text: Of the children of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

title: Ezra 8:10
text: And of the children of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah, and with him a hundred and sixty males.

title: Ezra 8:11
text: And of the children of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight males.

title: Ezra 8:12
text: And of the children of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him a hundred and ten males.

title: Ezra 8:13
text: And of the children of Adonikam, the last ones, whose names are these: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them sixty males.

title: Ezra 8:14
text: And of the children of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

title: Ezra 8:15
text: And I gathered them together at the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days; and I surveyed the people and the priests, and found none of the sons of Levi there.

title: Ezra 8:16
text: And I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men, and for Joiarib and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

title: Ezra 8:17
text: And I gave them a commission to Iddo the chief, at the place Casiphia, and I put words in their mouths to say to Iddo [and] his brethren the Nethinim, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

title: Ezra 8:18
text: And by the good hand of our God upon us, they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely, Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

title: Ezra 8:19
text: and Hashabiah, and with him Isaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

title: Ezra 8:20
text: and of the Nethinim, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim: all of them were expressed by name.

title: Ezra 8:21
text: ¶And I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

title: Ezra 8:22
text: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way; for we had spoken to the king saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his anger is against all them that forsake him.

title: Ezra 8:23
text: And we fasted, and besought our God for this; and he was entreated of us.

title: Ezra 8:24
text: ¶And I separated twelve of the chiefs of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,

title: Ezra 8:25
text: and I weighed to them the silver and the gold and the vessels, the heave-offering for the house of our God, which the king and his counsellors and his princes, and all Israel present, had offered.

title: Ezra 8:26
text: And I weighed into their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver; and silver vessels a hundred talents, [and] of gold a hundred talents;

title: Ezra 8:27
text: and twenty basons of gold, of a thousand darics; and two vessels of shining copper, precious as gold.

title: Ezra 8:28
text: And I said to them, Ye are holy unto Jehovah; the vessels also are holy; and the silver and the gold is a voluntary offering to Jehovah the God of your fathers.

title: Ezra 8:29
text: Watch and keep [them] until ye weigh them before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites, and the chiefs of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of Jehovah.

title: Ezra 8:30
text: And the priests and the Levites received by weight the silver and the gold and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.

title: Ezra 8:31
text: ¶And we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth of the first month, to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.

title: Ezra 8:32
text: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

title: Ezra 8:33
text: And on the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Urijah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites:

title: Ezra 8:34
text: the whole by number and by weight; and all the weight was written down at that time.

title: Ezra 8:35
text: The children of those that had been carried away, who had come out of the captivity, presented burnt-offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, twelve he-goats for a sin-offering: all for a burnt-offering to Jehovah.

title: Ezra 8:36
text: And they delivered the king's edicts to the king's satraps, and to the governors on this side the river. And they furthered the people and the house of God.

title: Ezra 9:1
text: ¶Now when these things were completed, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, according to their abominations, [even] of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites;

title: Ezra 9:2
text: for they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, and have mingled the holy seed with the peoples of the lands; and the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this unfaithfulness.

title: Ezra 9:3
text: And when I heard this thing, I rent my mantle and my garment, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down overwhelmed.

title: Ezra 9:4
text: Then were assembled to me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the unfaithfulness of those that had been carried away; and I sat overwhelmed until the evening oblation.

title: Ezra 9:5
text: ¶And at the evening oblation I arose up from my humiliation; and with my mantle and my garment rent, I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to Jehovah my God,

title: Ezra 9:6
text: and said: O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God; for our iniquities are increased over [our] head, and our trespass is grown up to the heavens.

title: Ezra 9:7
text: Since the days of our fathers, we have been in great trespass to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, our priests, have been given into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, and to captivity, and to spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

title: Ezra 9:8
text: And now for a little space there hath been favour from Jehovah our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

title: Ezra 9:9
text: For we are bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us before the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God and to repair the ruins thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 9:10
text: And now, what shall we say, our God, after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

title: Ezra 9:11
text: which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess [it], is an unclean land through the filthiness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations with which they have filled it from one end to another through their uncleanness.

title: Ezra 9:12
text: Now therefore give not your daughters to their sons, neither take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity for ever; that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.

title: Ezra 9:13
text: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities [deserve], and hast given us such deliverance as this,

title: Ezra 9:14
text: should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the peoples of these abominations? wouldest thou not be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor any to escape?

title: Ezra 9:15
text: Jehovah, God of Israel, thou art righteous; for we are a remnant that is escaped, as [it is] this day. Behold, we are before thee in our trespasses; for there is no standing before thee because of this.

title: Ezra 10:1
text: ¶And while Ezra prayed, and made confession, weeping and falling down before the house of God, there were gathered to him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children; for the people wept very much.

title: Ezra 10:2
text: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, We have acted unfaithfully toward our God, and have taken foreign wives of the peoples of the land; yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.

title: Ezra 10:3
text: And now let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of [my] lord, and of those that tremble at the commandments of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

title: Ezra 10:4
text: Arise, for this matter is incumbent on thee, and we will be with thee: be of good courage, and do [it].

title: Ezra 10:5
text: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, of the Levites, and of all Israel, to swear that they would do according to this word. And they swore.

title: Ezra 10:6
text: ¶And Ezra arose from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib; and when he came thither, he ate no bread and drank no water; for he mourned because of the unfaithfulness of them that had been carried away.

title: Ezra 10:7
text: And they made proclamation in Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

title: Ezra 10:8
text: and that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be confiscated, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

title: Ezra 10:9
text: Then were all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered together at Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month; and all the people sat in the open space of the house of God, trembling because of the matter, and because of the pouring rain.

title: Ezra 10:10
text: And Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, Ye have acted unfaithfully, and have taken foreign wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.

title: Ezra 10:11
text: And now make confession to Jehovah the God of your fathers, and do his pleasure, and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land, and from the foreign wives.

title: Ezra 10:12
text: And the whole congregation answered and said with a loud voice, Yes, it is for us to do according to thy words.

title: Ezra 10:13
text: But the people are many, and it is a time of pouring rain, and it is not possible to stand without: neither is this a work for one day or two; for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

title: Ezra 10:14
text: Let now our princes, while this matter is going on, stand for all the congregation, and let all those that have taken foreign wives in our cities come at the appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce anger of our God be turned from us.

title: Ezra 10:15
text: ¶Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

title: Ezra 10:16
text: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest [and] certain of the chief fathers were separated according to their fathers' houses, and all of them [expressed] by name; and they sat down on the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

title: Ezra 10:17
text: And they ended with all the men that had taken foreign wives by the first day of the first month.

title: Ezra 10:18
text: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken foreign wives, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren: Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

title: Ezra 10:19
text: And they gave their hand to send away their wives; and they offered a ram of the flock, as trespass-offering for their guilt.

title: Ezra 10:20
text: And of the children of Immer: Hanani, and Zebadiah.

title: Ezra 10:21
text: And of the children of Harim: Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

title: Ezra 10:22
text: And of the children of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

title: Ezra 10:23
text: And of the Levites: Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

title: Ezra 10:24
text: And of the singers: Eliashib. And of the doorkeepers: Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

title: Ezra 10:25
text: And of Israel; of the children of Parosh: Ramiah, and Jizzijah, and Malchijah, and Mijamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

title: Ezra 10:26
text: And of the children of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Elijah.

title: Ezra 10:27
text: And of the children of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

title: Ezra 10:28
text: And of the children of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.

title: Ezra 10:29
text: And of the children of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

title: Ezra 10:30
text: And of the children of Pahath-Moab: Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.

title: Ezra 10:31
text: And the children of Harim: Eliezer, Jishijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Simeon,

title: Ezra 10:32
text: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.

title: Ezra 10:33
text: Of the children of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.

title: Ezra 10:34
text: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

title: Ezra 10:35
text: Benaiah, Bediah, Cheluhu,

title: Ezra 10:36
text: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

title: Ezra 10:37
text: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasai,

title: Ezra 10:38
text: and Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

title: Ezra 10:39
text: and Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,

title: Ezra 10:40
text: Machnadbai, Shashai, Sharai,

title: Ezra 10:41
text: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

title: Ezra 10:42
text: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.

title: Ezra 10:43
text: Of the children of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, and Joel, Benaiah.

title: Ezra 10:44
text: All these had taken foreign wives; and there were among them wives who had had children.

title: Nehemiah 1:1
text: ¶The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the fortress,

title: Nehemiah 1:2
text: that Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and [certain] men of Judah. And I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

title: Nehemiah 1:3
text: And they said to me, Those who remain, that are left of the captivity there in the province, are in great affliction and reproach; and the wall of Jerusalem is in ruins, and its gates are burned with fire.

title: Nehemiah 1:4
text: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat and wept, and mourned for days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of the heavens,

title: Nehemiah 1:5
text: ¶and said, I beseech thee, Jehovah, God of the heavens, the great and terrible *God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and keep his commandments.

title: Nehemiah 1:6
text: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, to hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, confessing the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.

title: Nehemiah 1:7
text: We have acted very perversely against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances that thou commandedst thy servant Moses.

title: Nehemiah 1:8
text: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye act unfaithfully, I will scatter you among the peoples;

title: Nehemiah 1:9
text: but if ye return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heavens, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.

title: Nehemiah 1:10
text: And they are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power and by thy strong hand.

title: Nehemiah 1:11
text: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants who delight to fear thy name; and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. Now I was the king's cupbearer.

title: Nehemiah 2:1
text: ¶And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, [that] wine was before him, and I took up the wine and gave it to the king. Now, I had never been sad in his presence.

title: Nehemiah 2:2
text: And the king said to me, Why is thy face sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sadness of heart. And I was very sore afraid.

title: Nehemiah 2:3
text: And I said to the king, Let the king live for ever! Why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, lies waste, and its gates are consumed with fire?

title: Nehemiah 2:4
text: And the king said to me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of the heavens.

title: Nehemiah 2:5
text: And I said to the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.

title: Nehemiah 2:6
text: And the king said to me--the queen also sitting by him, --For how long shall thy journey be, and when wilt thou return? And it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.

title: Nehemiah 2:7
text: And I said to the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may set me forward till I come into Judah;

title: Nehemiah 2:8
text: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which [appertains] to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.

title: Nehemiah 2:9
text: ¶And I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of a force and horsemen with me.

title: Nehemiah 2:10
text: And when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobijah the servant, the Ammonite, heard [of it], it grieved them exceedingly that there had come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

title: Nehemiah 2:11
text: And I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

title: Nehemiah 2:12
text: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me--but I told no man what my God had put in my heart to do for Jerusalem--and there was no beast with me, except the beast that I rode upon.

title: Nehemiah 2:13
text: And I went out by night by the valley-gate, even toward the jackal-fountain, and to the dung-gate; and I viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were in ruins, and its gates were consumed with fire.

title: Nehemiah 2:14
text: And I went on to the fountain-gate, and to the king's pool; and there was no place for the beast under me to pass.

title: Nehemiah 2:15
text: And I went up in the night through the valley, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the valley-gate and returned.

title: Nehemiah 2:16
text: And the rulers did not know whither I went or what I did, for I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.

title: Nehemiah 2:17
text: And I said to them, Ye see the distress that we are in, that Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.

title: Nehemiah 2:18
text: And I told them of the hand of my God which had been good upon me; as also of the king's words which he had said unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. And they strengthened their hands for the good [work].

title: Nehemiah 2:19
text: And Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobijah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it; and they mocked us and despised us, and said, What is this thing which ye do? will ye rebel against the king?

title: Nehemiah 2:20
text: And I answered them, and said to them, The God of the heavens, he will prosper us, and we his servants will arise and build; but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.

title: Nehemiah 3:1
text: ¶And Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they built the sheep-gate. They hallowed it, and set up its doors; and they hallowed it even to the tower of Meah, to the tower of Hananeel.

title: Nehemiah 3:2
text: And next to them built the men of Jericho. And next to them built Zaccur the son of Imri.

title: Nehemiah 3:3
text: And the fish-gate did the sons of Senaah build: they laid its beams, and set up its doors, its locks and its bars.

title: Nehemiah 3:4
text: And next to them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next to them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next to them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.

title: Nehemiah 3:5
text: And next to them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.

title: Nehemiah 3:6
text: And the gate of the old [wall] repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodiah; they laid its beams, and set up its doors, and its locks, and its bars.

title: Nehemiah 3:7
text: And next to them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, to the seat of the governor on this side the river.

title: Nehemiah 3:8
text: Next to them repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths; and next to him repaired Hananiah of the perfumers, and they left Jerusalem [in its state] as far as the broad wall.

title: Nehemiah 3:9
text: And next to them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.

title: Nehemiah 3:10
text: And next to them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next to him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.

title: Nehemiah 3:11
text: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahath-Moab repaired a second piece, and the tower of the furnaces.

title: Nehemiah 3:12
text: And next to them repaired Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

title: Nehemiah 3:13
text: The valley-gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up its doors, its locks and its bars, and a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the dung-gate.

title: Nehemiah 3:14
text: And the dung-gate repaired Malchijah the son of Rechab, the chief of the district of Beth-haccerem; he built it, and set up its doors, its locks and its bars.

title: Nehemiah 3:15
text: And the fountain-gate repaired Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the chief of the district of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up its doors, its locks and its bars, and the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king's garden, and to the stairs that go down from the city of David.

title: Nehemiah 3:16
text: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the chief of the half district of Beth-zur, even over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty [men].

title: Nehemiah 3:17
text: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next to him repaired Hashabiah, the chief of the half district of Keilah, for his district.

title: Nehemiah 3:18
text: After him repaired their brethren, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the chief of the half district of Keilah.

title: Nehemiah 3:19
text: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, a second piece over against the going up to the armoury at the angle.

title: Nehemiah 3:20
text: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another piece, from the angle to the entry of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

title: Nehemiah 3:21
text: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz, another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib as far as the end of the house of Eliashib.

title: Nehemiah 3:22
text: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain [of Jordan].

title: Nehemiah 3:23
text: After them repaired Benjamin and Hasshub over against their house. After them repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, by his house.

title: Nehemiah 3:24
text: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah to the angle, as far as the corner.

title: Nehemiah 3:25
text: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the angle, and the high tower that lies out from the king's house, which was by the court of the prison. After him, Pedaiah the son of Parosh.

title: Nehemiah 3:26
text: (Now the Nethinim dwelt in Ophel, even over against the water-gate toward the east, and the tower which lies out.)

title: Nehemiah 3:27
text: After him the Tekoites repaired a second piece, over against the great tower which lies out, as far as the wall of Ophel.

title: Nehemiah 3:28
text: From above the horse-gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.

title: Nehemiah 3:29
text: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. And after him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.

title: Nehemiah 3:30
text: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, a second piece. After them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.

title: Nehemiah 3:31
text: After him repaired Malchijah of the goldsmiths to the place of the Nethinim and of the dealers, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the ascent of the corner.

title: Nehemiah 3:32
text: And between the ascent of the corner and the sheep-gate repaired the goldsmiths and the dealers.

title: Nehemiah 4:1
text: ¶And it came to pass that when Sanballat heard that we built the wall, he was angry and very indignant, and mocked the Jews.

title: Nehemiah 4:2
text: And he spoke before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? shall they be permitted to go on? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, when they are burned?

title: Nehemiah 4:3
text: And Tobijah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox went up, it would break down their stone wall. --

title: Nehemiah 4:4
text: Hear, our God, for we are despised, and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in a land of captivity!

title: Nehemiah 4:5
text: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee; for they have provoked the builders.

title: Nehemiah 4:6
text: But we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to the half thereof; for the people had a mind to work.

title: Nehemiah 4:7
text: ¶And it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobijah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the walls of Jerusalem were being repaired, that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,

title: Nehemiah 4:8
text: and conspired all of them together to come to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.

title: Nehemiah 4:9
text: Then we prayed to our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

title: Nehemiah 4:10
text: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens faileth, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build at the wall.

title: Nehemiah 4:11
text: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come into the midst of them and kill them, and put an end to the work.

title: Nehemiah 4:12
text: And it came to pass that when the Jews that dwelt by them came and told us so ten times, from all the places whence they returned to us,

title: Nehemiah 4:13
text: I set in the lower places behind the wall in exposed places, I even set the people, according to their families, with their swords, their spears and their bows.

title: Nehemiah 4:14
text: And I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not afraid of them: remember the Lord who is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your houses.

title: Nehemiah 4:15
text: And it came to pass that when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and that God had defeated their counsel, we returned all of us to the wall, every one to his work.

title: Nehemiah 4:16
text: ¶And from that time forth the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held the spears, and the shields, and the bows, and the corslets; and the captains were behind all the house of Judah.

title: Nehemiah 4:17
text: They that built on the wall, and they that bore burdens, with those that loaded, wrought in the work with one hand, and with the other they held a weapon.

title: Nehemiah 4:18
text: And the builders had every one his sword girded by his side, and built. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.

title: Nehemiah 4:19
text: And I said to the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and extended, and we are scattered upon the wall, one far from another:

title: Nehemiah 4:20
text: in what place ye hear the sound of the trumpet, thither shall ye assemble to us; our God will fight for us.

title: Nehemiah 4:21
text: And we laboured in the work; and half of them held the spears from the rising of the dawn till the stars appeared.

title: Nehemiah 4:22
text: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and [be for] labour in the day.

title: Nehemiah 4:23
text: And neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard that followed me, none of us put off our garments: every one had his weapon on his right side.

title: Nehemiah 5:1
text: ¶And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.

title: Nehemiah 5:2
text: And there were that said, We, our sons and our daughters, are many, and we must procure corn that we may eat and live.

title: Nehemiah 5:3
text: And there were that said, We have had to pledge our fields, and our vineyards, and our houses, that we might procure corn in the dearth.

title: Nehemiah 5:4
text: And there were that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute upon our fields and vineyards;

title: Nehemiah 5:5
text: yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children; and behold, we must bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought into bondage [already]; neither is it in the power of our hand [to redeem them], for other men have our fields and our vineyards.

title: Nehemiah 5:6
text: ¶And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

title: Nehemiah 5:7
text: And I consulted with myself; and I remonstrated with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother! And I set a great assembly against them.

title: Nehemiah 5:8
text: And I said to them, We, according to our ability, have redeemed our brethren the Jews, who were sold to the nations; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? And they were silent and found no answer.

title: Nehemiah 5:9
text: And I said, The thing that ye do is not good. Ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God, so as not to be the reproach of the nations our enemies?

title: Nehemiah 5:10
text: I also, my brethren and my servants, we might exact usury of them, money and corn. I pray you, let us leave off this usury.

title: Nehemiah 5:11
text: Restore, I pray you, to them this very day their fields, their vineyards, their olive-gardens, and their houses, also the hundredth [part] of the money, and of the corn, the wine and the oil, that ye have exacted of them.

title: Nehemiah 5:12
text: And they said, We will restore [them], and will require nothing of them; so will we do, as thou hast said. And I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

title: Nehemiah 5:13
text: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house and from his earnings, that performeth not this promise: even thus be he shaken out and emptied! And all the congregation said, Amen! And they praised Jehovah. And the people did according to this promise.

title: Nehemiah 5:14
text: ¶Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

title: Nehemiah 5:15
text: But the former governors that were before me had been chargeable to the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, besides forty shekels of silver: even their servants bore rule over the people. But I did not so, because of the fear of God.

title: Nehemiah 5:16
text: Yea, also I applied myself to this work of the wall, and we bought no fields; and all my servants were gathered thither for the work.

title: Nehemiah 5:17
text: And there were at my table a hundred and fifty of the Jews and the rulers, besides those that came to us from among the nations that were about us.

title: Nehemiah 5:18
text: And that which was prepared daily was one ox [and] six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days all sorts of wine in abundance. Yet for all this I demanded not the bread of the governor; for the service was heavy upon this people.

title: Nehemiah 5:19
text: Remember for me, my God, for good, all that I have done for this people.

title: Nehemiah 6:1
text: ¶And it came to pass when Sanballat, and Tobijah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though at that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),

title: Nehemiah 6:2
text: that Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, Come, let us meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

title: Nehemiah 6:3
text: And I sent messengers to them, saying, I am doing a great work, and I cannot come down. Why should the work cease, whilst I leave it and come down to you?

title: Nehemiah 6:4
text: And they sent to me four times after this sort; and I answered them in the same manner.

title: Nehemiah 6:5
text: Then sent Sanballat his servant to me in this manner the fifth time, with an open letter in his hand,

title: Nehemiah 6:6
text: in which was written: It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says [it, that] thou and the Jews think to rebel, for which cause thou buildest the wall, and according to these words thou wilt become their king.

title: Nehemiah 6:7
text: And thou hast also appointed prophets to proclaim concerning thee at Jerusalem saying, There is a king in Judah! And now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

title: Nehemiah 6:8
text: And I sent to him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

title: Nehemiah 6:9
text: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be slackened from the work, that it be not carried out. --Now therefore strengthen my hands!

title: Nehemiah 6:10
text: ¶And I came to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabeel, who had shut himself up. And he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple; for they are coming to kill thee; even in the night are they coming to kill thee.

title: Nehemiah 6:11
text: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, could go into the temple, and live? I will not go in.

title: Nehemiah 6:12
text: And I perceived, and behold, God had not sent him; for he pronounced this prophecy against me; and Tobijah and Sanballat had hired him.

title: Nehemiah 6:13
text: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have wherewith to spread an evil report, that they might reproach me.

title: Nehemiah 6:14
text: My God, remember Tobijah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets who would have put me in fear.

title: Nehemiah 6:15
text: ¶So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.

title: Nehemiah 6:16
text: And it came to pass that when all our enemies heard [of it], all the nations that were about us were afraid and were much cast down in their own eyes, and they perceived that this work was wrought by our God.

title: Nehemiah 6:17
text: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobijah, and those of Tobijah came to them.

title: Nehemiah 6:18
text: For there were many in Judah sworn to him; for he was a son-in-law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

title: Nehemiah 6:19
text: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. [And] Tobijah sent letters to put me in fear.

title: Nehemiah 7:1
text: ¶And it came to pass when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, that the doorkeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed.

title: Nehemiah 7:2
text: And I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the citadel, charge over Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

title: Nehemiah 7:3
text: And I said to them that the gates of Jerusalem should not be opened until the sun was hot, and that they should shut the doors and bar them while they stood by; and that there should be appointed watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one over against his house.

title: Nehemiah 7:4
text: Now the city was large and great; but the people in it were few, and no houses were built.

title: Nehemiah 7:5
text: ¶And my God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, for registration by genealogy. And I found a genealogical register of those that had come up at the first, and I found written in it:

title: Nehemiah 7:6
text: These are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one to his city;

title: Nehemiah 7:7
text: those who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

title: Nehemiah 7:8
text: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred and seventy-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:9
text: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:10
text: The children of Arah, six hundred and fifty-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:11
text: The children of Pahath-Moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and eighteen.

title: Nehemiah 7:12
text: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

title: Nehemiah 7:13
text: The children of Zattu, eight hundred and forty-five.

title: Nehemiah 7:14
text: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

title: Nehemiah 7:15
text: The children of Binnui, six hundred and forty-eight.

title: Nehemiah 7:16
text: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-eight.

title: Nehemiah 7:17
text: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred and twenty-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:18
text: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-seven.

title: Nehemiah 7:19
text: The children of Bigvai, two thousand and sixty-seven.

title: Nehemiah 7:20
text: The children of Adin, six hundred and fifty-five.

title: Nehemiah 7:21
text: The children of Ater of [the family of] Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

title: Nehemiah 7:22
text: The children of Hashum, three hundred and twenty-eight.

title: Nehemiah 7:23
text: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-four.

title: Nehemiah 7:24
text: The children of Hariph, a hundred and twelve.

title: Nehemiah 7:25
text: The children of Gibeon, ninety-five.

title: Nehemiah 7:26
text: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, a hundred and eighty-eight.

title: Nehemiah 7:27
text: The men of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.

title: Nehemiah 7:28
text: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:29
text: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three.

title: Nehemiah 7:30
text: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.

title: Nehemiah 7:31
text: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:32
text: The men of Bethel and Ai, a hundred and twenty-three.

title: Nehemiah 7:33
text: The men of the other Nebo, fifty-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:34
text: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty-four.

title: Nehemiah 7:35
text: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

title: Nehemiah 7:36
text: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.

title: Nehemiah 7:37
text: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-one.

title: Nehemiah 7:38
text: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

title: Nehemiah 7:39
text: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.

title: Nehemiah 7:40
text: The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:41
text: The children of Pashhur, a thousand two hundred and forty-seven.

title: Nehemiah 7:42
text: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

title: Nehemiah 7:43
text: The Levites: the children of Jeshua [and] of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodvah, seventy-four.

title: Nehemiah 7:44
text: The singers: the children of Asaph, a hundred and forty-eight.

title: Nehemiah 7:45
text: The doorkeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, a hundred and thirty-eight.

title: Nehemiah 7:46
text: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

title: Nehemiah 7:47
text: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

title: Nehemiah 7:48
text: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

title: Nehemiah 7:49
text: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

title: Nehemiah 7:50
text: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

title: Nehemiah 7:51
text: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,

title: Nehemiah 7:52
text: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,

title: Nehemiah 7:53
text: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

title: Nehemiah 7:54
text: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

title: Nehemiah 7:55
text: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,

title: Nehemiah 7:56
text: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

title: Nehemiah 7:57
text: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

title: Nehemiah 7:58
text: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

title: Nehemiah 7:59
text: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth-Hazzebaim, the children of Amon.

title: Nehemiah 7:60
text: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon's servants, three hundred and ninety-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:61
text: And these are they that went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub-Addon and Immer; but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.

title: Nehemiah 7:62
text: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobijah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and forty-two.

title: Nehemiah 7:63
text: And of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called after their name.

title: Nehemiah 7:64
text: These sought their genealogical register, but it was not found; therefore were they, as polluted, removed from the priesthood.

title: Nehemiah 7:65
text: And the Tirshatha said to them that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up the priest with Urim and Thummim.

title: Nehemiah 7:66
text: The whole congregation together was forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,

title: Nehemiah 7:67
text: besides their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven; and they had two hundred and forty-five singing-men and singing-women.

title: Nehemiah 7:68
text: Their horses were seven hundred and thirty-six; their mules, two hundred and forty-five;

title: Nehemiah 7:69
text: the camels, four hundred and thirty-five; the asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

title: Nehemiah 7:70
text: And some of the chief fathers gave to the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand darics of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' coats.

title: Nehemiah 7:71
text: And [some] of the chief fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred pounds of silver.

title: Nehemiah 7:72
text: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and sixty-seven priests' coats.

title: Nehemiah 7:73
text: And the priests, and the Levites, and the doorkeepers, and the singers, and [some] of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities. And when the seventh month came, and the children of Israel were in their cities,

title: Nehemiah 8:1
text: ¶all the people gathered together as one man to the open place that was before the water-gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Jehovah had commanded Israel.

title: Nehemiah 8:2
text: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation, both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

title: Nehemiah 8:3
text: And he read in it before the open place that was before the water-gate from the morning until midday, in presence of the men and the women, and those that could understand. And the ears of all the people were [attentive] to the book of the law.

title: Nehemiah 8:4
text: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a high stage of wood, which they had made for the purpose. And beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkijah, and Maaseiah on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchijah, and Hashum, and Hashbaddana, Zechariah, Meshullam.

title: Nehemiah 8:5
text: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, for he was above all the people; and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

title: Nehemiah 8:6
text: And Ezra blessed Jehovah, the great God; and all the people answered, Amen, Amen! with lifting up of their hands; and they bowed their heads, and worshipped Jehovah with their faces to the ground.

title: Nehemiah 8:7
text: And Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people [stood] in their place.

title: Nehemiah 8:8
text: And they read in the law of God distinctly out of the book, and gave the sense, and caused [them] to understand the reading.

title: Nehemiah 8:9
text: ¶And Nehemiah, that is, the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that explained to the people, said to all the people, This day is holy to Jehovah your God: mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

title: Nehemiah 8:10
text: And he said to them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions to them for whom nothing is prepared; for the day is holy to our Lord; and be not grieved, for the joy of Jehovah is your strength.

title: Nehemiah 8:11
text: And the Levites quieted all the people, saying, Be still! for the day is holy; neither be grieved.

title: Nehemiah 8:12
text: And all the people went their way, to eat and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great rejoicing. For they had understood the words that were declared to them.

title: Nehemiah 8:13
text: ¶And on the second day were gathered together the chief fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, to Ezra the scribe, even to gain wisdom as to the words of the law.

title: Nehemiah 8:14
text: And they found written in the law which Jehovah had commanded through Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month,

title: Nehemiah 8:15
text: and that they should publish and proclaim through all their cities, and at Jerusalem, saying, Go forth to the mount, and fetch olive-branches, and wild olive-branches, and myrtle-branches, and palm-branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.

title: Nehemiah 8:16
text: And the people went forth and brought [them], and made themselves booths, everyone upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the open space of the water-gate, and in the open space of the gate of Ephraim.

title: Nehemiah 8:17
text: And all the congregation of them that had come back from the captivity made booths, and dwelt in the booths. For since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun until that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.

title: Nehemiah 8:18
text: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they observed the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

title: Nehemiah 9:1
text: ¶And on the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

title: Nehemiah 9:2
text: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

title: Nehemiah 9:3
text: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Jehovah their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed, and worshipped Jehovah their God.

title: Nehemiah 9:4
text: ¶Then stood up upon the platform of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, Chenani, and cried with a loud voice to Jehovah their God.

title: Nehemiah 9:5
text: And the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, Pethahiah, said, Stand up, bless Jehovah your God from eternity to eternity. And let [men] bless the name of thy glory, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

title: Nehemiah 9:6
text: Thou art the Same, thou alone, Jehovah, who hast made the heaven of heavens, and all their host, the earth and all that is therein, the seas and all that is therein. And thou quickenest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

title: Nehemiah 9:7
text: Thou art the Same, Jehovah Elohim, who didst choose Abram and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

title: Nehemiah 9:8
text: and foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest the covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, --to give it to his seed; and thou hast performed thy words, for thou art righteous.

title: Nehemiah 9:9
text: And thou sawest the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red Sea;

title: Nehemiah 9:10
text: and didst shew signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants, and upon all the people of his land; for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them, and thou didst make thee a name, as it is this day.

title: Nehemiah 9:11
text: And thou didst divide the sea before them, and they went through the midst of the sea on dry [ground]; and their pursuers thou threwest into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

title: Nehemiah 9:12
text: And thou leddest them in the day by a pillar of cloud, and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

title: Nehemiah 9:13
text: And thou camest down on mount Sinai, and didst speak with them from the heavens, and gavest them right judgments and true laws, good statutes and commandments.

title: Nehemiah 9:14
text: And thou madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and prescribedst for them commandments and statutes and a law, through Moses thy servant.

title: Nehemiah 9:15
text: And thou gavest them bread from the heavens for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and didst say to them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

title: Nehemiah 9:16
text: But they, our fathers, dealt proudly, and hardened their neck, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

title: Nehemiah 9:17
text: and refused to obey, neither were they mindful of thy wonders which thou hadst done among them; but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion made a captain to return to their bondage. But thou art a +God ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, slow to anger and of great loving-kindness, and thou forsookest them not.

title: Nehemiah 9:18
text: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy god that brought thee up out of Egypt! and they had wrought great provocation,

title: Nehemiah 9:19
text: yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness. The pillar of the cloud departed not from over them by day, to lead them on the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

title: Nehemiah 9:20
text: Thou gavest also thy good Spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

title: Nehemiah 9:21
text: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness; they lacked nothing; their clothes grew not old, and their feet swelled not.

title: Nehemiah 9:22
text: And thou gavest them kingdoms and peoples, and didst divide them by countries; and they possessed the land of Sihon, as well the land of the king of Heshbon, as the land of Og king of Bashan.

title: Nehemiah 9:23
text: And their children thou didst multiply as the stars of heaven, and thou broughtest them into the land concerning which thou didst say to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.

title: Nehemiah 9:24
text: And the children went in and possessed the land; and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, both their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

title: Nehemiah 9:25
text: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all good things, wells digged, vineyards and olive-gardens, and fruit trees in abundance. And they did eat and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

title: Nehemiah 9:26
text: But they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets who testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

title: Nehemiah 9:27
text: And thou gavest them into the hand of their oppressors, and they oppressed them; and in the time of their distress, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from the heavens, and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their oppressors.

title: Nehemiah 9:28
text: But when they had rest, they did evil again before thee; and thou didst leave them in the hand of their enemies, and they had dominion over them; and again they cried unto thee, and thou heardest [them] from the heavens, and many times didst thou deliver them, according to thy mercies.

title: Nehemiah 9:29
text: And thou testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law; but they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thine ordinances (which if a man do, he shall live in them); and they withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

title: Nehemiah 9:30
text: And many years didst thou forbear with them, and testifiedst against them by thy Spirit through thy prophets; but they would not give ear: and thou gavest them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

title: Nehemiah 9:31
text: Nevertheless for thy manifold mercies' sake, thou didst not make a full end of them nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful *God.

title: Nehemiah 9:32
text: And now, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible *God, who keepest covenant and loving-kindness, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the days of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

title: Nehemiah 9:33
text: But thou art just in all that is come upon us; for thou hast acted according to truth, and we have done wickedly.

title: Nehemiah 9:34
text: And our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers, have not performed thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.

title: Nehemiah 9:35
text: And they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land that thou didst set before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.

title: Nehemiah 9:36
text: Behold, we are servants this day, and the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are bondmen in it.

title: Nehemiah 9:37
text: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: and they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure; and we are in great distress.

title: Nehemiah 9:38
text: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, [and] our priests are at the sealing.

title: Nehemiah 10:1
text: ¶And at the head of those that sealed were Nehemiah the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zedekiah.

title: Nehemiah 10:2
text: --Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

title: Nehemiah 10:3
text: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,

title: Nehemiah 10:4
text: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

title: Nehemiah 10:5
text: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

title: Nehemiah 10:6
text: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

title: Nehemiah 10:7
text: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

title: Nehemiah 10:8
text: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.

title: Nehemiah 10:9
text: --And the Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah; Binnui, of the sons of Henadad; Kadmiel,

title: Nehemiah 10:10
text: and their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

title: Nehemiah 10:11
text: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,

title: Nehemiah 10:12
text: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

title: Nehemiah 10:13
text: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

title: Nehemiah 10:14
text: --The chief of the people: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

title: Nehemiah 10:15
text: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

title: Nehemiah 10:16
text: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

title: Nehemiah 10:17
text: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

title: Nehemiah 10:18
text: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

title: Nehemiah 10:19
text: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

title: Nehemiah 10:20
text: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

title: Nehemiah 10:21
text: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

title: Nehemiah 10:22
text: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

title: Nehemiah 10:23
text: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

title: Nehemiah 10:24
text: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,

title: Nehemiah 10:25
text: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

title: Nehemiah 10:26
text: and Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

title: Nehemiah 10:27
text: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

title: Nehemiah 10:28
text: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the doorkeepers, the singers, the Nethinim, and all they that had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons and their daughters, every one having knowledge [and] having understanding,
